Hotels.Description: 【Traveling in Dongguang, slow down your heart and let the scenery come in】      Dongguang Travel is located in the Dongpu Hot Spring Scenic Area in Xinyi Township, Nantou County, with an altitude of about 1,200 meters. It is famous for its natural hot springs and magnificent mountain scenery. The hotel is close to Chenyoulan River, with the Xinzhongheng Highway in front and the Batongguan Ancient Road in the back. It has a superior geographical location and is an important relay station between Xinzhongheng and the ancient road. It is also the critical point of Yushan National Park. It is surrounded by mountains, including mountains, Wangxiangshan and Yushan. The scenery is vast and is an excellent starting point for climbing Yushan and visiting Batongguan.      Dongpu natural hot spring introduced by our travels is sourced from the foothills of Wangxiang. It has abundant water and is inexhaustible all seasons. The spring water is clear and transparent, colorless and odorless. It is a weak alkaline carbonated spring with a temperature of about 47°C. It can not only be soaked in soup, but also drink directly. It is the best among mineral water.      The rooms have an exclusive soup house, allowing you to enjoy private hot spring time in the room. Outdoors are also planned to have an open-air bath pool and a hot spring swimming pool, which are suitable for all seasons. Whether it is morning or dusk, you can fully immerse yourself in the spring healing among the mountains and forests.      When traveling in Dongguang, the dining table carries not only the flavor, but also the stories from the mountains, forests and land. We select local ingredients, blend the pure taste of natural terroir, and slowly simmer it into warm and delicious dishes, awakening the sleeping taste buds during the journey, making every meal not only full, but also a time worth savoring during the journey.      In addition, Dongguang Travel also has a well-equipped conference space, equipped with projection equipment, audio systems and a comfortable discussion environment. Whether it is corporate meetings, education and training, lectures, or communication time during group tourism, it can be flexibly used to break the limitations of the field, allow inspiration to flow freely, and stimulate more possibilities of cooperation and dialogue in nature.      Whether you are relaxing quietly in the private soup in the room, or feeling the embrace of the mountains and forests between the open-air soup pool and the hot spring swimming pool, every moment is the beginning of healing, accompanied by local and carefully cooked dishes, so that the taste buds are also treated gently. This place is not only a place to rest, but also an ideal place to reconnect with nature. I sincerely invite you to visit yourself and experience the beauty of the mountains, forests, hot springs.? Hotels.Description: New Taipei｜Something Easy GuesthouseA Window to Tranquility in a Mountain TownAs you ride up the mountain into the town of Jiufen, you catch sight of the misty mountains in the distance and see the sun pierce the clouds, warming the emerald-green mountainside. Disembarking from your ride, you recall the words of your host, Min, who warned that you would have to pass through the bustling old-street district on your way to the guesthouse. As you walk to the end of the street, you begin to foresee what is in store, as images of the elegant, tranquil face of Jiufen begin to fill your mind.A life of peace and quiet on the side of the mountainWalking along stone steps, you wind your way this way and that down the narrow alleys until you reach the appointed destination of Jiufen Elementary School, where you are met by the sweet smile of your host, Min. You follow her for less than three minutes until you reach the inconspicuous entrance of Something Easy Guesthouse to one side of the steep stone laneway. You close the door behind you and, slipping out of your shoes and into the slippers your host has prepared, you step onto the warm solid-wood floorboards. You bask in the warm lighting of the place, leaving the cold air of the mountains behind, as the mellow wooden environs instantly set your mind at ease.This space was originally designed to meet the vacation needs of Min’s family. From the verawood floorboards to the array of solid teakwood furniture, every corner of the space reveals her family’s insistence on quality and texture. The house, which is situated on the edge of this hillside town, affords you secluded, peaceful lodgings for your getaway from busy city life.Waking up free from worry in a scenic landscapeYou gently open the door to each of the rooms and walk in towards an entire wall of floor-to-ceiling windows. You gaze upon the mountain range beyond, the peaks extending layer upon layer all the way to the ocean where ocean and sky meet on the horizon. If you choose to stay in an upstairs room, you may enjoy the luxury of your own small living room, allowing you the freedom to laze about on the sofa in the company of the majestic landscape.As the evening sky gradually darkens, the lights of the town illuminate the mountainside one by one. Min has thoughtfully equipped your bathroom with a heater / dehumidifier so that you may stay warm and dry at all times. After you’ve enjoyed a lavish bath, connect to the room’s bluetooth sound system to play your favorite tunes. Finally, lie down on the large double bed and slowly drift into slumberland.A calm corner on the Old StreetAs morning breaks and the gentle sunlight peeks through the cracks of the curtains, you unhurriedly awake to meet the day. The single-serving coffee maker brews a silky smooth latte for you to enjoy on the rooftop patio with a few slices of toast and jam. In contrast to yesterday evening’s misty mountain scenery, the daytime skies in Jiufen appear especially clear and bright - the turquoise blue of the ocean blending into the azure blue of the sky. Glancing downwards, you realize the bustle of Jiufen Old Street is right below your feet. Anticipation of perusing the old street at a leisurely pace begins to build, as you imagine the undiscovered pleasures awaiting you within.Something Easy Guesthouse is situated in a corner of Jiufen’s bustling Old Street, inviting you to settle into your own tranquil corner from which to peacefully observe the everyday life of this hillside town. Regardless of the countless tumultuous days of your life, all that is left now is a wall of windows and the serene landscape beyond. From here, discover the peaceful getaway of your dreams.

Hotels.Description: About Mingshan Forest Resort - The M VillageMingshan Forest Resort is located next to the Xitou Nature Education Area in Nantou.(Original name: Mingshan Hotel, Mingshan Villa)It is surrounded by the towering fir forest and unique flora and fauna of the National Taiwan University Experimental Forest.Provide tourist accommodation, sightseeing experience, business district market and other services.The guest rooms in the building area are divided into Building 1, Building 2, Building 3 and Broadway Building.Provide comfortable accommodation space and guest activities.There are also a limited number of escape rooms and secret treasure rooms where you can experience being a little detective and crack clues to solve mysteries.In addition to the building area, there are also twenty forest cabins of different styles.The independent wooden houses are surrounded by fir forests, full of phytoncides.Blending with the forest and being one with the earth, it is so beautiful.About the Matsubayashi shopping districtThe Songlin-cho shopping district is a shopping street affiliated with the Mingshan Forest Hall.There are more than 20 different businesses settled in the square, and there are also resident artists performing in the square.It was established in 2009 with the theme of Japanese architecture and was named "Matsubayashi Town".To commemorate the founder, Songlin Shengyi (Songlin Shengyi was a name during the Japanese occupation period, his real name was Lin Shan)Thanks to the widespread introduction of bloggers and influencers on the Internet, Songlin Town has become a popular tourist attraction in Xitou.The streets and landscapes of the town are decorated with big red torii gates, Japanese-style buildings, and big red lanterns.Travelers who come to Xitou to stay overnight can experience the special mysterious atmosphere under the big red lanterns.The chef of [Laosonglin Cake Shop] in the shopping street has created many special souvenirs, such as Xitou Cake and Ginkgo Cake.The famous Kubota Bakery commemorates the precious foreign friendship between Katsuichi Matsubayashi and his Japanese friend Kubota.Among them, the signature product "Bite the Cat Bread" has repeatedly caused queues and is a hot seller.After Songlin Town was officially established in Xitou, it has been holding a series of holiday and festival activities on a regular basis.In July, commonly known as the Ghost Month, the Demon Festival and Demon Festival are held.During Halloween, we will hold a Halloween Carnival and invite everyone to join us in making fun of others and spreading candy.During the Chinese New Year, a mountain god festival was held to celebrate the harvest and express respect for nature.Pray for peace and happiness to those who come to this land!A variety of rich activities and experiences have successfully attracted the general public to visit Matsubayashi.Dreams and construction are ongoing. We welcome you to come here and spend time with us.

Hotels.Description: Dao Xiang Cun is located in the Taomi Ecological Village of Puli Township. Taomi features an excellent natural environment, a complex and varied forest, rivers, wetlands, an agricultural ecological area, surrounding mountains, fresh air, beautiful scenery, and rich countryside atmosphre. Large in area, Dao Xiang Cun is surrounded by a well-preserved natural environment with an ecological pond full of diverse biological life and forest trail for visitors to explore the local ecology and get a close-up view of the diversity of life in the ecological pond. Pavilions by the pond offer a place to rest, enjoy the beautiful scenery of the surrounding green mountains, breathe in the fresh countryside air, and enjoy the relaxed, leisurely village pace of life. Rooms are well-lit and ventilated, with the double and 4-person rooms featuring simple colors and clean layout. The 6-person room, suitable for accommodating families, features a living room and thoughtful layout that makes visitors feel at home. Carefully listen to the sounds of nature outside in the evenings, putting your cares and worries aside! We maintain the natural appearance of the environment, a warm countryside friendliness, the babbling sound of the stream, beauty of the scenery, sounds of birds, and fragrance of flowers. Bring the children to experience green life in Dao Xiang Cun, where a stroll through the forest will bring back wonderful childhood memories of catching fish and shrimp by the pond – this is a relaxing, otherworldly paradise. Taomi Ecological Village – Dao Xiang Cun Vacation Bed and Breakfast.

Hotels.Description: Located close to Liouciou (Liuqiu) Wharf, Boathouse Specialty Bed and Breakfast’s special wharf shape was designed to highlight the local features of Liouciou (Liuqiu) Fishing Village, with the anchor symbolizing our new establishment in this ocean paradise. If you want to experience the deep blue sea, schools of fish, fantastic coral reefs, and glimpse the mysterious ocean depths, Boathouse Bed and Breakfast is the place to visit. We love this little island, far from the dirt and noise of the city, and originally worked in the restaurant business. While servicing customers, we felt a twinge of pride and satisfaction every time customers left here smiling. We were proud of the fact this beautiful little island was our home, and satisfied that another person could witness its beauty. Our cruise ship-themed bed and breakfast is “docked” at Liouciou (Liuqiu), where we provide travelers with unique, honorable service. Come tour the ocean paradise of Liouciou (Liuqiu)  with us; we offer various themed cabins where you’ll soon catch the vacation spirit. We offer professional ecological tour guides so you can experience the beauty of this place up close, and you’ll discover one surprise after another as the guide leads you through the rich intertidal zone. Dip your feet in the water as the waves come forward and recede, or dive into the sea and search for new surprises. You’ll fall in love with this island and the ocean scenery! Our restaurant offers local seafood, and the fresh pollution-free seafood banquet is a special feature of this place. We’d like to sincerely invite everyone to Liouciou (Liuqiu)  to experience the beauty and friendliness of this place. Put aside worries and cares, give yourself a reason to take a vacation, and relax with a trip to Liouciou (Liuqiu), where we’ll bring you a different seaside experience.

Hotels.Description: Taipei’s prestigious Japanese-style hotel, the Okura Prestige Taipei, is located in the downtown part of the city in the Nanjing East and Zhongshan North Road Commercial Area, whose history dates back to the Japanese colonial era, when it was a gathering place for merchants. Today, it is a center of finance, business, shopping, and entertainment, home to several business buildings, boutique shops, and high-class restaurants. Zhongshan North Road is heavily shaded by trees, features attractive sites, and is home to several embassies and foreign restaurants; here one can really feel the pulse of Taipei. Modern classic space contains Okura Prestige’s legacy, as the Taipei location is one of Prestige’s 5-star hotels. The building’s design was the newest creation of famous Hong Kong designer Rocco Design Architects Limited, and its decoration was directed by Chhada, Siembieda & Associates Ltd, a famous hotel design company from Hong Kong. The main hall features a modern classical European design. Classic European patterns and crystal lighting are thoughtfully placed within the simple colors and line of the modern space, producing a low-key yet calm atmosphere. The space features traditional Japanese elegant design, balancing function and aesthetics and converying the Japanese cultural ideal of harmony with nature. In the relaxed, comfortable space, one can experience Tokyo’s friendly and harmonious spirit of service, continuing a half-century legacy of attentive customer service. Featuring a luxurious living experience and rich living entertainment and style, the hotel’s 208 modern rooms and suites come with a raised space design that perfectly combines modern classical decoration and Japanese functional aesthetics to provide visitors with the ultimate quiet and comfortable accommodation. We also provide a professional gym, heated rooftop pool, spa, and sauna, where you can relax your body and mind. The hotel also includes a multi-purpose meeting area serviced by attentive staff ready to meet your needs. Customized banquet and professional meeting planning makes this a perfect place to hold important banquets and meetings. Feast on fine food and beverages rivaling Tokyo –YAMAZATO fine Japanese Cuisine, Toh-Ka-Lin Chinese Restaurant, and other representative Japanese restaurants have made their home in Okura Prestige Taipei, where you can enjoy classic Japanese cuisine. The hotel also includes the European-style Continental Room, featuring an all-day buffet, The Nine Bakery, and The Pearl, a great bar to relax in and sip fine brews from around the world. The heated rooftop pool features another bar with magnificent views of Taipei 101, the cityscape, and surrounding mountains.

Hotels.Description: Penghu｜Murraya Paniculata VillaA classical Fujian-style vacation home beside the waterDriving along County Road 201, you see none of the hustle and bustle of Penghu City, as the spacious scenery along the sides of the road comes alive. You begin to hum a little country ditty, as you drive towards the classically appealing style of Murraya Paniculata Villa which sits at the end of the lane as if awaiting your arrival.Go to bed in secluded relaxation, surrounded by exquisite brick and tileThe gorgeous courtyard entrance to Murraya Paniculata Villa employs orange brick as its basic style while brightly colored ceramic tiles frame the two characters of the Chinese name to extend a magnificent welcome to all visiting travelers. A refreshing breeze blows by as you enter the premises and see several lotus blossoms are just waiting to burst into bloom in the pool out in front of the house. You raise your head and look upwards beneath the saddle-shaped Fujian-style roof ridge to see elaborate, vivid paintings of birds and flowers frolicking as if about to leap out at you. Upon closer inspection you realize that the scene is made by the nearly-lost traditional art of Taiwanese ceramic applique! Guesthouse owner, Well, especially sought out a team of old-house restoration specialists who carried out their renovation of the entire structure using ancient construction methods. Using the coral stone material unique to Penghu, the old building was made new so that visiting travelers might also enjoy the beauty of an ancient homestead.As the clear yellow sun creeps over the rooftop of Murraya Paniculata Villa, each square inch appears, under the brilliant sunlight, as if sprinkled with gold leaf. In the afterglow of sunset, and in the lamplight after darkness falls, numerous yellow lights appear like ornaments under the violet night sky. Light and shadow move with the passing of time, and the homestead’s winsome reflection is inverted in the waters of the pool. The picturesque reflection appears as if anew at progressive moments throughout the day, at once imposing and beautiful, yet refined and tranquil. Ancient but not old-fashioned, elegant yet adaptiveBehind the simple entrance, however, you’ll be surprised to find your own personal swimming pool! Inside the ancient homestead, you can enjoy all the modern comforts, and allow the light-reflecting water to mirror all the happiness of your vacation. As you push open the gold-leaf painted wooden shutter doors, you behold the elegant furniture in classical Chinese-style. Whether it is the “imperial tutor’s chair”, the old food cabinet, or the wooden linen dresser, each and every implement is refined and unique.When the moment comes to rest and light penetrates outward from the holes in driftwood lamp shades, you make yourself a refreshing cup of Hsiang-ju teasane, a local specialty, and once more wash the dust away with a handful of water from the ceramic lotus flower sink. You savor the remaining light of the sunset which slides down the roof ridge in preparation to embrace the moon in a sound slumber. Enjoy your own meditative purelandOpening the doors in the morning, the brightly smiling housekeeper delivers a diverse breakfast: plump, round meatballs, crisp fried dumplings, tasty iced black tea, and the local favorite of Zhongji baked sesame seed-coated cakes, with a refreshing fruit sandwich to finish the meal. The sumptuous food is deeply satisfying, like a classical nanguan musical performance; sometimes singing, sometimes playing a tune, each delivering its own clever magic whilst making harmonious music together.You push open the front gate and leave Murraya Paniculata Villa, with the dazzling noonhour sun shining on the water of the pool. You approach the surface of the water and discover the lotus flower has bloomed, while little tilapia fish dart between the lotus leaves, their charming silhouettes dancing on the surface of the water. You secretly store this amiable scene deep in your heart, as if, now, you and Penghu share a beautiful secret.

Grand Hi-Lai Hotel has awarded the Best Business Hotel by domestic and international business magazines, has also been designated international banquet venue by the government for several times. Moreover, in 2008, Hi-Lai was designated foreign guests accommodations in the occasion of presidential inaugural banquet. With professional aesthetic architecture, experienced international hotel management, and the most elegant landmark of classic in southern Taiwan, Hi-Lai offers the best quality of professional services in international renown accommodation and in famous international cuisine dishes.

Hotels.Description: LuHeFeng Homestay: A Tranquil Retreat Back to NatureNestled in the serene town of Luodong in Yilan County, LuHeFeng Homestay is the perfect getaway for those looking to escape the hustle and bustle of the city and unwind in a peaceful, natural environment. Every corner of this place seems to embrace nature, offering guests a quiet and leisurely retreat. Whether you& #39;re here for a brief weekend escape or an extended stay to recharge, this haven allows you to fully relax and reconnect with nature.1. An Invitation from NatureSurrounded by lush green fields, LuHeFeng Homestay boasts fresh air, free from the noise and traffic of the city. Instead, you& #39;ll be greeted by the melodious songs of birds and the occasional gentle breeze, encouraging you to slow down and breathe in the clean, refreshing air. During the day, you can relax on the balcony and enjoy the beautiful rural landscape, while in the evening, you can gaze at the stars and experience the peacefulness and mystery of the twilight.2. Designed with the Feeling of "Home"The design of the homestay is simple yet warm, with every corner of the rooms exuding a "homey" feeling. The soft, neutral colors and gentle lighting create an atmosphere that allows you to unwind and leave behind the stress of everyday life. Each room is equipped with modern amenities, ensuring that you can enjoy a comfortable stay even in the countryside. The view of the fields outside, combined with the cozy indoor ambiance, creates a stress-free environment for your relaxation.LuHeFeng Homestay is a place where you can truly slow down and immerse yourself in nature. Whether you’re from a busy city or simply looking for a quiet sanctuary away from the noise of daily life, this homestay offers the perfect experience for relaxation and comfort. Reconnect with nature and embrace the tranquility – let LuHeFeng Homestay be your ideal choice for rejuvenating both body and soul.

Hotels.Description: One day, a child raised beneath the black tea tree decided to leave the workplace behind and return to a place of serene mountains and the scenic countryside, his pure spiritual and life hometown, in order to live with the black tea plants and help the garden that raised him continue to grow sustainably. When the two children put aside their work and decide to help their parents, Black Tea Workshop was born! United in heart and mind, the family entered the world of black tea one step at a time. In order to realize their dream, they started with the designs, and following much debate, decided on a Tudor architectural style – simple, natural, refined, and down-to-earth. They drew up several designs matching the scale of their ideas for lattice windows which let in sunlight and greenery while providing great views. After cutting, pasting, and comparing, they decided on an ideal rectangular 4:3 ratio, changing the deep, narrow Tudor windows into a larger, wider design. For the color coordination of the building’s exterior, they not only diligently searched the Internet to select roof tiles, colors, magnets, tiles, and wood floors, but also visited manufacturers around Taichung to compare and contrast until they found the right texture and patterns. The bed and breakfast’s rooms are named based on the theme of black tea, such as Black Tea Seed, Black Tea Ren, Workshop Aged Tea, and Taiwanese Tea No. 18. The rooms also feature different-themed decoration, with the characters or pictures created by the workshop family or photographs subjected to a special pressure proces, giving them a unique, original style. In order to help guests feel at home, black tea pillows are provided, filling the room with a faint fragrance. The pillows are made by the three generations of family members who run the business and have been personally involved in everything from producing tea to sewing pillows. In addition to the fragrance of the pillows, the room walkways feature pictures detailing the process of hard work that goes into making pillows. In keeping with the black tea theme, room lights are designed with black tea leaves, and under the contrast of the soft light, the leaves spread out, contributing to Black Tea Workshop’s unique style. Rooms are spacious and well-lit inside and out, simple and refined in layout, and faintly fragrant of black tea – features provided by the Black Tea Workshop family in order to provide honored guests with the best and most comfortable atmosphere. The main goal of the workshop is sustainable management of the old tea garden, which naturally makes the old trees the point of focus. So before the 2010 Chinese New Year, in the dead of winter which is the best time for transplanting, the old trees are moved from the garden inside the house to be taken care of. We currently grow them in the Black Tea Workshop courtyard, where they accompany us each day. The days pass just as they once did amidst the tea trees; even when we don’t go to the garden anymore, we feel their presence. When you come to Black Tea Workshop, please take a close look at them. These are the trees that raised our family, standing strong and tall, braving winds and rain for over sixty years! Black Tea Workshop also features cuisine made from old tea garden black tea and seasonal fruits and vegetables. Our specialty milk tea blends the fragrance of milk and tea, refreshing without being overly sweet, and goes well with our handmade cookies and black tea cheesecake. Black Tea Workshop is a place that will leave wonderful memories! This is Black Tea Workshop! A small, warm, beautiful, carefree place!

Hotels.Description: Nestled along the coast of Zhuangwei Township in Yilan, 9G Love Ocean Villa is conveniently located less than 1 kilometer from several top attractions, including Lanyang Animal and Botanical Kingdom, Zhuangwei Sand Dunes Visitor Center, Yi Qi Yuan Ranch, Zhuangwei Beach Swings, and Yongzhen Seaside Park. It’s also just a 16-minute drive to the popular Luodong Night Market. The villa offers free parking in front of the property, suitable for tour buses or 4–9 cars, and receipts are available—making it ideal for families, student groups, or corporate outings, whether arriving by car or bus.Although the villa consists of two separate buildings—the Main House and Windmill House—they are rented together as one exclusive booking, with only one group hosted at a time, ensuring privacy and a relaxed experience.There are 17 rooms in total, including: 1 single room (shared bathroom), 1 double room (shared bathroom), 9 double suites, and 6 quadruple suites. Rooms are allocated based on the group size, and unused rooms are securely locked.The base occupancy is 28 people, but the villa can accommodate up to 65 guests with extra beds. Facilities include a spacious 25-ping (approx. 82 sqm) outdoor BBQ area with sunshade and restrooms, a kitchen, KTV karaoke system, electric mahjong table, free Wi‑Fi, as well as baby-friendly items like a bathtub, bottle sterilizer, and bed rails. With its proximity to the beach and multiple attractions, Love Ocean Villa is a perfect choice for family-friendly and pet-friendly group stays in Yilan.Rates start at NT$22,000 per night on weekdays (up to 28 guests) and NT$28,000 on weekends (up to 28 guests). Official receipts are available. This villa is highly recommended for family reunions, class gatherings, and company retreats looking for a spacious and private getaway.shared kitchen, coffee machine, and Wi-Fi. It’s also a pet-friendly accommodation, welcoming furry companions for a cleaning fee of NT$1,000 per pet—making it one of the top choices for private pet-friendly stays in Yilan.

Hotels.Description: Yilan｜Meishiou B&B A Fairytale-Like Carpenter’s HouseWhite clouds drift through the clear, blue Yilan skies as you sing a song and stroll along the country lanes. Suddenly, you hear the energetic barking of a little dog. A little black and white Chihuahua stares at you with its sparkling big eyes. Behind it, a three-level building painted in off-white and brown comes into view. Welcome to Meishiou B&B!Countryside memoirs of a happy encounter with woodPushing open the low, wooden gate, you enter a garden filled with lush and vibrant flowers and plants. Red dragonflies accompany you down the crushed stone pathway right up to the front door. On the veranda, you find a sturdy wooden shoe cabinet above which a blackboard has been colorfully decorated with the words “Meishiou B&B: lodging, woodworking, playful life.” You open the door to a room full of richly colored wooden furniture, giving the interior the feeling of a small forest. Lifting your head, you see a beautiful scene of blue sky and green trees out the window, and you feel as if you’ve entered the home of a fairytale elf!This fairytale-like home and all the beautiful furniture within is a product of the hard work of your hosts. The doghouse in the entrance is your hostess Meishiou’s first woodworking project, to create a warm little corner for her beloved dog, Bogi. She has since transformed herself into a stylish female carpenter! She dragged Piety, who loves DIY projects, into her plan, to become her number-one helper. Piety’s passion for carpentry, however, originates from his inherent desire to get his hands on everything around him. He once even helped SGS to do inspection work! Eventually, they built a tiny woodworking shop behind their house, helping to establish their dream home. A cozy, warm woodworking shop, a miniature tri-color fairytaleGoing up stairs, you see Meishiou’s creativity in the natural tri-color decor: red, blue, and green. Each room seems to embody its own miniature fairytale. The first page of the tale tells the story of a sunflower growing up in a safflower garden. With multi-colored pillows and tender-colored walls, the “Red Warmth Room” is a little paradise just for you and your furry friend, set up to give you the most delightful experience before settling in for bed.The second page of the tale tells of an elf’s fantasy adventure in the green forest. The “Green Forest Room” is the only four-person room at Meishiou B&B, serving as the perfect secret base for you and your friends to share a vacation together. A red dinosaur dangling from a floating balloon drifts up near the ceiling, the clock on his belly tick-tocking away as if to suggest that this is the moment for a joyous adventure to begin!On the third floor, you open the third page of the tale, where a mermaid princess shares her story about the world beneath the sea. The “Blue Waters Room” has an elevated wooden floor with a row of tall blue waves for bed headboards. This room has the only bathtub, and it’s pink, like a romantic blessing from the mermaid princess.A fairytale home converging with real lifeIn the morning, you walk out onto the balcony, take a deep breath of that fresh, clean Yilan air, and catch a whiff of a delicious breakfast cooking! Soy milk, a fresh fruit and vegetable salad, mashed potato balls, soft-boiled eggs, and perfectly toasted bread combine for a simple yet perfectly energizing breakfast. If you’re intrigued by Meishiou and Piety’s woodworking life, you can book a seat in Friday’s woodworking course for a chance to hammer around with Meishiou in the workshop! Different than your standard carpentry course, Meishiou enjoys using love to create woodcrafts with her guests. Piety humorously refers to their workshop as their “delivery room” where you can experience with your own hands the satisfaction of creating things from wood.The warm feeling inside the house is just like the interaction between Meishiou and Piety – comfortable and cozy. When they met each other, one had just completed a job, while the other had fallen in love with hiking as a way of coping with a break up. They began hiking, fishing, and bicycle-riding together - they’ve even conquered half of the hundred highest peaks in Taiwan. Having an unspoken understanding of one another, they began to construct their guesthouse together. They’ve been through a lot in their countryside life; even though Piety recently fell seriously ill, the illness was unable to defeat them as they faced it with unyielding optimism. This fairytale-like home is not simply a physical building. Even more so, Meishiou B&B is a product of the charisma of its hosts.

Hotels.Description: Hotel HistoryRespond to the twenty first century tourism development movement, Ministry of Transportation & Communications developed on Twenty First Century Taiwan Tourism Strategy, and created a high quality sightseeing environment concentrate in local community, ecological community, and variety as the main principal. To continue promote tourism, the Executive Yuan Tourism Development Team appointed Chiayi County government and Tourism Bureau to carry out the scenic resource investigation and management arena agenda for Ali Mountain region. In March 2001, Ministry of Transportation & Communication completes the grade review as national class scenic area and declared management region. In the same year, established National Scenic Area Administration Office in Mt. Ali on July 23rd. On September 4th, President Chen came in person for the grand opening.Story of DevelopmentEight years ago, government operated Alishan House entrusted Chao-Li Hotel Management Advisory Company for business management. Afterwards, Alishan House has obvious improvements in hotel amenities, and became the five-star holiday hotel at highest altitude in Taiwan.Future PerspectiveChao-Li Hotel Management Advisory Company officially contracted with Forestry Bureau in December 2004, and obtained the first non-governmental investment BOT case qualification from Forestry Bureau. Chao-Li Hotel Management Advisory Company anticipate to build a five-star holiday hotel at the current address in approximately two years, and expand it to 150 guestrooms with plenty facilities upon completion. Once again, push Mt. Ali to be the best sightseeing region in Taiwan.

Hotels.Description: New Shui Diao Ge Tou B&B  Traditional-Style Taiwanese Building is a large traditional residence featuring a traditional layout, “11 Support” style structure with 11 pillars, and front and rear sections connected on the left and right sides. It was built by Huang Sunzhang around the turn of the 20th century. The Kinmen National Parks of Taiwan had the land rights for 30 years and renovated the building before turning it over to be privately operated as a B&B. New Shui Diao Ge Tou Bed & Breakfast took its name from a famous poem by Su Dongpo as well as its location by the water. It has 7 rooms; 4 of the rooms have upper attics and can accommodate 2-4 people, while the 3 rooms on the right side are doubles which can accommodate 14-22 people. The overall design combines traditional building features with bright, clean modern suite rooms, making this a warm, comfortable B&B. Here you can experience the wisdom and charming layout of Kinmen’s old buildings, as well as a sense of spiritual fulfillment. These old buildings have a long and colorful history; the weathered stone slabs have stood firm against the test of time and the mottled red bricks and tiles still shine after a long rain. Life is to be celebrated and cherished! Share a moment of peace and quiet with family and friends, and hold it as a beautiful, lasting memory – this is the sublime power of our traditional-style B&B. Welcome to Shuitou No. 35 Bed & Breakfast! Location: Shang Yi Airport – Zhong Yang Road – left at Jin Cheng Roundabout – right at Bei Ti Road – left at Wu Jiang Bridge – go straight till Shuitou Community – go straight at the Kaoliang Liquor Mark (behind the Deyue Tower), and we are on the left, after about 12 minutes. No. 6 or No. 7 bus from Jin Cheng Station, get off at Shuitou Roundabout.

Hotels.Description: Introduction of Ji-Yue VillaJiu-Zhou Lake is a quiet and secluded mountain settlement, and later the Agriculture Committee has promoted the "Rich Countryside" project, and developed the mountain settlement into a combination of agriculture and tourism leisure area. The original environment is a beautiful mountain and river condition, and has been improved with recreational facilities of trails, pavilions and landscape table. The local farmers have set up sightseeing orchards and Hakka restaurants. With these preparation, Jiu-Zhou Lake is expected to become a popular leisure area.  There are three hiking trails in the Jiu-Zhou Lake area, namely, "Jiu-fu", "Guan- Nan" and "Ji-Yue". Hiking trails can be found in the mountain and the lake area. Three trails have been planned with stone steps, red brick, or sleepers. The trails are also wide and safe to walk freely. People can absorb the natural phytoncide for about two hours while walking these three trails among the old acacia trees, suitable leisure trails for young and old people as well as children.   "Ji-Yue Villa" becomes famous because it is close to Ji-Yue trail. People can come to Ji-Yue Villa from Ji-shan Bridge of Jiu-fu road along the river with bald pines planted by the Soil and Water Conservation Bureau. The bald pines have different color in four different seasons. The scenery is especially beautiful in the winter like the northland style bleak landscape. The residence also retains the traditional Hakka red brick house, part of the villa is currently open for the accommodation and resting place of tourists. Allegedly, the children of the original house owner are very smart with good school grades. Currently, they are very successful in the education sector and hold high work positions in the academia circle. This house is built facing the mountain with river and backing mountain geographical location, the so called good Feng-Shui pattern " Jade Belt Waist ", and this house is also called "Champion Home" by the local people. This house retains the ancient hakka kitchen stove that worships the traditional Chinese gods called "Stove God". When visitors arrive at the "Ancient House", they are greeted with a row of red brick and tile-roofed house. Walking red brick on the floor, the visitors will experience the sense of the past. Under the hundred-year lychee tree in the courtyard, tourists can rest and chat. In the manor, there are several old camphor trees that are extremely large and precious old trees.The green grass is planted in the garden and there is a "Big Fish" in the form of a fish pond, where the carps swim in fish pond and the wood flooring platform is the best view of the beautiful scenery and the bald pines. It is also possible to gaze at “South Park”from the manor, a good recreational activity venue for the group tourists to dance and sing songs. It is like a paradise and it is  also a wonderful choice for vacation and relaxation.Service Items:1. Accommodation2. Mountaineering Trip Planning (Itinerary Tour)3. Order the Restaurant Services (Liu Stew Chicken, Chen Farm Restaurant, and Catering Service) for the Tourists4. Group Activities Arrangements (Package for Karaoke Singing)5. Meeting Arrangements

Hotels.Description: Located in Beitou high ground, neighboring Yangmingshan National Park, overlooking the Danfeng mountains, embracing Datun Mountains, Grand View Resort Beitou enjoys "mountain, water, heaven, earth." The hotel was designed by the architect CY Lee. The building utilized wood and stone materials, supplemented with titanium metal and natural plantings, to infuse cleverly architectural concepts into the precious natural landscapes, presenting the deeply introverted, timeless, refined, extraordinary qualities ofa combination of natural and human world. Unlike other services and design of Japanese-style spa hotel, Grand View Resort Beitou emphasizes on Taiwanese-style services and the concept of making the best out of local materials to blend architectural aesthetics with accommodation, leisure, food culture, bathing enjoyment, and many other elements into every corners of the hotel, hoping to convey the beauty and charm of Taiwan and Beitou to all guests visiting the hotel, bringing travelers rich humanities and the natural flavor of the leisure space. The hotel offers a total of 66 top-level rooms, Chinese and Western restaurants, 24 hours concierge, eight private baths, open-air baths, Le Spa, and many other services. When you are in the hotel you will feel like wandering in the most beautiful vacation paradise. Each room has more than 16 pings (floor area) of private space with a great mountain view, allowing you enjoy the most comfortable leisure environment, why you are staying in your room. Chinese Cuisine and Western European Restaurants select certified local fresh ingredients, and our chefs magically prepare specialty cuisine stunning your visual and taste buds to make eating an aesthetic attitude. The hotel's bathing enjoyment planning is definitely worth tasting. The intimate space surrounded by mountains, and the warm, moist, nourishing white sulfur springs is one of the four largest white sulfur springs in the world. Grand View Resort Beitou perfectly presents you so beautiful realm to allow your body, mind, and soul to be completely returned to zero and relaxed.

Hotels.Description: Entering Sun Moon Lake, I find it hard not to be attracted by the lake water and the mountain scenery; I am here with an empty mood to accept all freshness, nature, beauty and romance here, where I will record into my travel log for memory in the future. I am enjoying everything that is refreshing on this vast land, which is not very far away, I am at… Flora Villa-Rexort. Flora Villa-Rexort at Sun Moon Lake has an elevated design for the lounge to create an aristocratic manner, the super large field of vision straight to the second floor and the enlarged stylish French window allows you to embrace all scenery indoor and outdoor with a broad sight; the perfect combination between the majestic ambience created by the elegant decorative lighting, the beautiful temperament introduced by the white gauze curtains, the meticulously selected furniture and spacious space not only demonstrates the owner’s unique ideas, but further easily brings the travelers coming from afar to a better quality hotel taste. Hotels.Description: Fu Ren Bed & Breakfast is a stone building nearly 80 years old. On October 15, 2003, the owner bought a NT$20 sickle and cut a basket-size bundle of grass by the stairs in front of the building. Thick wild grass and many large trees obstructed views of the building and prevented such this great construction project from being completed. So he called home and told his parents about the situation, asking them to come to Matsu and help renovate the old structure. It was very hard work, but his parents showed their love by helping and supporting him through the entire process. Their persistence and dedication transformed the old building, which now shines with a warm atmosphere, featuring stairs, curves, waving grass, and flowers. We would like to thank many people for making this possible. The building’s beauty is really unbelievable, and there is not a single nail to be found in the internal wood structure. The building is also well-situated, facing Fu-Ao Wharf, from where one can see little white boats traveling between the islands during the day and the most beautiful sights in the evening, including the moon in the middle of the month. The best part is relaxing either in the outdoor area or inside and listening to the sound of crashing waves! Flowers of all colors make their appearances by season, butterflies dance in the wind, and carefree birds fly overhead. Spring brings romance, summer passion, autumn beauty, and winter serenity, and the beauty of it all touches the heart! We’ve prepared a lucky key to open the door to your emotions. Stay in a traditional stone house, embrace the ocean, and enjoy the sunrise in the morning and waves during the day. The sea is right at your doorstep! Fu Ren Bed & Breakfast is the most convenient place to eat, stay, and travel! Natural scenery and a beautiful environment provide your very own place of peace and quiet!

Hotels.Description: Dreaming of life on the Farm? Many people may fantasize about living in the country, but only a very few ever get around to living the pastoral life a reality.Chuo Chen Ming had her epiphany 30 years ago on the eve of her 40th birthday. “If I don’t begin working on my dreams while my mind and body are at their peak,” she thought, “when am I going to do it?” Soon after, she was crossing hill and dale with a real estate agent haunting for the perfect place. When she found it at the mountains of Kengfeng village at Toucheng Township, Yilan County, she spent all of the more than NT$5 million she had earned from her garment factory and teaching, to buy it. Thus begun what was to become the legendary story of the farming Grandma. “Look, children!” exclaims Chuo Chen Ming, “That’s our national bird, the Formosa blue magpie. They’re very family-oriented birds. After the chicks grow up, they help their parents raise their younger siblings”. She then leans forward to make sure she doesn’t miss any of the questions coming from the large group of children before her.Her eyes and ears are surprisingly sharp in spite of her 68 years- there’s no movement in the forest that escape her notice. Visitors to the Toucheng Leisure Farm in Yilan County, all remember the grandmotherly old woman who pops up in the Farm. Always bursting with energy, she is happy to share her opinions with visitors, including her insistence that the farm grow its food organically, and prepare it in a traditional fashion. Her personality is so warm and frank that visitors almost always end up addressing as “Mama Chuo” regardless of their own age. Chuo Chen Ming was born in Chingshui Township, Taichung County, Taiwan in 1940. After graduating from The Taipei Women’s Normal College, (now the Taipei Municipal University of Education), she began working as a teacher primarily of sixth graders.

Hotels.Description: ★Monet Garden—Don Gus Coffee Farm is the main agency for the renowned Balanjoyo Coffee. With top quality coffee beans imported directly from the volcano district in Guademala, Mr. Chang as the farm owner brews limited amount daily. Therefore, the entire farm manifests mysterious atmosphere integrating Latino romance and Mayan magic. The setting of Central American Tropical Forest is decorated with numerous artifacts from Mayan ruins. Even furniture is handmade by Mayan workers, while bed cover is made from the most famous Mayan textile.   ★Such a unique style combining Latino romance and Mayan magic can only be represented via techniques of the impressionist school. Mr. Chang and his son who majored in architecture present natural simplicity with joint efforts so that aesthetic elegance is distributed via impressionist approach. Of course, a water lily pond is established here to elicit reminiscence of the famous painting by Claude Monet. Our farm is named as Monet Garden for this reason.  ★The farm has rich natural ecosystems. Visitors inadvertently encounter a variety of lizards, stag beetles, and rhinoceros beetles here. Dragonflies, butterflies, Gunder brown frogs come back every spring and summer. In front of the Mayan Suite, there is a waterway, derived from the mountain creek, zigzagging into the water lily pond. Five generations of kois and Chinese sturgeons live in the water lily pond along with many other fishes from mountain creeks riding currents down here as passers-by.   The geese couple, Pipi and Yaya, are the most welcome ambassadors of goodwill. They greet people with passion. Another pair of Japanese rooster and hen stroll leisurely to seek feed. With the advent of night, you can sit on the stairway of the Monet Chicken Farm to appreciate the scene with bird species flying on top of the trees to rest in sleep.  ★Located to the north end of East Rift Valley, Carp Like has abundant picturesque natural ecosystems. From March to May every year, tourists flock here to view fireflies. ★A five-kilometer trip around the lake by bike or on foot is full of joy. So is sitting in the pagoda next to the lake with your heart and mind totally relaxed. Swinging on the lake by peddling a boat or shaking a canoe is fun as well. Scenic Spots Nearby:★White Abalone River and Gems Canyon----You can explore in stream-tracing, wade into the clear water, pick up gems, or follow the forest trail all the way to the Woods of Green Light in quest of natural ecosystems. ★Mukumugi Ecological Garden----It is Toroko Gorge in miniature. As you wade into the creeks, schools of shoveljaw carps will play with you by licking your soles. ★South Lake Forest Park----Formerly Harlem Forest with papaya trees all over, the Park now has an exhibition hall as well as an ecological classroom. The mini-rail which used to distribute logs has long discontinued. Strolling among the remaining rail tracks, you will be surrounded by chirping birds and fragrant flowers as Carp Lake mirrors your reflection. ★Carp Hill Hiking Trail----Stepping on the observatory six-hundred kilometers in height, you can view Mount Chilai in the north from afar. Winter will decorate the hilltop with snow. And the blue Pacific is visible at the east side.  ★From Monet Garden to downtown Hualien is an easy ride of approximately twenty minutes. All the main scenic areas are within half-hour ride by car.

Hotels.Description: Repeats Line 52-59!!! This is a very special B&B. Its open-structured and permeable decoration is full of art spirit, showing the style of fashion and indicating the freedom and lifestyle. Surprisingly, the B&B host, Mr. Dai, is a young and cheerful man, and his friends call him Dai. He is fond of individual travel,and occasionally saw loft-style B&B's when traveling abroad. The open-structured space with no partitions and freestyle design had attracted his attention. He started to have a dream. It is hard to imagine that this humorous and friendly young man was a perfect sales with outstanding performance in Banking Enterprises. However, his life was filled with works. He worked for long hours and engaged in social parties, and often came back home at late night. He suddenly realized that what he was missing when seeing his children slept soundly. At last, when he was 40, he made an important decision - getting retirement. He found his own way after tendering the resignation letter. He desired to make his dream come true. What he saw abroad affected him and made him eager for action, and he started to make plans. He wanted to bond with his children when it was not too late, let them grow up in a great environment, and realize his dream - running a special B&B. After thinking carefully, he settled down in Hualien - the most beautiful area in Taiwan. He spent two years completing his own buildings- from design and plan to selecting materials and constructing, and he gradually completed the perfect B&B in his mind. He owned two buildings for the B&B. Building A, with dark red brick walls, vintage electric fans, obvious pipelines and log doors, makes you go back to the 1950s. Building B, with black iron partition cabinet, leather sofa and glossy floor, shows an ornate style to make you feel like displaced in time and place. There is no special B&B like Ji Ye Jing Zhan Villa Homestay in Taiwan. Dai hopes that travelers can experience the happiness he had experienced before as long as they visit Hualien- no flight ticket, not going abroad, and no tiring flight.

Hotels.Description: Shuaige Farmhouse B&B is part of the Lu surname village in Liujiao Township. It's part of a hundred-year-old courtyard house belonging to the Lu family that was once occupied by five extended families. As the family grew, many of them moved away to make a living and only the third son's family was left to take care of the traditional Taiwanese ancestral property. This house went from being a traditional acestral property to a leisure B&B business, which became known as Shuaige Farmhouse. As our guests increased in number, the thought of turning the house into a legally operated business came to mind, simply because it was not a good idea to leave it vacant. Coincidentally, the government was  promoting tourism in the area, so an application was submitted to legalize the operation. Though we faced many obstacles such as legal issues and land use rights, we were finally certified to operate our business. No. 57 Shuaige Farmhouse B&B gradually spread its name through word-of-mouth and internet marketing.                                                                                                                                  A trip is often memorable when you remember the hospitality, safety and cleanliness of the place you stayed at. Our mission is always to serve our customers with honor. We hope to see you soon at Shuaige Farmhouse B&B.

Hotels.Description: Evergreen Laurel Hotel (Taipei) is a luxury yacht-themed 5-star hotel, stationed in the capitol like a great ship. The area was once the headquarters of the Evergreen Marine Corporation, and the hotel is now situated in the financial and economic center of Taiwan, frequented by politicians, business leaders, and celebrities. Come for a stay and plan your grand strategy for seizing economic opportunity. The inside of the building is filled with ocean-themed designs and a variety of ship models and valuable items, including oars, door handles, anchors and ornamental borders on the walls, a wave-shaped ceiling, 19th century paintings of the River Thames, and Swarovski crystal decorations across the ceiling, creating the feeling of riding a luxurious yacht across the wide ocean. Looking out at the sky, you can feel Evergreen Laurel Hotel’s deep connection to the sea. 95 spacious, comfortable, luxurious suites and rooms are designed and decorated at luxury yacht scale, featuring Italian nationally-acclaimed Dubini furniture, 24K gilded wash basins handmade by Dutch masters, Japanese-style bidet toilets, supersonic massage tubs, triple layer sound-proof glass, special service buttons, all-in-one printers, 42-inch TVs, and wireless communication systems. The hotel includes the Garden Hall, serving a variety of fine foods and beverages, the coffee shop and Evergreen Passage, and another large hall providing diners with a chance to enjoy Western and Eastern cuisine. Famous chefs prepare delicious, fragrant, colorful dishes, giving diners a taste of their expertise; this exquisite cuisine is not to be missed. Recreational facilities include a fitness center and spa, another serene paradise to relax your mind and body. Website: http://www.evergreen-hotels.com/branch/taipei

Hotels.Description: Wang Yougu Bed & Breakfast sits next to the Jiufen River in verdant mountainous foothills. With just a 10-minute stroll, you can reach the popular trail, a walk back into the days of Jiufen’s gold rush. From the homestay you can look out over Jiufen, and Mt. Keelung, and whether by day or by night, it’s a spectacular sight. A renovated building built in the traditional stone style of the area, Wang Yougu’s renovations are our own handiwork, with every tile and stone personally laid. We’re born and bred Jiufen residents, and as such have a strong connection to the area and are invested heart and soul in providing a homestay experience you’ll love. Every room has its own table and chairs to relax at, with the interior design our own work; we hope you’ll enjoy your stay with us! If you arrive in the afternoon, you can head down from Songde Park to Jiufen Old Street and while away the hours in the old-fashioned surroundings at one of the excellent tea houses or cafés, and in the evening you can watch the stars in our yard, relaxing before a good night’s sleep, then wake up to a home-cooked breakfast. Then, full of vim and vigor, you can travel out to Jinguashi, visit the Gold Park, or go for a hike up Mt. Keelung or along the northeast coast. We have three rooms in different styles—a Japanese tatami room, a “blue ocean” room, and a “pastel romance” room. Each comes equipped with its own bathroom and free snacks, including candy, cookies, instant noodles, water, and drinks — perfect for that midnight snack! The usual fee is NT$1500 (Sunday-Thursday), with weekends and holidays NT$2000. Extra beds can be provided for NT$300 a person, up to a maximum of two additional people.

Hotels.Description: Miaoli｜House of Tung FlowersWhite snow in a mountain forest; the delight of Tung flower landFollowing Provincial Highway Six up into the mountains, you breathe the sweet, clear air of Miaoli County. Turning down a winding mountain road, you see a flurry of snow-like Tung flowers - the so-called May Snows. Trees encompass the road from both sides as you approach your beautiful mountain destination - House of Tung Flowers. Between the elegance of nature and the deliciousness of exquisitely prepared meals, you savor the taste of happiness.Afternoon tea in the mountains beneath the Tung treesThe layered green landscape of House of Tung Flowers unfolds before your eyes, with a lofty tung tree standing directly in the middle of the gardens, quietly extending its branches to bathe in the warm sunlight. You set out across a wooden pathway strewn with Tung flowers and resembling snow-covered ground, and stroll between the Tung, Phoebe zhennan, umbrella, and camellia assamica trees. The mountain breeze rustles the tree leaves as the sounds of insects and birds enters your ears, uniting into a lively forest concerto.In the afternoon, you enter the glass-walled tea room, with light spilling in from all sides. To one side sits a dessert cabinet full of sweets from the famous RT Bakery House. Have as much as you like, along with hot tea and coffee. Seated indoors or out, the scenery is beautiful any season of the year, not just during the Tung flower season. In spring, fresh emerald-green leaves sprout all around. In summer, the tung trees produce a snow of white flowers. In autumn, the maples shine red in the forest. And in winter, the mountain forests are shrouded in clouds and mist.Resting between fragrant trees, taste a creative, menu-free Hakka-style mealStepping into the three-story building, the scent of Chinese fir filling the entire space relieves your exhausted mind. At House of Tung Flowers, the furnishings in each room are made of solid wood, accentuated with exquisite antique lamps, and include a capsule coffee machine and complementary RT Bakery House cookies. The interior design includes Japanese tatami mats as well as wooden rocking chairs, with large windows that afford beautiful views of the mountain forests. You can sit on the balcony and breathe phytoncides from the comfort of hanging chairs, or soak in the bathtub to completely relax. With a maximum capacity of 20 people, House of Tung Flowers is well-suited for a family or a group of friends to reserve the entire wooden structure. With karaoke in the first floor common room and a small living room on the third floor where family and friends can play chess or chat with each other.A one night stay includes three meals, yet the thing most anticipated by visitors to House of Tung Flowers is the menu-free fusion dinner incorporating local ingredients and traditional Hakka flavors. Red date vinegar is used to start the meal off, followed by lotus root wrapped in the sweetness of Hakka-style grass jelly made of Chinese mesona. A bamboo steamer full of fresh seasonal vegetables with homemade kumquat sauce satisfies all the senses. A uniquely flavored bean curd chicken soup, served with crisp bread stuffed with Italian rice-flour noodles emits distinct Italian aroma. The sweet fish imparts the fresh sweetness of the sea, while the broiled Japanese beef (wagyu) simply cannot be missed. Finally, enjoy a bite of delicate almond tofu and a glass from host James’s private wine collection to bring your beautiful evening to a close. In contrast with one’s impression of the usual fixed villa menu, the food at House of Tung Flowers employs meticulous western-style techniques and the ingenious fusion of Hakka cuisine and Taiwanese ingredients to bring to each traveler an elegant and refined dining experience. James - promoting Taiwan’s tung flower season for the appreciation of the entire worldIn the morning, the mountain breeze urges you toward the breakfast table, where yet another sumptuous meal is laid out. Many summers ago, James decided to open his family home up to the public, to share the beautiful scenery with travelers by opening a guesthouse. The Hakka Affairs Council seized the opportunity to promote the Hakka tung flower season to attract large quantities of tourists, during which time House of Tung Flowers operates at full capacity every single day. Today, James has a full head of gray hair, yet in those first days, he truly was a pioneer, leading the way in the tung flower tourist market. With his endless Hakka passion and hospitality, he has been a great advocate of tung flower tourism during the month of May. Who would guess that he grew up in the Ximending neighborhood in Taipei! Yet he had always hoped to one day live in the tranquility of nature. Upon entering society, he continued his father’s construction business. At the turn of the millennium, in a time when many people could not even recognize a tung tree, he had come to admire the largest tung tree in Taiwan, right here beside House of Tung Flowers. He built his guesthouse and launched his one night, three meals slow living holiday package so that travelers can live in the mountains, and enjoy the tung flowers and delicious food. “Taiwan has many qualifications which surpass those of other countries, so we need to look at things from a new perspective, drawing in a tide of tourists from abroad, in order for Taiwan to build confidence!” With his warmth and sincerity, James invites travelers from around the world to come to this tranquil forest, to enjoy the tung flowers fluttering on the May breeze, like beautiful snow swirling in the air, and savor the taste of a truly happy vacation.

Hotels.Description: Enjoy the relaxation and serenity of a harbor community and experience the limitless fun of a fishing village. Dongshih (Dongshi), the “township of three colors,” is a mixture of green, blue, and gray viewed from a distance and includes eight unique scenic sites and eight natural ecological sites, while the authentic seaside community provides a diverse travel experience. Try out the plump and crispy sweet Dongshih oysters, be a part of the Dongshih fish market, bustling with the sounds of vendors, and visit the Aogu wetland, Waisanding Sand Bar, the natural ecology display center…fully experience the unending charm of this little seaside community. Chuanzaitou Homestay located in Chuanzaitou, Dongshih Township, Chiayi County, was the first legally certified bed and breakfast in Chiayi. Located on the border between Dongshih Township, Puzih (Puzi) City, and Lioujiao (Liujiao) Township, Chuanzaitou was a place of beautiful childhood memories for Mr. Cai Zhencheng, the owner of the bed and breakfast. In order to introduce others to the beauty of this place, he and his wife returned to his hometown and established Chuanzaitou Homestay, promoting an outstanding in-depth cultural trip with package activities such as the Puzih Stream Levee Bike Trail and dragon boat rowing so that travelers may not only relax but thoroughly experience the carefree fun of the fields and fishing village. In addition to providing an outstanding, in-depth experience, Chuanzaitou offers a well-designed, warm, elegant, comfortable, bright, and secure resting place. During the day, take a in-depth tour of village experiences, such as the mangrove ecological area, Dongshih fishing wharf, and an ox-cart ride around the village, then spend the night at Chuanzaitou Homestay enjoying the peaceful countryside scenery and traditional three-section building compound and listening to the crickets. Bring the whole family!

We offer separate gardens and parking lots, two double rooms, two four-person rooms and a Japanese four-person room, in addition to an elevator, accessible ramps, and other facilities to make the stay of elderly and families with children more convenient, as well as a saloon for visitors to chat with friends and family leisurely and enjoy our offer of tea and snacks.  In the night, you may stroll to the famous Luodong Night Market, and after your return play XBOX with the whole family together, or exercise, enjoying the warmth of family time.  After a good night's sleep, you can enjoy a Chinese breakfast with local food ingredients carefully prepared by the proprietress in the restaurant under the sunshine. After breakfast, you can ride a bicycle provided by the Jinzhuya Homestay to the nearby Dongshan River. Along the riverbank, you enjoy the scenery and river views of the Long Yang countryside, slowing down to experience the Lohas tour, away from the hubbub.

Hotels.Description: Olive Tree Farm is a Bed & Breakfast/coffee shop in the valley. With attention-catching European countryside architecture, located away from the noise and pollution of the city in a quiet corner of Xinshe District, the air is filled with a pleasant atmosphere, because this is a dream garden. The idea for the farm was born when Mr. Fu, the current owner, was a young boy. Playing with other children under an olive tree, he was inspired to build a house underneath it, and this dream stayed with him for the next 30 years until the spring of 2004, when the restaurant was completed. In the summer of 2008, the Bed & Breakfast was completed, finally realizing his dream. There’s no interference from work here, just birds and insects to keep you company, a soft breeze blowing by, and beautiful scenery. Are you searching for a spiritual garden? Take a seat here on the mountaintop. The Bed & Breakfast is a European countryside-style wooden house built against the mountain in a wide open area where you can sit and watch the clouds roll by. Some days there isn’t a cloud in sight, and the verdant mountains, green water, and pleasant, tranquil atmosphere transport you to the European countryside.

Hotels.Description: Bed and Breakfast in Pingtung CountyHomestays in Pingtung CountyKenting is a pearl located at the southernmost tip of Taiwan, shining brightly in the hearts of travelers. "Light Show" stands on the hill of Houbihu in Kenting. Designed by master architect Xu Chunyi, the gray building with a texture similar to exposed concrete shows a style that is integrated with the art of nature. The entire floor faces Houbihu Harbor, and when you open your eyes in the morning, you will be greeted by the clear blue of Kenting. The boundless sky, the ever-changing white clouds, and the charming sea. Just a quick glance can unload the burden of the city."Light Shows" Each room faces the sea and has different design features, from "Spring Light" to "Sunset Light", through "Time" to "Great Light". Travelers linger in the cozy home design of red bricks and slates, lie on the soft and comfortable big bed, listen to the whispers of the sea, embrace the starry sky, and spend a happy and wonderful holiday with family and friends.At "The-light", you can relax and do nothing, just lean lazily on a lounge chair and watch the changing seascape, which is sometimes like emerald and sometimes a mysterious blue. The sea talks silently to the travelers, slowly settling the random thoughts in their hearts. The shadows of the trees are swaying outside the window, and I am half-squinting my eyes to listen to the whisper of the sea breeze. Kenting blue gently illuminates your heart.The secret area of ​​Houbihu Lake, which is within a short stroll from "The-light", has a mysterious beach that stretches for several kilometers. Walking on the beach beside the sea, playing in the sand and watching the sunset recreate the beautiful memories with family and friends."The-light" wishes to make Kenting's sunshine and sea better for your life!

Hotels.Description: Welcome to Love River Inn!We are located in the prime area of Yancheng District, Kaohsiung, right by the Love River. Whether for leisure or business, we& #39;ve got you covered. Guests may also enjoy our complimentary self-service bar with coffee, tea, hot cocoa, snacks, and cereals, available 24 hours a day.We also provide family rooms and group accommodations. Groups of 12 to 18 people can book an entire floor with private access—ideal for family trips, reunions, or friends traveling together.Love River Inn is a fully non-smoking, legally registered hotel (Kaohsiung City Hotel License No. 532), ensuring safety and comfort for all our guests.Whether you& #39;re here for a delightful holiday or a well-deserved break from work, let us create a unique and comfortable stay for you. Book now and begin your journey of relaxation!

Hotels.Description: Taoyuan｜Before B&BThe intoxicating delight of lingering between booksIn open fields only an hour south of Taipei sits a small villa, which brings together books and fine beer. Sitting brightly under a blue sky, the amber colored building of Before B&B invites you to join in writing the story of your unrestrained journey.Sipping beer with your nose in a bookAs you enter Before B&B, sunlight streams through large windows and spills across the square pattern of the terrazzo floors. The uneven wooden bookshelves along both walls give the sensation of being in a forest where the trees have grown to varying heights. In this staggered forest, the treasures hiding between the trees are not birds’ nests, but rather the book collection of B&B host Danny, as well as his collection of craft beer! According to Danny, books are like friends who enrich our innermost selves, while beer is a good companion for pleasant worldly conversation. These two items appear to be unrelated, yet they are Danny’s indispensable life companions. So the first floor of Danny’s B&B is an independent bookstore that sells beer. This design is not for profit, but rather to satisfy Danny’s heartfelt desire for sharing his passions with others. “My B&B is a part of my life. It is an extension of me, so you have to appreciate my lifestyle to stay in my B&B.” Danny comes across as somewhat arrogant and proud, but after all, confidence comes from working hard at what you do. The moment his family decided to refurbish their aged courtyard home, the opportunity to create Before B&B was born. Black Forest is the name of the area were Before B&B is situated, while Before is actually a play on “b-four”, as in bed, breakfast, books, and beer - all delightful things which Danny just can’t wait to share with travelling guests. You may buy a book with which it was love at first sight, or perhaps a bottle of mouthwatering beer to pass a relaxing afternoon.Volume after volume recounting the collage of lifeHeading upstairs past walls lined with books, you discover that Before B&B is itself a colorful hardcover storybook, each page containing different scenery, as the names of the five guest rooms imply. Occasionally flipping this storybook open to the “life style” page, the central mountain range, however distant, appears right before your eyes. Occasionally opening it up to the “fiction & literature” section or the pages describing “indigenous literature” and light streams in through skylights, illuminating the split-level loft design of the B&B. Meanwhile, you share your discoveries with friends in the nooks beneath the stairs. The page of this B&B storybook about “travel & food” is the tender green color of a grassy field, the warmth of the sun and the specs of pink flowers accompany you in welcoming springtime. Meanwhile in the gosling-yellow story regarding “kids’ picture books” you and your friends have ample room to roll freely around like children on the two large double beds. Yet no matter which meticulously collaged page you open the Before B&B storybook to, it is sure to bring your imagined scenery to life.Discover story after brilliant storyStanding there in a simple t-shirt with a bottle of beer in hand, Danny looks just like the character Ling Hu-chong out of Jin Yong’s famous 1967 martial arts novel “Swordsman” who regarded the liquor in his cup as a lifelong friend. Most surprising, though, is that the practice to which he has devoted more than twenty years of his life is not what is in his cup, but rather what lies between the pages of his books! With a laugh, Danny proclaims, “Not a day goes by that I don’t read a book, nor a day when I don’t drink alcohol.” Danny exudes an open and generous humor, and is quite insistent on realizing the ideals he feels passionate about. Though it isn’t easy to operate a bookstore, he still hopes to use the magic of his shop to help people fall in love with reading. Even when work keeps him busy, whenever he meets a like-minded traveler, he’s more than willing to discuss books over bottles of beer all night long. Danny appreciates life and is apt to follow his whims, just like that free and easy character Ling Hu-chong, laughing his way through life.When you arrive at Before B&B, please remember to leave your hurried urban pace at the door, take the time to truly enjoy a good book, a bottle of beer, or an amusing phrase from your amiable host, Danny. Shouldn’t everyone’s life contain just this kind of carefree comfort? On this trip, you need not travel far, just a little to the south and you can find yourself in the midst of lush nature, fine literature, and craft beer. Put yourself in a holiday frame of mind, and enjoy the intoxicating delight of books and beer!

Hotels.Description: Formerly known as Wuzhou, Xianzhou, Wujiang, or Wu Island, Kinmen received its current name during the Ming dynasty, when one of the nobles built a city here. The name Kinmen, which means “Golden Door,” was derived from the island’s strategic location between Taiwan and mainland China. Surrounded by the sea, and it features rich cultural assets including old Taiwanese and Western buildings. The battle of Gu Ning Tou and 823 Artillery Bombardment left behind a wealth of war and military relics, the area has long been closed off and shrouded in mystery, and the well-preserved natural ecology is home to unique birds, making Kinmen a unique tourist destination. It gives off an impression of being a very foreign place with interesting military features, with a deeply friendly atmosphere even though separated from Taiwan only by a narrow strip of water. Don’t rely on your imagination, take a break and go on a backpack trip to Kinmen, where you can experience the culture and atmosphere firsthand. Feel its unrestrained passion. Let’s unveil this mystery together. We welcome you to Nobility Bed & Breakfast, a Baroque-style building backing the mountains and facing the sea, in a beautiful environment, equipped with a garden recreation deck and BBQ area.

Hotels.Description: The moment you walk through the doors of the Tempus Hotel, our staff will greet you with warm smiles and friendly service. With passion and sincerity, we strive to provide the best possible service to all of our guests from all corners of the globe. Our aim is to make your stay one marked by warmth, passion, gratefulness, and most importantly, joy.City and Resort: The Ultimate Relaxing Experience. Tempus comprises two buildings that each give guests a different accommodation experience: A, which combines pop styling with minimalist design, giving guests a clear, vibrant, northern European atmosphere; and B, where you can enjoy a more classical environment using high-quality stone and classy wood furniture, escaping the rat race of the city into an air of warmth and comfort. And out of consideration for vacationing families, in September 2011 Tempus opened the four-person-room-focused Da-Dun Building, offering 84 all-new rooms in a simple grey-white checkerboard motif with twin bathrooms with European baths and balconies adorned with greenery. Overall, these new offerings create a sense of total relaxation and feel like vacationing abroad.A Gourmet Combination of East and West. The Tempus offers both Chinese and Western restaurants to satisfy all kinds of appetites. Kenting Ali Seafood Restaurant’s flagship Taichung branch is located here, and the restaurant fields its own fleet of eight fishing boats to catch its own fresh fish. Master chef Li Wenzhan puts to use his 26 years of experience to create fresh dishes with a distinctively southern Taiwanese taste. La Mode Restaurant, headed up by chef Zhong Qingtian, offers European style cooking made with locally sourced ingredients, serving up international meals that are both spectacular and healthy. Between the combination of East and West, these restaurants make the Tempus a culinary landmark for central Taiwan.Balinese Relaxation in the Middle of the City. Located next to the Tempus is a large, freshly designed recreation center where guests can swim, sunbathe, or just enjoy the sunshine and breeze amongst the coconut trees. Guests at the Tempus have unlimited access to this center, and can freely take advantage of the gym, classes, and sauna for a taste of high-quality tropical relaxation in the middle of the city.
