Images.Name: 總統套房
Images.Description:
The 39F Presidential Suite, which is located at the top floor of guestrooms, occupies an area of 198㎡, is classically and elegantly decorated in the European and American styles. The whole suite is mainly divided into three zones: living room, dining room and master bedroom. All linear decorative boards in the suite are adorned with 24K bronzing varnish.

Living Room: The European imperial style living room adopts an elevated design of 6 meters, four magnificent crystal lamps are hung from the 6m high ceiling, while the embedded patterned floor at the entrance gives the room extra elegance. A TV with a 50” screen, a video player and recorder, as well as karaoke facilities with Automatic Music Select System and the function of keying in next 10 songs are equipped in the room. With the stereo system, you will feel like watching CDs in a cinema. 

Dining Room: The dining room with 3 French windows has a large wooden round table for over 10 people and a guest restroom to maintain the privacy of the host. There is also a wide range of facilities in the preparation zone. The curtain in the dining room has a remote control for guests to enjoy their meal and the spectacular harbor view of Kaohsiung city at the same time. 

Library: Fine antique furniture and ornaments have created a classical and elegant atmosphere. All solid wood furniture with painted patterns is made of red cedar from the Mainland. With solemn brick red chosen as the major color and imported chairs upholstered in light-colored jacquard fabric, the room is elegantly and innovatively designed. There is also a guest restroom and a cigar box (with a lighter) in the study for guests’ enjoyment. 

Bedroom: A King size double bed (190cm×200cm) and luxurious bed sets are in the master bedroom decorated in warm beige color. All the furniture is hand-made and the curtain has a remote control for guests to enjoy the spectacular view of Kaohsiung city from the 3 French windows. 

Bathroom: The bathing facilities include Jacuzzi, steam room, shower and electronic toilet bidet seat. After bathing, guests can enjoy sauna and relax in the Jacuzzi to experience VIP standard services. 

Other VIP services: (Flexibly offered in accordance with the need of guests) 
24hours butler services; gold plated stationery and name cards; bathrobe with personalized stamping and towel sets. 
Mutually accessible bedroom for bodyguards or personal helpers.

Hotels.Description: Qishan Sanheyuan B&B is a very distinctive ancient rural Sanheyuan building. It is located at No. 6, Zhongxing Street, Guangfuli, Qishan District, Kaohsiung City. Qishan is located in the center of Kaohsiung County and has always been the external transportation hub of Jiuxiang Town, Qishan District. You can drive there by yourself. It is very convenient to get to Qishan from the expressway. When passing the Zhongshan Expressway, you can get off at the Nanzi Interchange and take Qinan Highway directly to Qishan; or take the Zhongshan Expressway and connect to National Highway No. 10 and drive eastward, and turn right at the end of the national highway toward Ligang. There are signs for B&Bs on the road in the direction.   This hotel provides vacation and leisure breaks, allowing people to temporarily stay away from the hustle and bustle of the city, embrace nature and enjoy a quiet, leisure and comfortable life. There are many flowers and plants planted around the B&B for you to enjoy, and there is also a Happy Farm (real version) to experience rural life, where the landlady will teach you how to grow vegetables. , fruits..., it is a good place for the whole family to relax. Pets can be accommodated. You can take a walk on the river embankment to watch the sunset in the evening, and there is a barbecue area.  "Please inform us by phone in advance when bringing pets or using the barbecue area."    Our hotel provides free breakfast to hotel guests, Chinese style (rice porridge) and coffee. Please inform in advance if you want to eat vegetarian food.   In addition, instant noodles, drinks, and beer are sold... #Making tea (each set of tea sets is 500 yuan, including tea sets, tea leaves, and tea water), simple tea making is 150 yuan, and a bag of tea leaves is sold separately for 500 yuan. #Barbecue space and barbecue grills are provided free of charge. In addition, ingredients and charcoal are provided (please bring your own).  (Please call us if you want to use the barbecue area)

Hotels.Description: Yilan｜Sealuv HomestayThe Delightful Taste of The Deep Blue SeaComing out the other side of the Hsuehshan Tunnel, the world seems to become brighter the further you move away from Taipei city! On your way to the Wushi Marina, you roll down the window and look out to your right at the ocean. Amid the row of ocean-view guesthouses along Waiao Beach, you see a sign which reads “Enjoy Blue Paradise” on a wave-shaped white wall. Here in Toucheng Township of Yilan County, you’re always very close to the ocean!Make a beeline for the beach with the seawater and the sunshineEntering Sealuv Homestay from the back door, to one side, you notice a professional kitchen the likes of which is rarely seen in ordinary guesthouses. Not only is there a central food counter, they have a hotel restaurant grade oven and stainless steel freezer room. The spacious dining hall is painted white and blue in Greek style, and, overlooking Waiao Beach through the front doors, is filled with the sound of the waves breaking on the sand. Removing your shoes and walking upstairs, the guest rooms all bear the names of oceanside cities. The Greek Mykonos and Aegina rooms both employ a loft design, with comfortable sofas indoors and lounge chairs on the balcony for you to recline upon. The French Marseille and Balinese Kuta rooms employ a European South seas style decor to provide visitors with a peaceful vacation time.In contrast to this, the other Sealuv edifice employs a medieval Greek style. The Sun God Apollo room on the first floor has a wading pool from which you can admire the ocean. Indoors, you can enjoy the comfort of the steam room. Similar in layout, the Moon Goddess Diana room has a home theatre system in the living room, as well as a television in the bedroom. Entering the Goddess of Beauty Venus room from the back door, you can enjoy the expansive seaview from the balcony, and delight in watching the sunrise from the comfort of your bed. Yet the most breathtaking scene must surely be on the 65-inch liquid crystal display with full surround sound audio system furnishing the God of the Sea Poseidon room. From the balcony, take the staircase upwards and discover your own private outdoor pool.Every delicious mouthful is fresh from the seaAs every gourmand who travels to Sealuv Homestay surely knows, after night falls, you are in for a flavorful feast! Your host Brother Cong introduces each local ingredient and freshly caught seafood delicacy in detail. Flying fish caviar, whitebait, and seaweed prepared cold with special dressing taste sweet and refreshing. Then comes a plate of carefully selected sashimi from the local fish market, meticulously prepared sweet shrimp, neritic squid and the rare mackerel bonito served with special sauce gives the sensation that the ocean waves are dancing on your tongue. Gently steamed bowls of chawan mushi (savoury egg custard) with fresh prawns, clams, and broccoli harmonize perfectly with the delicious flavor of katsuobushi (dried skipjack tuna flakes). The main course is perfectly broiled red blowfish with a sprinkle of salt and pepper or shichimi spicing. Each bite of fish is bursting with zesty sweetness. Served with a bowl of stewed pork over rice and homemade daikon pickle, washed down with a bowl of warm ginger fish broth, and followed by a dessert consisting of coconut cream purple rice congee and a glass of white wine.Not only do you get to enjoy an evening banquet, you can savor a European style breakfast in the morning sunshine. A delicious breakfast embraced by the sea breeze provides the perfect start to a beautiful day. Your cordial host, Brother Cong, happily suggests a travel itinerary for you: the Lanyang Museum, followed by Toucheng old street and the paragliding base. And don’t forget the privately owned local restaurants.Enjoy a beautiful place to liveWhen Brother Cong was young, he left Yilan and moved to Sanchong in New Taipei City. Yet he always maintained an indescribable affinity for the Toucheng area and, at that time, he made a promise to his young self that he would one day return. In the year that the SARS epidemic broke out, the industry that Brother Cong worked in underwent massive changes. He suddenly found himself following a course which he had not planned but which somehow seemed perfectly arranged. Sometime before, he had seized the chance when housing prices were low to buy a house in Yilan in order to give his frequently ill son more opportunities to be close to nature. It suddenly occurred to Brother Cong that it would be best to return to Yilan and try his hand at opening a guesthouse. “First the guests benefit, then the locality benefits, and only afterwards do you yourself benefit.” According to Brother Cong, Sealuv Homestay isn’t just a guesthouse, it’s a place to appreciate life. From the very beginning, he went against local custom, constructing the main entrance facing the beach while the back door faced out onto the street. He was even ridiculed by his neighbors for this decision. Yet he was determined to place prime importance on the living environment and integrate it all with a gourmet restaurant. “Many people see operating a guesthouse as a part time business, a side job. In fact this is a kind of specialized occupation, in which there is much professional knowledge.” By nature, Brother Cong is very particular about the details. It was this character which allowed him to realize the vacation space of his dreams. He hopes that when you arrive, you’ll encounter Sealuv Homestay’s unique brand of happiness.

Hotels.Description: Located on the outskirts of Nantou City, A Peak, A Stay sits at the geographical center of Taiwan. It is just a 15-minute drive from the nearest freeway exit, making it an ideal venue for gatherings from all over the island. Popular tourist attractions such as Sunny Hills Pineapple Cake Museum, Zhongxing New Village, and the Sky Bridge are only a 10 to 15-minute drive away. Guests can admire panoramic views of the Central Mountain Range, Jiji Dashan, the Jioujiou Peaks, and Hehuanshan. At dawn, the 180-degree vista offers a breathtaking sunrise, as the golden sun rises above the mountains, casting brilliant light across the misty white sea of clouds — a sight so stunning it leaves visitors in awe.The homestay is located within a leisure farm in Nantou and is equipped with a multifunctional activity plaza, outdoor café seating, al fresco dining areas, large outdoor event spaces, an organic farming experience area, restaurant, observation deck, pavilion, DIY agricultural workshop facilities, ecological pond, barbecue and kiln-cooking zone, and an herb garden. With its wide range of recreational spaces and facilities, it’s perfect not only for couples and families seeking a countryside getaway, but also for organizations and large groups looking to host events and gatherings.

Hotels.Description: Penghu｜Summerya HouseA Place Overflowing With Sparkling Summer WatersCrossing the vast blue ocean, your boat anchors at Penghu island’s Magong Harbor. You set off along County Highway 203 for the distant city district in the north, eventually turning onto Township Road 11. Roll down the car window and let the blue sky and white clouds welcome you to the start of your journey. You arrive at Summerya House; a sunny-yellow vacation ground situated along the intertidal zone, where worries dissolve and summer cheer prevails.Inn dog and the tide: therapeutic and heartwarmingEntering the brilliant yellow building, the smile of your host Summer is as amiable as the summertime sun. Boss, the inn’s dog, circles your legs with a frisbee in his mouth, guiding you across the red-tile floor and by the solid wood table, after which you step into the sun-soaked backyard encircled by the tide. Boss runs excitedly across the lawn chasing the frisbee, you and he soaking in the ocean breeze as you chase each other around. In the sweltering afternoon, as the tide gradually rises, seawater covering the rocky seashore, Boss lazes around, too. As you sit in wooden chairs facing the ocean and listen to the burbling tide, you feel your own insignificance in the face of nature’s majesty. You also sense how fortunate you are; though you own nothing at all, at the same time, you have it all.Each room at Summerya has its own name, and each name reveals a little secret about this place. The Pure Sea Breeze room is located on the second floor and has ceilings just as lofty as the ocean winds. From the attached outdoor balcony, you have a clear view of the seaweed draped over the seaside rocks revealed by the receding tide, and the azure ocean waters at high tide. The Serene Starry Skies room also has a spacious balcony from which you might as well greet the evening stars, inviting you outside to take a stroll and enjoy the sparkling night sky. The Azure Seas room has an entire wall of floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the ocean. The beautiful ocean vista will keep you captivated all night until the first rays of the new day sun appear over the horizon. The following morning, follow your nose to the breakfast table where two slices of perfectly toasted bread with ham and eggs, a crispy salad with rich dressing, and a fragrant cup of coffee are waiting to wake up your belly. The simple yet rich flavors provide the perfect start to the day.Heartfelt regard for this piece of land, this stretch of seaRecalling the first time she saw the original piece of land where Summerya House now stands, extroverted and lively hostess Summer makes a silly face and exclaims, “It was practically in ruins!” Summer’s hometown is in the Lugu township of Nantou county. Having grown up in the mountain forests, Summer had a kind of inexpressible yearning for island life. At 17, she had saved up enough money from her part-time jobs to take a trip to Penghu, and it was that visit which left an indelible impression on her. From then on, she would seize any chance she got to go relax on Penghu island. After starting to date host Michael, Summer dragged him over to visit her beloved island. Little did she know that for Michael, Penghu would also be love at first sight! The moment he was able to wrap up the business at hand, he unhesitatingly decided to move to Penghu, the place that both he and Summer were longing for, to start a new life together and construct the beautiful Summerya House.After operating Summerya House for exactly ten years, another place that they both really liked came up for sale, the place where Oasis Hotel now sits. When asked why they wanted to create Oasis Hotel, Michael gave a mysterious answer, “Operating guesthouses is a path of no return; once you’ve begun, you end up investing all of your resources.” Perhaps it is precisely their sincere love of this land, their high self-demands, and the pull of destiny that conspired to establish them in the life that they now find themselves.Their backs to the azure ocean as they share with us their ideas about operating guesthouses, Summer and Michael laugh in unison when they get to the happy moments and listen attentively to each other when discussing the times things didn’t go as intended. Their seemingly very different personalities tacitly complement one another on account of their mutual love. In the same way, coming to Penghu from the distant main island of Taiwan, their love of the place has crystalized into the two guesthouses known as Summerya House and Oasis Hotel.Remembering the embrace of the ocean vista and the bustling journeySummerya House is like a benevolent friend who is always there to listen to your troubles and to share in your happiness. Sometimes there are layers of shape-shifting clouds, at others a vast, serene body of water. No matter if it’s early morning or late evening, no matter which season it may be, they always have a new and beautiful surprise for you. Coming to Summerya House, it’s best to bring your most sincere state of mind, and you are sure to forge a wonderful friendship!

Hotels.Description: Promisedland Resort in Hualien is positioned to promote the concept that "Instead of rushing about, to stay is the ideal vacation; instead of following a schedule, it is to stroll ..." Accordingly we built a canal-style resort, which the respectable "100 Hotels + Resorts" magazine recognized the Promiseland as the only resort from Taiwan to be among the world's top 29 hotels in Asia, such as Grand Hyatt Bali, Hilton Sanya Resort, as a destination to lift one's spirit. The world's longest original artificial hotel canal of 2.2 km long, designed by the world's top-ranked international architectural design team W. A. T. & G., runs through the resort and passes through seven docks, 16 charming bridges, and 22 villa style landscape architectures. One after another, Spanish style low rise castles were built along the river, based on the legendary Spanish architect Gaudi's architectural concepts and combined with Byzantine and Moorish styles, added the architectures with soft curves and fairytale flavor, and successfully blended them into the local natural landscape, creating a global exclusive original architectural style. Guests can take a boat cruise along the canals and enjoy the scenery on sides, insect buzzes and bird chirps, as well as the characteristic scenery of the 16 bridges.     "Feng Valley Ecological Park" is the only ecological park in Taiwan attached to a hotel. The park uses the underground springs from Taiwan's Central Mountains to ecologically restore an area of 5.7 hectares green space for three years. Pure water has nurtured rich aquatic plants and the park become a habitat and feeding place for nearby birds, insects, and frogs. Professional narrators lead visitors through the programs of urban farmer experience, cycling migratory bird, equestrian riding, grass skiing, and many other enriching activities for parent and child to experience together, with a deep sense of ecological and conservation enlightenment. Four room types with different Spanish story themes, "Flamenco," "Isabella," "Antonio," and "San Diego," each room is equipped with elegant exotic handmade rosewood furniture and has balconies facing the canal and the East Rift Valley Mountains. Your visit Promisedland Resort will always leave you with unexpected wonders, joy, and touching memories, The only Spanish Gaudi-style resort hotel surrounded by a spring canal, and a land promised to let you relax your body and ease your mind.

Hotels.Description: Nantou｜Bear Meets MooseThe unparalleled cuteness of a Japanese zakka-style guesthouseWe’re really lost this time! Various guesthouse signs stand along either side of the road in Taomi Village, yet our fabled super-cute destination is nowhere to be found. Turning this way and that on the country lanes, we finally arrive at the Bear Meets Moose guesthouse. No wonder we got lost. They purposely have no sign!Dreamlike hosts straight out of Japanese mangaYou enter the pink building of the Bear Meets Moose guesthouse. Spacious, warm and bright, the style is rustic Japanese and there is a smell of cinnamon in the air. Light-colored wooden bookshelves hold all kinds of cute miscellaneous goods. Of course, the leading characters of this guesthouse - bear and moose - are hiding in every corner! No matter if it’s armwrestling moose and black bear, or white bears with moose antlers designed by the guesthouse owner, each wears a welcoming smile just for you!The most unexpected thing is that this cute, dreamlike, fairytale guesthouse is actually the creation of two grown boys, Jerry and Ethan. Jerry’s nickname is Tu-Tu-Ge (or Rabbit Brother), a reference to Tukisiro Yukito from the Japanese manga Cardcaptor Sakura. Both Jerry and Ethan appear as if they have just emerged from the kind of manga adored by young girls, with their fair, clear skin, eyes like crescent moons, and mouths always turned up at the corners in a smile.Afternoon tea prepared by the hosts is ready and waiting for you, but the best thing is that you get to choose your preferred mug from their rich and varied collections. Tea and handmade cookies are available around the clock here. You can even sign up for Jerry and Ethan’s own DIY dessert workshop, donning a cute apron in this cute house to make cute aromatic cookies together!A mansion fit for young ladiesBear Meets Moose is absolutely a mansion fit for young ladies; not a gold-and-jade kind of luxuriousness, but rather the kind of sweet and gorgeous environment that young girls dream of. A lavender-colored calico sofa furnishes the first floor common space, and a life-sized stuffed bear sits there awaiting your embrace. Even the wooden tree adorning the wall and ceiling spreads out overhead in layered shapes resembling a cloud, a butterfly and a heart!Each room is painted in tender colors, the favorite being the Tiffany blue room on the third floor where the ceiling is cut into diamond-shaped lines and adorned with a crystal light fixture. There is also the Rilakkuma room on the first floor where the doors are decorated with a big bear’s head and paws asking you to “give me five” before you enter. Furthermore, room and bathroom are furnished with a heater and a bed of the same quality as the Hilton hotel chain. Each and every guest is guaranteed a sweet night’s sleep.Joy fills the space inside and outYou wake up in the morning and push open the balcony doors. The sight of blue sky and green grass raises your spirits. Next, you go down stairs and find Jerry and Ethan working together to make the breakfast of your choice: a savory American-style meal, sweet banana and chocolate waffles, or toast and homemade jam. Breakfast is served with hot tea or coffee, giving the day a sumptuous and delightful start. After breakfast, walk out into the vast outdoor park area and discover even more pleasant surprises. Apart from the ecological pond and the four-seasons pathway, there is even a pool shaped like a cupid’s heart. Near the pool is a spacious barbecue area with the option to order barbecued suckling pig. Time flies in such a place, but each moment leaves a cheerful memory.

Hotels.Description: The first impression of Yilan is one of abundant greenery, followed by an gentle ocean breeze and the idyllic pace of the Lanyang Plain. This is the setting for “Hotel Les Champs”, a minimalist granite building with a classic copper roof with a rich European ambience? The 7M tall lobby puts guests completely at ease while the attentive reception staff offers weary travelers a warm welcome. The 12-storey European style building is also surrounded by a carefully landscaped garden. Walking down the spiral staircase in the rear garden brings guests to the newly added Bali Hot Spring Swimming Pool, the Four Seasons Hot Spring Spa and the Crystal Energy Sauna where a tropical atmosphere awaits. During the day, you can wander beneath the warm sunlight to embrace the country ambience and metropolitan opulence. At night, you can relax and enjoy the purity of a sky filled with sparkling stars. Les Champs& #39;& #39;& #39;& #39; most famous feature is our special “Sunken Ceramic Bath”. Guests can enjoy the sodium hydrogen carbonate spring waters – also known as “Beauty Hot Spring” – in their own suits with perfect privacy and hygiene. We particularly recommend the “Yocyuan Hot Spring Suite” as it offers breathtaking views of Gueishan Island without having to go to see it. The French windows also offer unparalleled views of the Lanyang Plains. This is a unique experience that only Hotel Les Champs can offer out of all of the hotels in Jiaosi. At Les Champs, “To be a hotel worth visiting and a hotel worth remembering” is our philosophy. We hope to offer our guests an even better travel experience. The hotel& #39;& #39;& #39;& #39;s facilities are therefore regularly adjusted in keeping with the seasons. We also offer the best quality and most reasonably priced packaged tours of beautiful Lanyang. “Hotel Les Champs” is confident that our high quality suites and extensive facilities backed by the most attentive service will meet the needs of your mind and body. Why keep such a wonderful experience a secret? Come and experience for yourself the magic of “Hotel Les Champs”, rated by the Japanese publisher Shueisha as one of the “Top 50 Hot Spring Hotels in the World”.

Those who spend a night here by can go onto the balcony for the great view or the bustling world underneath, or even the starry night above! A short break or good sleep to recharge oneself and start your next journey anew. Some say no matter how long the journey is, it always leads to home. The wanderer's heart is always full of the desire for home. At Hotel Mi Casa, passers-by without any destination can find their home and enjoy the peace and warmth just like home.

Hotels.Description: Welcome to Red Bridge B&B! We are located in an area with a strong cultural and historical atmosphere and are committed to providing you with a comfortable accommodation experience. Hotels.Description: Hualian｜ Adagio ShihtipingA Slow Travel Journey Between Mountains and SeaTime seems to slow down beneath clear blue skies as you follow the Hualian-Taitung Coastal Highway (Provincial Highway 11) from Changbin township northward to Fengbin. Pulling off into the Shitiping ocean-lookout rest area, you arrive at today’s destination: Adagio Shihtiping. At a slow, relaxed pace, you set off on your exclusive journey.The enchanting elegance of mountain and seaCrossing grassy fields and ascending stone steps with the Pacific Ocean spread out right before your eyes, you push open the front doors and are greeted by the faint smell of solid wood and the smiles of your cordial hosts. Gentle piano music plays in the background as you take in the ocean vista beyond the windows and any tension you’ve brought with you slowly fades away. Laying your luggage to one side, you enter the main hall and enjoy the afternoon array of self-serve refreshments consisting of fresh seasonal fruit, handmade indigenous desserts, and fresh coffee. Sitting beside floor-to-ceiling windows and gazing at the captivating coastal vistas, your spirits feel soothed by the waves gently lapping the shore and the clouds drifting carefree through the sky.You peruse the local indigenous artwork in the main hall. With their roots in the natural world, these works of art create yet another fascinating landscape for the delight of travelers. With their insistence upon a win-win community philosophy, all Adagio Inn branches are making connections between local art and the natural environment.Enjoy pampered intimacy in any of seven private ocean-view roomsService personnel considerately help you choose the room key and the aromas best suited to your tastes, adding to the pleasure of the travel experience. Each keychain is unique, with indigenous markings that represent different romantic stories and cultural elements. Once you choose your favorite relaxing aroma from several unique herbal bath creams, the housekeeper will swap the shower products in your room for your preferred fragrance so that bath time may become a journey back to your most comfortable self.As you take off your shoes and walk up the wooden stairs, the coziness of this house reveals itself. Lounging in the spacious common room, with its assortment of magazines, two hardwood tables and roomy sofa, you can enjoy a slow-paced, cheerful mountain holiday by the seaside even without leaving the comforts of the B&B.The 330-square meter space allows each of the seven rooms to have its own special ocean view and independent open balcony. Whether you find your own comfy corner to laze around in or head out of Shitiping for a stroll, there is no need to add the stress and haste of a travel plan to your vacation. Just find your favorite spot and stay put and let the clouds and mist of the mountains drift slowly through your state of mind.Diverse breakfast dishes, slow travel with beautiful sceneryIn the brilliant morning sunlight, you stroll into the main hall to enjoy a delicious breakfast of warm congee accompanied by an array of tidy side dishes made from healthy local ingredients and served on a three-by-three square of nine small porcelain plates a la Chinese calligraphy paper and a bowl of refreshing fish soup, leaving both body and soul feeling nourished and satisfied. Before leaving, you bid farewell to the gorgeous scenery outside the floor-to-ceiling windows. Your heart suddenly softens as your body unconsciously unloads some of its usual burden. As the stress of the usual struggle for survival is cast aside, you become aware that the thing you needed to warm your heart, after all, was a date with the mountains and sea at Adagio Shihtiping.

Hotels.Description: Yamagata Prefecture in Japan contains many majestic natural sights and mysterious temples hidden in mountains; intertwined with Mount Zaō, the elegance of nature is conveyed through the light of dusk reflected off frosted tree branches, icy mountain paths, and emanating mists from hot springs.Extending along the Sendai line, the mountain’s temples are major spiritual grounds for religious practitioners. Hotels.Description: Tainan｜Sai Kau Kin Old HouseGold in the Gutter, An Old House that Spans Three CenturiesWalking at an unhurried pace through the narrow streets of the old capital city, you turn down Xinyi Street, walking past a mixture of residences both old and new. Eventually, you stop before an old wooden door painted white with couplets handwritten on red paper framing the doorway - on the horizontal scroll above the door are the characters for Sai Kau Kin Old House. You lightly push the door open, feeling the wealth of stories it must contain, and are seemingly transported a century into the past to a beautiful bygone time.The story begins with a smelly riverSai Kau Kin (literally “The Bank of the Open Sewer”) is the name of the northernmost tributary in Wu Tiao Gang (“Five Channels Harbor”). In olden days, it was used for the storage and transportation of the city’s sewage waters, hence the rather smelly sounding name. Built in 1897, the old house of today’s visit is located on the bank of this river channel. After construction of the Tainan Canal was completed, the accumulating silt and sludge filled up the channel, at which time residents in the area began to expand their dwellings outward and upward, creating the Sai Kau Kin living environment that we see today.As you set foot in Sai Kau Kin Old House, the simple wooden construction, the bamboo and wicker furniture exhibits the classical style of life in Tainan. James, the owner of the guesthouse, chose the name Sai Kau Kin Old House in the hopes of preserving the local culture, and of giving people a place to enjoy a life of freedom and ease. The roof beams overhead, the pebble-inlaid flooring underfoot, and the red brick wall all preserve the traces of history. More than a hundred years ago, during the era of Japanese occupation, the Japanese came to Tainan to implement plans for urban renewal and tore down many old city walls and buildings. The workers from the local harbors collected these bricks dating back to the era of Dutch occupation and the Ming and Qing dynasties, using them to build their own houses.Deep conversations with an old soulThis is a house that spans three centuries, as well as James’s old family home. Over forty years ago, James’s father bought this old house to provide his parents with a place to enjoy their golden years in peace. However, his parents later moved elsewhere, after which time this old house sat vacant for over twenty years. It wasn’t until 2011 that James decided to return to live in Tainan, with the belief that, “The true value of Tainan is to be found in these old laneways, these old houses, and this culture.” Thus he set about rebuilding the old building into a guesthouse with the intention of sharing memories and stories of the past with his travelling guests. Illuminated by the warm sunshine, travelers climb the steep wooden steps, arriving at the “Ballast Room” which is decorated with collected items from James’s travels through Europe when he was a young man. “This house is like a centenarian, it actually has a soul!” Continuing on, James invites you to walk barefoot upon the wooden floorboards, which sing their creaky song with every step you take.As you climb even higher, you reach the top-floor sleeping quarters. On a peaceful afternoon, you recline on the old sofa lost in thought, and looking out across the sloping open balcony which has no enclosing walls, you see all the neighboring rooftop balconies. Turning around, you notice that behind you there is another sliding door which connects to the “Matsu Room” in the attic. Looking out from the small hatch-like window, you feel like a child again, hiding in a small corner and peering out at the scenery of the laneways below. In the tranquility of night, you close your eyes, the gentle smell of rushes accompanies you as you drift into dreams of olden days.Still, the story of an old city continuesIn the morning, with Sai Kau Kin Old House as your starting point, you begin to walk along Xinyi Street. This place is different than other cities - there are no high-rise apartment buildings, only short old single-story houses one after another. These gifts that time and history have left to the city reveal the culture and enchanting atmosphere of which the people of Tainan are so proud.Xinyi Street lies between the Matsu Building and the Jifu Temple, and so receives the protection of these two great deities. It is the kind of precious land found in legends, and the place where James was born. After growing up, he backpacked around Europe and Asia, travelling to Germany, Singapore, Hong Kong, and China, even experiencing the fall of the Berlin Wall, the Tiananmen Square incident and other significant historical events, all of which nourished him to become who he is today. Afterwards, he attended advanced courses at Tokyo College of Photography. After returning to Taiwan James and his wife first decided to return to Tainan to establish their own photography studio. After striving for more than twenty years, they happened to encounter the Foundation of Historic City Conservation and Regeneration. Deeply moved by their philosophy, it was after this time that James began to operate his guesthouse and put down roots in the local culture.Beyond the operation of his guesthouse, James also devotes his efforts to putting on all kinds of different activities pertaining to arts and culture, establishing Sai Kau Kin Old House as an arts and culture space to increase interaction and exchange within the community. Check-in to Sai Kau Kin, sip a cup of tea, savour the slow passage of time, and look forward to the memories written down by each and every traveler who comes by to visit.

Hotels.Description: Superbly positioned for both business and leisure, Silks Place Tainan is situated in the heart of this enchanting city that was once a bustling cultural capital. A mere thirty-minute drive from Tainan High Speed Rail station, we are just a stone’s throw away from Shin Kong Mitsukoshi shopping district and major historic landmarks.Timeless designs, from the suspended calligraphy brush lamps in each of the 255 guest rooms to the motif of pottery rooftop tiles in the lobby walls, gracefully reflect Tainan’s rich history of art, literature, and architecture. Without compromising on modern luxury, our hotel features a stunning outdoor swimming pool, a magnificent banquet hall, a sublime Chinese cuisine restaurant, and a Western steakhouse and teppanyaki, popular among both locals and travelers. With our junior guests in mind, our Kid’s Club offers a stimulating array of activities from story time and Xbox games to our exclusive Chinese “Six Arts”, where families can enjoy simple calligraphy exercises, bean bag toss, abacus practice, and more. Art lovers looking to soak up a splash of local culture are invited to join our guided tour of the exquisite collection of paintings, photographs and other works by local artists on display throughout Silks Place Tainan. A pioneering local author once wrote, “Tainan is the perfect place to daydream, to work, to fall in love, to get married, and to live in utter bliss.” We invite you to discover this charming city for yourself. Welcome to Silks Place Tainan!

Hotels.Description: The Tai Yi Ecological Leisure Farm is a four-star hotel with a combination of Nantou County's first farm, B&B, restaurants, and green energy ecological resources, located next to Taiwan Highway No. 14 (at the end of National Highway No. 6) at the Tai-Yi Red Maple Resort, which is a flower forest castle with access to Chigjing (Qing Jing) Road in Wushe, offering services for business, conferences, banquets, leisure, catering, accommodations, entertainment, and other functions all in one, creating a wonderful vacation paradise. For Staying: Tai Yi Ecological Leisure Farm is designed using environmentally qualified green building materials. Floors with seasonal names, “Spring Dew,” “Summer Lotus,” “Autumn Maple,” and “Winter Love” are carefully constructed, offering 73 rooms, all equipped with environmental-grade products, including essential oils, spare and separate marble baths, inviting guests to enjoy the exquisite hotel. For Dining: In the holiday park, we offer three dining environments for guests' choice. The South Garden Banquet Hall, with French windows 13 meters high, is built with native plant landscaping introducing king coconut trees, ferns, flowers, etc., to absorb the natural lighting, which includes a unique greenhouse restaurant and an elegant Water Garden Restaurant offering dishes of Taiwanese, Sichuan, Japanese, and Western styles, serving special “flower cuisine” and offering a creative menu. In addition, the simple quiet Flower Coffee House offers local, seasonal specialties and health concept foods, introducing individual packages, afternoon tea, coffee, herbal tea, and other delicacies. Welcome and enjoy! For Banqueting and Meeting: Unlike ordinary conference rooms, the Hotel features accompanying greenery and beautiful floral arrangements with natural fragrance all around for banquets or meetings of all sizes, and offers services for a variety of meetings, conferences, parties, year-end banquets, and weddings, among other activities. Leisure Facilities: Flower Spa is a separate private space, and provides aromatherapy services with meticulous, soft massage techniques to relax your frayed nerves and relieve the pressure accumulated over many years, a complete “baptism” from the inside out, from soul to body. Strolling out of the Tai Yi Ecological Leisure Farm, there is a colorful garden with an area of 132,000 square meters with ecological themes such as; flower temple, rainforest hall, honey garden, dancing butterfly museum, fairy tale forest, DIY activities, outdoor cinema, guided tours, etc., which will soothe and relax you!

Hotels.Description: Firefly Farm is located on the hillside at the junction of the protected forest and the upstream of Nanshi River in Fuxing Village, Tongsiao Township, surrounded by the green hills in three directions. A babbling brook flows across the valley and slowly passes through the front of the house. A courtyard covered with floral. It is a typical quiet Sanhe Yuan farmhouse. Firefly Farm offers visitors the activities including watching fireflies, listening to birds, tea and chat, swimming and playing with water. It is the best place to enjoy the countryside snacks in an arranged vacation.   Covered with wetlands around the park, the place is rich in fireflies during the annual spring season. At night, mountains and waters, in front of the house and behind the house, are dotted with charming flickering fireflies; therefore the name "Firefly Farm." Located halfway up the mountain, it is a clean environment with minimal pollution, so every year from March to November you can enjoy Luciola ficta Olivier, Pyrocoelia analis, and Luciola anceyi flying in the mountains dotting the lights. It is one of nature's most beautiful pictures.   Firefly Farm is a comprehensive B&B that integrates the concepts of nature, health and sustainability. It is located in the Firefly Ecological Restoration Area and provides a variety of services. It aims to allow every visitor to experience the process of relaxation, learning and self-healing while getting close to nature. The farm's services include accommodation, catering, DIY experiences, ecological tours, environmental education, and professional forest healing activities. Whether you are a traveler pursuing leisure or a friend who desires to relax physically and mentally, you can find your own way to relax here.

Hotels.Description: Mapleton Spa Motel (sometimes be called Fong-cai Motel by transliteration) is located in the mountain region of the Taichung metropolitan area. In this region, Mapleton Spa motel is the first motor hotel which provides with steam room, jacuzzi and spa facilities in each guest room. This motel building exterior was designed in a simple and elegant style, which is inspired by the traditional design of southern European residence. Several Palm trees and Pandanus trees were planted as the mainstay within the motel driveway garden, further showing the atmosphere of this subtropical island. The motel logo is derived from traditional hot spring icons. It aims to illustrate the image of: “in colourful autumn, maple leafs and hot spring steam dance together in the wind.” It also implies that the motel offers outstanding bathroom facilities.The motel has thirty guest rooms; each room has an attached and covered garage. Average room sizes are forty to fifty square meters, providing guests a clean and comfortable environment. Rooms are classified into three types: Standard Room, Twin Room and Quad Room. All guest rooms have one 42-inch LCD television and a jacuzzi bathtub. Most of guest rooms also have a steam room and a spa facility.

At night the mountain breeze travels downward, passes the B&B and moves towards the ocean. The B&B doesn't face the ocean and is not luxurious, but all the furnishings in the house are very comfortable.                                                                                                                      Coconut Coast B&B serves delicious local gourmets. There are no industrial pollution, so all the local ingredients are safe to eat. Hotels.Description: The Lou Zi Xia Traditional-Style Taiwanese Bed & Breakfast was planned and renovated by Kinmen National Park and operated by the Cai sisters from Qiong Lin Community. Three sisters manage No. 79, 92, and 105. The B&B includes 12suites accomodating up to 34 people. Groups and individuals welcome. Facilities include a BBQ grill and ingredients. After spending a day around the island, travelers can come back and barbecue, sip tea, or chat with friends under a starry night. Enjoy the serenity and a break from the stress and bustle of the city. As an environmentally-friendly B&B, Lou Zi Xia Traditional-Style Taiwanese Bed & Breakfast complies with the Kinmen Low-Carbon Program by not automatically providing disposable toiletries or changing bedding and towels for guests staying more than one night. Qiong Lin Community is located in the center of the island, and is one of its representative communities. The original name for this area, “Pinglin,” came from the forests that used to grow nearby. It has been frequented by famous people since the Ming dynasty, when one of the emperors bestowed an honorary inscribed board from which the current name, “Qiong Lin,” is derived. A number of traditional-style Taiwanese buildings, simple and elegant, with natural charm, have been preserved here. The largest of these is the ancestral temple. During times of war, tunnels were dug around the island and it had a heavy military atmosphere; now it is open to the public. Qiong Lin was home to a number of successful scholars during the Ming and Qing dynasties, and therefore a number of ornate official residences can still be viewed here. The ancestral temples are full of inscribed boards celebrating the scholars’ achievements, and in addition to the main Cai Family Temple, several more representing the branches of the family can be found in Qiong Lin. One building houses two of these temples. Each of the temples provides interesting sights, and along with Yi Gu Tang and two of Feng Shi Ye (Wind Lion Gods) have been designated second-grade historical sites.

Hotels.Description: A drifting work style is the destiny for those who graduated from the department of civil engineering and the graduate school of architecture. From Kaohsiung to Taipei, and from Taiwan to the Mainland to every corner around the world, either for work or business, with bitterness and happiness, I am a wanderer between cities, staying at different hotels at night. The silver moonlight, however, is the one thing that never changes no matter whether the streets are booming or quiet. Shone by the streetlight, those extravagantly adorned 5-star hotels provide the comfort of brand-name beds, whereas in the ordinarily equipped, confined room of business hotels, only beds of slightly insufficient length and roughness to be had. These only make me feel the lack of warmth being away from home. The pillows without my own smell arouse the homesickness deep inside of me in the depth of night. I miss home. We all have what it takes to plan, design, build and decorate a beautiful, comfortable, warm and safe house of our own. Those who travel anywhere owing to the highly developed global village without their own permanent residence want a hotel to be "like home" for their time staying there. It is with such idea that "Hoyang Business Hotel - Chu" was born in our home town, the gorgeous harbor city in southern Taiwan where the sun always shines - Kaohsiung. An inconspicuous old building on the Qixian 2nd Rd. was thus given a new life by our expertise, dedication and persistence. It is hoped, whether it is because of business, work or travel, those who are far away from home and destined to spend a night at out place will find it like home with all its comfort and relief. Come visit us! Be a part of this big family. You will find it just like moving into a new house upon your stay first time. From then on, end every time you happen to be in Kaohsiung, you will have an impulse to go back to your home at "Hoyang Business Hotel." Now that our "Hoyang Business Hotel" is open for business, we hope our dedication, business philosophy and passion touch deep down inside all of you who ever spent a night here. And you will miss your home of Kaohsiung - "Hoyang Business Hotel."

Rooms
Enjoy a moment of quiet 
Every room contains aromatic plants specially grown for Hotel Royal Beitou bringing a touch of green. They also have a culinary use: our staff is on hand to prepare healthy and relaxing herbal teas from the same plants placed in every room.

Our custom in-room sound systems use Near-Field Communication (NFC) technology to play music from your smartphone, giving you unrestrained enjoyment.

｜Sleep Soundly Service

Hotels.Description: Looking for a relaxed, all-natural bed and breakfast? Next to the Taiwan Adventist College is a small, inconspicuous flower path that leads to a secret place – Secret Garden Bed and Breakfast. “Look for Mr. Wu when you come to Sun Moon Lake.” Unless you heard about this place by word of mouth or the Internet, it might be difficult to find such a beautiful, secret place. Mr. Wu and his family lived in Brazil for 8 years before deciding to return to Taiwan due to several considerations. A middle-aged man, he enjoys a reputation for being friendly and steadfastly pursuing his dreams. Without an architectural background, he nonetheless created his home through careful planning and skillful, self-taught methods. “Unique architectural creativity, unconcealable secrets.” Mr. Wu was singularly responsible for the blueprints, construction, and overall planning, completing this impossible mission that became his life’s most meaningful project. Thoughtfully integrating natural scenery and architectural art, it used a large amount of glass, whose transparency enhanced the visual appeal. The independent, creative design also fills every corner, inside and out, with surprises. We welcome you to Sun Moon Lake Secret Garden Bed and Breakfast, a place of friendliness and ideals that fate will hopefully lead you to!

Hotels.Description: Pingtung｜Orange Moon InnOrange vacation beneath a century-old breadfruit treeTurning a corner off Kenting’s Main Street and heading down a small lane, you embark on a stroll through the daily happenings of this southern Taiwanese town. A little down the lane, you encounter a stately breadfruit tree that has inhabited this place for a century. Tucked away in the shade of the tree sits Orange Moon Inn, almost as if extending both hands to you in welcome. Your vacation is about to be immersed in the orange warmth of Kenting.A life adorned with the warmth of the sunPerhaps because it sits in the embrace of a breadfruit tree, as you push open the wooden doors of Orange Moon Inn, you are struck by the gentle warmth of the midsummer sun dancing on the orange interior walls. However simple and reserved, the wooden space with its bare cement walls is not devoid of texture. The simple decor is offset by various displays of adorable goods which from time to time surprises you with their orange ingenuity. Genial collectibles and stacks of books adorn the stairwell, inherited from the “Orange Moon Bookstore” once owned and operated in Kenting by host and guesthouse owner, Alumi. Feel free to peruse which ever book may catch your eye.Orange Moon Inn is a split-level structure, and each half-storey level is represented by a different color and botanical theme. For instance, the romantic Rose level is painted in passionate red, while the Ginger Lily level is clad in calming blue. A number of specially crafted carvings represent such local flowers as Small-leaved Barringtonia, Narrow-leaved Dracaena, Frangipani, and others, all indigenous to Pingtung county. The four-person rooms are suitable for groups of friends, while, in consideration of lone travelers, Orange Moon Inn also offers single rooms. If you’re travelling alone, Orange Moon Inn has the perfect nook for you to enjoy. Architectural aesthetics in dialogue with spaceThe eight conceptually colored rooms spread across four stories are replete with ingenuity, inspiring a kind of dialogue between travelers and the building they inhabit. The facade of the cement wall in the entrance is modeled after traditional iron window grates. As the second floor atrium running up through the entire building allows sunlight to trickle downwards, it also invites the wind into Orange Moon Inn, inspiring the atmosphere with rhythmic life. Having been retrofitted by Alumi with a pneumatic luggage elevator, the Orange Moon Inn has integrated an increasingly simple aesthetic. The purpose: to provide each and every traveler the right amount of space to enjoy true freedom and ease.All of these design concepts were generated by guesthouse owner Alumi himself. Alumi once acted as editor in chief of his university magazine, at which time he developed his seemingly endless ingenuity in artistic culture and design. Alumi was previously the owner of a bookstore here in Kenting, when his wife began to dream of opening a bed and breakfast. “Architecture needs to correspond to the environment, and must harmonize with it, the experience of which cannot be replaced by any particular style of interior design.” With such staunch dedication to architectural aesthetics, Alumi resolved to introduce sunlight and shade, wind and form into his design. Close your eyes and you can hear the space breathe, as if all the sunlight and tranquility of Kenting has been gathered in this place.Jubilant mornings beneath the breadfruit treeBreakfast is made fresh every morning. Travelers who stay more than one night will be treated to different breakfast creations every day. Sitting in the wooden space of the main hall as a hot chicken sandwich is placed on the table, you enjoy every toasty bite, washing it down with ice-cold milk tea in a state of pure satisfaction.Before you leave Orange Moon Inn, why not linger a moment beneath the breadfruit tree! Look into the near distance and see the morning sun shining upon Dajianshan mountain and the pastures of Kenting ranch. Beneath the hundred-year-old breadfruit tree, tucked away down a little lane, enjoy your very own orange vacation.

Hotels.Description: Shou Watt, pronounced as "Shou-Wa", means "first tile". The name represents the first tile put on the roof that started the heritage and origin of Shou Watt Design B&B.                                                                                                                                         Shou Watt B&B has a slanted roof and white walls. Its building principal is energy conservation - UV-resistant tempered glass, energy-efficient building materials such as using natural light, and reducing energy consumption by using a heat pump water heater, etc..                                                                                                           The open-style living room and dining room, open staircase and the simply treated driftwood (unique to Liuqiu) all make the living space special and unique. In addition, the open kitchen has a small space to rest or take a break. The small open area on the second floor has a small courtyard that brings a lot of natural light to the room.                                                                                                                         The history behind the name "Shou Watt" was that this house was built on the location of the owner's ancestral home, "Wa-Cuo-Nei". Since Wa-Cuo-Nei was the first courtyard house in Xiaoliuqiu built with tiles, therefore the name "Shou Watt Design B&B" was given to remember the ancestor's hard work.                                                                                                                                           In order for our guests to fully enjoy and relax in the privacy of their own home, we only receive one group of guests each day.

Hotels.Description: Huan Er (exchange of a goose) Homestay is named after the classic allusion of Wang Xizhi& #39;s exchanging his writing for a goose. Just a three-minute& #39; walk from Chihshang Station, originally this three and a half story townhouse was a residence. We hope you will have the feeling of home when you checked in.  　　The reason to draw the name from Wang Xizhi& #39;s exchange allusion is that Huan Er& #39;s family members love calligraphy deeply, especially the founder Dad Huan Er even uses calligraphy to make friends, and Huan Er& #39; hostess, "Xiaoshan." also opens calligraphy talent classes for children in Huan Er Homestay. As long as you like calligraphy, we offer you Four Treasures of the Study for you to experience, when you are staying in the B&B.  　　The interiors of Huan Er Homestay is a minimalist style, there is no luxury décor, but calligraphy is visible everywhere .If you are interested in calligraphy, we welcome you to experience this cultural essence of over a thousand years.  　　Huan Er Homestay offers mainly simple, clean, and comfortable rooms, and of course, we decorate the rooms with a lot of calligraphic works .Currently, the room types of Huan Er Homestay include double suites and four-person rooms.  　　Although Huan Er is known for his calligraphy, but he is active in sports. The host "Xiao Hei" has once cycled around the island,; therefore he understands the needs of the friends cycling around the island, and hence Huan Er Homestay is a good place for cycling friends to stay for a time on their journey. Chishang has beautiful Dapo Pond, vast rice fields. For cycling lovers, do you want to wander in the scenery of golden paddy waves of Mr. Brown Avenue and Paradise Road? Do forget to come to Chishang.

Hotels.Description: The museum started off with a humble beginning as a woodcarving workshop. Later in 1988, it functioned as a woodcarving school that mainly conducted classes for young children between ages 10 and 12. The overwhelming responses for classes inspired the establishment of the current Face Painting Cultural Museum, which combines the art of wood carving and the art of Chinese Opera face painting together.      More than a thousand traditional Chinese Opera face paintings are displayed in the museum, each exquisitely designed by the owner's family of 4 during the SARS period from 1992 to 1995. The SARS crisis was a blessing in disguise that provided the family with an opportunity to transform the site into the current Face Painting Cultural Museum. The gallery of face painting art pieces not only enhances the beauty of the place, but also represents the fruits of their hard work.

Hotels.Description: Gui Ju Yuan B&B, located in Shihtan (Shitan) , Miaoli, stands in beside Highway No. 3, is a new building with gray and white and a significant landmark. From here you can overlook the pleasant country scene of Shihtan mountains, and having a spacious space; it is an excellent choice of place for enjoying the Mid-Autumn Festival. Mr. Huang Rongzong, the innkeeper, brought his family together back to hometown Shihtan after retirement, and decided to build a high-quality living space for home, During building the house, he had an idea to ​​operate a B&B. The B&B is located close to Taiwan Highway No. 3 surrounded by mountains. To close the distance between you and the sky is only to raise your head, and when facing the myriad of mountains, you catch the view of the greeting emerald green of the whole valley. Take a deep breath, you then inhale the freshness of the mountains immediately. The dawn of sunrise at here is comparable to that of Cingjing (Qingjing) Farm. If lucky enough, you are able to watch the domineering posture of an eagle soaring in the sky. When the sun goes down, night falls, and the vast starry sky is hanging over. While frogs croak, birds chirp, sweet Osmanthuses give off a fragrance, you brew a pot of tea and enjoy the life unavailable in the city but available in the most natural environment. A place you feel the warmth of home with rich real human interest, where you can have fun of playing the toys of old days, and breakfast of Hakka flavor. A real B&B the travelers have frequented repeatedly. Gui Ju Yuan offers spacious lawns, moon watching balcony, private indoor parking spaces, featuring a quiet and comfortable environment and relaxing countryside ambience. Whether it is family or group outings, you can enjoy the pleasure of a pleasance. Welcome to Gui Ju Yuan.

Hotels.Description: When Taiwan regained its territory in 1945, Guguan was renamed "Guguan" (meaning "valley pass") due to its valley terrain and the water in Dajia River running to the ocean, which seemed like a pass the water had to travel through, hence the name.                                                                                                In 1984, the hotel was expanded and named "Ku Kuan Hotel". After the 921 Earthquake, the hotel was renovated and renamed "Ku Kuan Hot-Spring Hotel" and emerged as an enterprise establishment.                                                 Ku Kuan Hot-Spring Hotel is surrounded by mountains. There are river and streams, and lush green plants in the area. With an elevation of 800 meters, the air quality in this serene, quiet location is very fresh. It& #39;s also blessed with the best natural hot spring and beautiful scenery in Taiwan.                                                  There are elegant hot spring suites, exquisite cuisine, a variety of hot spring pools, meeting rooms and banquet rooms. In addition, there are a number of hiking trails nearby. We& #39;re waiting for you to join us to explore nature.

Hotels.Description: We often go up the mountain. Not to reach the summit, nor to escape anything.It& #39;s just that when the car enters Qingjing, the clouds drift low, and the wind brushes against the car window, the pace of life slows down.Once, we temporarily parked our car by the No. 6 Livestock Trail at kilometer 10 of Provincial Highway 14A.We just wanted to get out and walk around, to feel the breeze.After walking for a few minutes, we came across this corner.The grass stretched out quietly, and the sunlight fell on the distant mountainline. No one spoke,but at that moment, it seemed everyone understood—this place was different from other places.A year later, we passed by there again. The grass was still there, and the wind was still there.So we stayed, built a house, and slowly, this name came to be.Qingjing B&B - "Giethoorn"—not because it resembles any other place,but because its tranquility reminded us of a small Dutch village we had once visited.There were no clamors to rush us there, no one urging us to leave,only the scenery, and just the right amount of time.If you& #39;re also a traveler, perhaps next time you pass through this area, you don& #39;t need to rush.Sit down, have a cup of hot tea, look at the distant mountains, feel the breeze for a while; maybe that will remind you that some scenery is meant to be appreciated by pausing and pausing.

Hotels.Description: Penghu｜ DaydreamCotton candy spaceship sailing the white clouds of a dreamOutside the car window, carefree white clouds drift in the blue sky, stirring up the wanderlust of the travelers within. The radio provides melodious accompaniment invoking further flights of fancy. Beside the road sits Daydream, Penghu Islands’ enchanting guesthouse, like a cotton candy spaceship just waiting to fly you away!Summer fantasyOpen the gates to this dreamland and behold a fantasy paradise out of a young girl’s daydream. A princess bed sits in the middle of a vast green field. Teak lounge chairs surround an inviting, clear swimming pool. Glance westward and behold an endless ocean view. There’s a variety of charming inflatable swim rings floating upon the clear water of the pool. The whole summer scene seems to have burst from a dream.Only when Heshi, the owner of this dreamland, walks out the front doors in her flowery skirt to greet you do you realize that this place is truly real. You follow Heshi into Daydream guesthouse, contemplating the relaxing atmosphere and princess-style decor which seems just like a little girl’s fantasy land.A daydream canvasThe high ceilings and huge windows make for a spacious and bright lobby. Macaron-colored sofa cushions catch the eye like bright paint splattered across a canvas. Tasty brown sugar cakes and tisane tea, a local specialty, sit welcomingly on the table before you. Travelers move unconstrained throughout the space.As you stroll up the stairs and along the outdoor balcony, you observe the attentive efforts Heshi has put into the creation of this white dreamland. Moon and star inlays decorate pure white walls. Cute little sailor dolls adorn window sills. Every element of the decor and design was executed personally by Heshi and her family, with their cute and dainty ornaments appearing in every corner as if awaiting to surprise you upon arrival!Tiptoeing in the cloudsYou enter a room, where a basket of exquisite Verbena bath products and velvety soft slippers sits on the bed waiting for you. The slippers are customized according to Heshi’s requirements. She wants you to feel so comfortable it’s as if you’re walking above the clouds, making sure that every second you spend at Daydream is a real sensual experience.The room overlooking the ocean offers more than just an impressive seaside view - the Penghu sunset makes a daily appearance as well. After dark, if your visit happens to be during the Penghu Fireworks Festival, you can admire the fireworks exploding into colorful blooms in the distance out of the same windows. No matter what time it is at Daydream guesthouse, the most splendid views are there for you just outside the window.Daydream guesthouse does everything possible to give you a genuine dreamland experience. In the future, whenever you look out the window of a plane and see white clouds drifting through blue skies, you’ll think of that time when you rode the cotton candy spaceship in Penghu.

Hotels.Description: The beauty of the Southern Cross-Island Highway can only be truly appreciated by experiencing it firsthand. The eastern section of the highway is comprised of numerous magnificent natural landscapes, coupled with the rustic charm of the Bunun indigenous people, making every stretch of the Southern Cross-Island Highway unique. Driving along the winding highway, you& #39;ll be surrounded by lush green trees, and the unique, refreshing mountain breeze will invigorate you! You can leisurely drive at a slow pace, enjoying the scenery along the way. If you& #39;re lucky, you might even spot the Formosan Blue Magpie, its silhouette like a blue ribbon flying past!Xia Ma Hot Spring B&B is located at Xia Ma on the Southern Cross-Island Highway. The environment is tranquil and serene, and the B&B offers a variety of room types, allowing you to soothe your travel fatigue on a slightly cool mountain night. Unlike typical family-run B&Bs, each room is thoughtfully designed, offering spacious living areas and en-suite bathroom facilities, making it the perfect choice for your Southern Cross-Island Highway stay.Xia Ma B&B warmly welcomes you! Please join us in experiencing the beauty of the Southern Cross-Island Highway!

Hotels.Description: 5 years ago, we unexpectedly came to this little-known place called Sanxing Township, deliberately crossing the street and turning into an area with luxuriant green fields of rice. Ming Shui Lu, hidden among the countryside roads, has no extravagant exterior, opting for wonderful natural scenery, fresh air, and a great environment instead. I love the feeling of simplicity, because it’s the only true way to relax, and it’s only a vacation if you really feel relaxed. We’d like to share the simple joy of this place with you. Sanxing Township – I think it’s a countryside within a countryside. Free of industrial pollution or commercial bustle, the special agricultural area authentically preserves the purity of this place. Take a deep breath and relax your body as the green rice fields stretch out as far as the eye can see, your mood swaying along with the rhythm. Would you like to stay here with them?? Then welcome to Ming Shui Lu!

Hotels.Description: Jen Ju Hotel — A Time Capsule in the Heart of ChiayiTucked inside Chiayi City’s historic Central Second Market, Jen Ju Hotel has been welcoming travelers since 1974. Inside, an elevator imported from Milan, Italy stands as a proud reminder of the hotel’s elegant beginnings. Even the original button panel remains, inviting guests to step into a slower, more nostalgic era.Located just a one-minute walk from Wenhua Road Night Market and Zhongshan Road shopping district, the hotel puts you right in the center of Chiayi’s most vibrant neighborhood. Whether you& #39;re craving local dishes like turkey rice, clay pot fish head, or a refreshing grapefruit green tea, everything is just steps away.Perfect for travelers who love vintage aesthetics, local history, and unbeatable convenience. The renowned Wulai Waterfall originates from a stunning mountaintop landscape featuring tranquil lakes, ancient towering trees, misty forests, colorful butterflies, cicadas singing, and birds chirping — like a paradise hidden from the world. However, due to the steep cliffs of the Nanshi River, visitors were unable to fully appreciate this scenery up close. Thus, the idea to construct an aerial cable car was conceived. Fax: 05-2501533  Website: www.ruili.com.tw  Email：ruiliteapot@gmail.com    The first snack shop (Ruili rest stop) was founded in Ruili in 1989. Since most of the original guests were hikers, they would return hungry and looking for a place to eat after climbing. They would inquire the locals, who would offer a friendly reply: “Keep going past Ruili Elementary School and you’ll see a teapot (the only one in Alishan to have an inlaid clock, which used to let hikers know when to come down from the mountain) where you can get a bite to eat! Over twenty years later, the teapot has become a landmark of Ruili, and just like it, the bed and breakfast and restaurant preserve the wonderful flavor of our memories! The teapot lady represents it and performs well in competitions! (Invited to compete in New York!) A trip to Ruili isn’t complete without enjoying this wonderful twenty year old flavor! Like the teapot, the bed and breakfast has a great capacity, with a large open space in the center of each floor where guests can completely relax! Make this your home away from home! I hope every guest who visits “empties his or her heart of everything undesirable, and replaces it with positive things!” Brew a cup of good tea for life at Ruili Teapot Bed and Breakfast! We’re located in Meishan Township (Chiayi County), being No. 61 Bed and Breakfast, a Culture and Tourism Bureau of Chiayi County) legally-certified establishment. Quietly listen to the soft symphony of the forest during the day, calmly observe the colorful sunset clouds in the evening, and as night falls, the exciting and diverse countryside night life begins…    In order to provide each guest with a fun and satisfying experience, we provide packages such as detailed tours and transportation service, as well as antique lantern night trips based on the season. During firefly season, the air is filled with dancing glows; we welcome everyone to experience the beauty of Ruili! Hotels.Description: The "Dhyana and Pine Recreational Homestay" is located in Shuili Township, Nantou County, and right on the way to Sun Moon Lake Scenic Area, the destinations nearby include Sun Moon Lake, Jiji, Checheng, Shuili Snakekiln, Dongpu Hot Spring and more. This hostel occupies 25000 sqm of land and the location was Shuili's second largest log stockpile and lumbermill in 1950s to 1960s. The land was later purchased by Dr. Yang who is well-known locally after the "921" earthquake of 1999. With his massive planting of "Taiwan pines", this place booms years later. This pine garden is built with two hostels: "Dhyana Homestay" and "Song Zhi Yuan Homestay", both are registered with No. 260 and 279 licenses, respectively. These two homestays are managed by one single management group. The "Dhayana Homestay", a Japanese-style building with red roof tiles and white wall serves as the lobby of both homestays, while "Song Zhi Yuan" presents the cabins built with Taiwan red cypress timber and red honeycomb cell-shaped floor tiles, which resembles the old-school Japanese style. Relax in the Taiwan pine forest and pasture to talk to the breeze, pine forest and chirping birds and insects. There are several famous destinations, including Jiji (15 minutes driving), Sun Moon Lake (30 minutes driving), and Shuili Snakekiln (10 minutes of walking). Also, Taichung International Airport and HSR Taichung Station takes only about an hour of driving, and it's convenient to reach Checheng Recreational Agriculture Area, Sun Moon Lake National Scenic Area and Dream Works of the Mei in Xinyi Township. Featured with tranquility, healthy cuisine, various accommodation options and guest-oriented service, "Dhyana and Pine" welcomes your visit!

Hotels.Description: Room reservation line: 0911-277-178  Cloud Range 128 Bed and Breakfast is located in the north end of Shoufeng Township (Hualien County), a place with a simple, down-to-earth atmosphere, surrounded by magnificent mountains. Every corner of the building has a great view of the towering Qilai Mountain and surrounding ridges. In the depth of winter, the Qilai Mountains, covered with a layer of pure white snow, are a magnificent sight, appearing incredibly fantastic and romantic in combination with the pure white color of our building. Here at Cloud Range 128 Bed and Breakfast, our mission was to create a living space based on “nature, health, simplicity, spaciousness, security, and art.” The owner turned his home into a comfortable environment and built a rich little green forest outside. During the various seasons, different flowers blossom and the area is rich in ecological resources, while guests can enjoy the natural music of chirping birds and croaking frogs as well as going bird-watching. Here you enjoy not only a comfortable environment but ecological experience of the myriad of plants and animals interacting together. Cloud Range 128 Bed and Breakfast is a legally-certified bed and breakfast, a simple white building located in a green area, with comfortable, spacious areas for activity both inside and out. The large building only houses 5 rooms, the rest of the space being common area, offering guests who come for relaxation the chance to browse the book room, chat with friends in the warm living room, or head to the kitchen, a room with excellent views and bathed in sunlight. Enjoy a delicious breakfast and come to Cloud Range 128, where you’ll experience the incomparable delight of being bathed by nature, truly experiencing a joyful vacation!

Hotels.Description: A real, authentic bed and breakfast upholding the principles of the trade instead of being over-commercialized. You’ll never be met by standardized or automatic greeting or service here! We treat every guest as a family member or friend and are committed to providing a home for everyone who comes to visit Yilan, hosting each one with sincerity and friendliness. For us, running a bed and breakfast isn’t about money, it’s about sharing the fun of life with you. Located in the countryside, The Dew offers a spirit of sharing in the bed and breakfast life. This isn’t a hotel or motel, it’s your home in Yilan! Wake up to the sound of birds and insects instead of a machine, an alarm clock. After getting washed and dressed, take a 5 minute bike ride and before you know it come into view of the beautiful Dongshan River. Bathe in Yilan’s beautiful scenery along the river, and by the time you return, the owner’s wife will have a rich, authentic Chinese or Western-style breakfast waiting for you! Our family warmly greets and hosts every guest, and you can be sure never to feel like a stranger here. Though we’ve never met, we’re like long-separated family or friends! Pack your bags and come by yourself or with a group of friends, taking a temporary break from life to come to Yilan and take a deep breath, daydream, read, listen to music, or take an in-depth trip. Relax and give yourself the opportunity to be pampered!

Hotels.Description: Sun Moon Lake Homestay – CHIN-PIN LO B&B is located at Seshui Community in Yuchi Township. The B&B is a conspicuous yellow building intimately hugged by the surrounding mountains and rivers, helping to create a unique sanctuary and paradise. CHIN PIN-LO B&B is graced with a natural ecology pond that adapts to the seasons. Fish, dragonflies, frogs, and tadpoles as well as plants such as waterlilies and lotuses call this place their home. Tea plantations, farms, orchards, and other simple, rustic elements surround CHIN PIN-LO B&B. Guests could take a walk along the footpath that circles the village or visit Seshui Community in the morning while enjoying the refreshing air provided by the gentle wind while enjoying the hums and chirps of birds and other natural wildlife in the mountains. Visitors are also welcome to the pottery classroom to make their own porcelain and pottery, or go even further to the waterfall to enjoy its refreshing, misty splashes. Of course, you can also drive to nearby attractions such as Sun Moon Lake and Formosan Aboriginal Culture Village. It does not take long to drive to these places. Night time at CHIN-PIN LO features starry skies, a perfect time to enjoy tea with your friends while sharing a delightful conversation. The quiet countryside will help relax your soul, with the natural chirping of critters and birds keeping you company as you settle down for a most relaxing sleep.

Hotels.Description: Mu Gu Mu Yu which has the style of a Japanese style vacation villas, built next to a creek and mountains. On the left hand side is a large area of grass for children to play ball. On the trail in front, you can go play with the water along the riverside rock, and also walk for about 15 minutes along a 200 meter long old tunnel to Jade Valley (Feicui Valley) in front of the home stay to take a SPA, swim, river trek, and explore old trails. On the left side, there is the most popular scenic spot in Hualien, Mu Gu Mu Yu. There are also Qingshui River and Long Chien (Longjian) Valley, known as Taiwan's Jiuzaigou (About 32 km round trip). On the right hand side of the home stay, within 6 km, there is the Bai Bao River, Liuyutan (Liyu Lake), Ji-an Canal, Feng Lin trail with bicycle trails. Every building has a window and the view is good. In the rooms, balcony, outer hallway, green grassland in the grounds, you can enjoy the beautiful natural scenery of mountains, Papaya River (Mugua River) and Jade Valley. The buildings have a Taroko aboriginal architectural style. We provide 2 person to 6 person rooms which are comfortable, spacious, bright, and simple. All the rooms have good views. The viewing platform in front of the home stay enjoys expansive views of the Papaya River. Standing here opens the mind. In addition, the observatory next to the fish pond is the best place for relaxing the mind and soul, where you can be caressed by the breeze as you soak up the country charm. The Tong Men Community is only 15 km away from the city (Hualien Train Station), however Mu Gu Mu Yu Home Stay’s favorable geographical location, with  the mountains and mountain mist, and the winding river bed of the Papaya River and Taroko tribe buildings with aborigine totems, giving you a different lodging and vacation space. We welcome you to enjoy the life and culture of the Taroko tribe and embrace the beautiful environment of Mother Nature, relax, and get away from the city hubbub.

Hotels.Description: Here, the mountains are close; here, the clouds are right in front of you; here, the butterflies dance carefree through the air; here, nature is right by your side. A-Kuei’s House Bed & Breakfast is only a half-hour drive from Sanxia Old Street, and the ability to so easily enjoy the embrace of nature and the mountains comes as quite the surprise to many! Over 10 years ago, A-Kuei was looking for a place to retire, finally settling on this slice of land. Now, we hope that you’ll find “A-Kuei’s House” a place to unwind and return to the embrace of Mother Nature as the natural scenery nourishes your soul and spirit.
