Hotels.Description: Located at the altitude of 2,000 meters, The Cotswolds Villa is just 500 meters away from Cingjing Farm (aka Qingjing Farm), and 20 meters from the bus stop (Operated by Nantou Bus). It only takes about 40 minutes drive (25KM) from the B&B to the famous Hehuan Mountains.The hosts—Daisy & Asungo, who were just ordinary white colars based in Taichung, founded the property that resembles the Cotswolds of the UK.The Cotswolds Villa is the first building in Cinjing built to be earthquake resistant (SRC). From the chimney caps handcrafted by the local pottery master, the vintage furniture carved from mahogany, to imported French paintings, Daisy & Asungo carefully decorate the property in and out, and surround the villa with various cypresses, maples, and cherry trees—with a hint of European rusticity.To ensure travelers the homey comfort, Daisy enrolled and has passed the professional training program to be a certified baker. Her daughter, Karina, who was working in semiconductor industry at TSMC, advances further and has got the highest certification as both bread & pastry chefs.Karina, who had a master degree from UC San Diego (California, USA), is an outdoor enthusiast. She loves backpacking & hiking, and would love to show their guests what Taiwan& #39;s mountains have got to offer. "Email us your plan and which nearby mountain you want to go. My friend and I can give you an in-depth and unforgettable backpacking experience in Taiwan," She adds with eyes sparklingly. The mother & daughter together knead local produce and natural ingredients (eg. persimmons, cherry blossoms, roses, beet roots…) into their breads, and served daily in the breakfast buffet. "At 16°C and with mountains in the eyes, we make our breads wholeheartedly, and welcome our guest with utmost sincerity," Daisy & Karina say proudly.

Hotels.Description: Penghu｜Migrant Intertidal GuesthouseMigratory Birds Return to Roost in their Primitive Ocean HometownYou turn into a small village before Baisha township and the road leads seamlessly straight up to the inner Penghu ocean. As for the migratory bird intertidal zone, it is unique to this ocean area and is less than 20 meters from the hostel. Migrant Intertidal Guesthouse welcomes you city birds to return to your primitive, natural seaside home.White migratory birds perched in the intertidal zoneThe irregular design of the building, like a white migratory bird preparing to take flight, is caressed by the southern summer winds. The bright, yellow beach and expansive ocean scenery in front of the guesthouse, the independent docks and the beautiful vistas of the intertidal zone; all of these ecological landscapes before your eyes fluctuate with the ebb and flow of the tide and the come and go of daylight. These elements combine into a veritable painting of priceless abundant vitality wherein, each moment, a new and moving vista appears.Besides embracing the intertidal zone along the shore in front of the guesthouse, the name of Migrant Intertidal Guesthouse originates from hosts Amy and Ken’s love of birds. They are both members of the Penghu Wild Birds Association and are passionate about everything relating to birds on the island. They also look forward to helping all their city-dwelling guests to feel as if they are returning to roost, to invite them to come back regularly to enjoy the intact natural ecosystem as well as their own oceanside home.Earnest perception of the simplest blessings and happiness “There is really nothing special about our home, as there’s nothing of note in this area. All we have is our earnest perception and appreciation.” In the words of Amy, Migrant Intertidal Guesthouse doesn’t have any ornate decorations or elaborate designs, but is rather a return to primitive natural happiness, all of which is made possible by one’s willingness to “perceive”.Open your mind and strive to perceive, then! Migrant Intertidal Guesthouse will help you open your senses and your mind, and to cultivate an even more attentive attitude toward experiencing nature. Perhaps it will happen in the morning, when welcoming the sunrise over the ocean, or perhaps when observing the A-New, the guesthouse dog, running down to the ocean to frolic excitedly in the water. Or perhaps it will come to you in the morning over breakfast when you experience the taste of Zhongji baked sesame seed-coated cakes for the first time. In any case, you’ll experience so many moving moments in this place. Nighttime exploration of intertidal pools!Yet the most unforgettable experience on offer at Migrant Intertidal Guesthouse is surely exploring the intertidal pools in the pitch-black darkness of night. Follow Ken on a magnificent intertidal nighttime adventure! Holding your flashlight, you put on shorts and sandals and, stepping over the vines on the beach, you enter the knee-high tidal pool. You catch sight of bright, silver clove fish as their slender bodies dart to and fro beneath the surface. They bump into your legs as you pass through and, before you have time to get used to this clove fish encounter, to your delighted surprise, Ken picks up a plump, round blowfish, spines protruding at all angles. If you make the trip to Migrant Intertidal Guesthouse, you simply cannot pass up the opportunity to go out with Ken to explore the abundant ecological wonders of the intertidal pools. It will be a meeting with nature that you won’t soon forget!It’s hard to imagine that, after leaving the intertidal pools and returning to the guesthouse, yet another surprise awaits: a bowl full of a summer-season delicacy - fresh oysters! You use tongs to hold the shells of the oysters while you remove the rich milky flesh. No matter how much you eat, you never get tired of these oysters, especially when washed down with a cup of draft beer. How delightful!Life is simple at Migrant Intertidal Guesthouse, yet the experience is rich and plentiful. For city-dwelling travelers who are weary of the bustle of everyday life, it is a true blessing to return to such a place, like migratory birds returning to roost each year. After visiting such a place, with spirits revitalized, you can set off to achieve your next big goal.

Hotels.Description: Once, there was a beloved local landmark—the Nanfang’ao Theatre. It was more than just a movie house; it served as a venue for Taiwanese opera performances, gatherings, teaching and knowledge exchange. In its place rose a hotel—an aged building that has stood for over 50 years, undergoing transformations under different names and styles. Today, a new story begins within its walls—Koh Tsit Kang.At Koh Tsit Kang, you’ll become neighbors with the locals, sharing in the ebb and flow of daily life under the shifting sunlight of the open-air courtyard. We epitomize the essence of Nanfang’ao without embellishment—just as it is—so that visitors can linger, immerse themselves in its culture, and sync with its rhythm. Yet, more than anything, we hope that this place serves as a harbor for you—where you can experience one day in Nanfang’ao, and another day in rhythm with the sea.

Hotels.Description: Ocean Deep Bed and Breakfast is an authentic legally-certified establishment personally operated by the former deputy head of Yilan (as well as head of Toucheng Township) and his wife. Located on the bay of the Northeast Coast National Scenic Area, it features a vast layout with a marine atmosphere and an extremely warm and accommodating living environment, with down-to-Earth countryside friendliness and a feeling of home. Hotels.Description: Hualien Revika B&B  Map Living in a busy city with heavy traffic, many days pass by in a hurry.There are many nights when I want to look up and search for the peaceful starry sky in my memory, but in the urban jungle full of high-rise buildings, There are only flashing neon lights, and I can& #39;t find the twinkling little star in the nursery rhyme.In order to escape the hustle and bustle of the city and find myself, I often travel to Hualien to enjoy the tranquility in nature that cannot be found in the city.Once, I sat quietly in the courtyard of the homestay, listening to the symphony of nature played by the croaking of frogs and the chirping of birds, watching all the subtle changes in the sky from sunrise to sunset, and under the starry sky at night, I saw countless stars. In such an environment, I seemed to have found a sense of belonging. At that moment, I realized that it was time to return to Hualien.In this way, I traveled back and forth between Hualien and Taipei just to find the place of my dreams.By chance, I came to the small village of Yuemei. At first, I didn’t have any special thoughts about it, but later, I visited it many times at different times and in different weather conditions. I couldn’t help but marvel at how much of this place there is that I have not yet seen. No matter whether it is sunny, cloudy or rainy, the changes in the mountain shapes and valleys are never the same. They really attract the eyes and make people reluctant to look away. Being in a natural environment, facing the mountains and the sea, always makes people feel small and calm. This is definitely not something that an urbanite living in a concrete jungle can easily feel.At that moment, I knew this was it, this was the place of my dreams.@revika　wechat revikabb　Booking hotline: 0937 738 452 Vivian Hualien County Government approved legal B&B No. 2130 Copyright 2017 Hualien B&B-REVIKA

Hotels.Description: A place with flourishing flowers and floral fragrances, as well as lush prosperous woods, and the owner named it Yun Shanju. Whether straight stem or hanging down, literati or graceful are all artistic bonsais created meticulously by the owner. Trees and stones are naturally inseparable, offering an alternative sentiment with garden stones or scene stones placed in the yard. The image of white geese swimming in the pool and green ducks chasing after the waves form an interesting scenery as well! Wait for you to uncover the secrets of Meinong Yun Shanju Homestay!

Hotels.Description: Yilan｜Fengchun VillaA Mountain Retreat that is Peaceful Year RoundA fine drizzle falls upon the leaves, sliding off into the pool below one drop at a time. You stand and look into the distance, and beyond the water droplets sparkling on the soft lawn, an immense scene unfolds before your eyes: layers of dark and light green leading up to mountain peaks, with a light blue stream tracing a path across it all. The clouds and mist slowly disperse, little by little revealing the mountain’s complexion. Rain or shine, this mountain retreat is peaceful year round - Fengchun Villa.A tranquil residence concealed within the mountainsAfter following a winding little road up into the mountains, you park your car and let the refreshing air encircle your nose. To one side, the main doors have been left open for you, so you stroll into the hidden territory which is Fengchun Villa. You admire the lush lawn beside the sloping road, decorated with a few European statues and wooden lawn chairs. You walk deeper into the gardens and Lilysan comes forward extending a warm greeting. Arriving at the semi-open scenic lookout space, you enjoy the tea and snacks that have been prepared for you: organic honey fragrance black tea from a nearby tea farm, dragon fruit from Fengchun Villa’s own gardens, and green bean cakes. You look out over the vast scenery before you as any worries that were hiding deep in your heart are carried away on the gentle mountain breeze.Fengchun Villa was established in 1989 when Lilysan finished her previous business and bought this vacation garden property. Nearly four acres in size, Lilysan and her family prepared and constructed it all themselves. They didn’t expect that this quiet mountain lifestyle, away from the bustle of the city, would attract many family and friends to visit. This inspired the family to construct a white, European style building to serve as a guesthouse, choosing to name it Fengchun after the pen name of an ancestor. As a way to allow the name of their ancestors’ Fengchun Trading Company to live on, they used the same enthusiasm to operate Fengchun Villa as their ancestors did their trading company.An intimate time for self-healingStepping into the house, you smell the mild fragrance of cunninghamia, a type of cypress wood imported from Laos, and it puts your mind at ease. The various guest rooms are named after local birds and are available in many different layouts to meet the different needs of travelers. Taking off your shoes, you admire the abundant greenery outside the massive windows. Reclining beside a window or walking out onto the balcony, the gentle golden light of sunset caresses your body. You pour yourself a hot cup of tea and in this way, feel the slow passage of time. You reserve the afternoon just for yourself, allowing the peaceful view to wash the exhaustion from your train of thoughts. In Fengchun Villa, besides the enjoyment of spacious interior accommodations, you can also make reservations for an infrared foot bath, sauna, or energy space experience. In the evening, the Fengchun Villa menu of rich and sumptuous mountain cuisine is sure to satisfy your taste buds and completely relax both your body and mind.Relaxed and restful mountain lifeThe gentle morning sun signals the start of a new day, urging you toward the table to enjoy a lavish breakfast. You admire the elaborate oil paintings of your host as the mountain air fills you with energy. As a part of your spontaneous vacation, you might set off with your hosts on a scavenger hunt into the mountains, or make reservations for a Chinese tea ceremony. Either of these may help you regain a healthy rhythm for your life, allowing you to experience true comfort from the bottom of your heart, and enjoy the carefree passage of time in the mountains!

Hotels.Description: Located in Zhuangwei Township, Yilan, 9G Riverside House (also known as Lanyang Riverside Stay) sits right beside the scenic Lanyang River. It’s just a 12-minute drive from the famous Luodong Night Market and Dongmen Night Market in Yilan City. With free roadside parking right outside the community, it’s the perfect stay for families or groups traveling by car.The house is available as a full-unit rental, with only one group hosted at a time, ensuring privacy and comfort. It includes two buildings—House 2 (No.1) and House 3 (No.3). Each building accommodates 8 to 16 guests, and both together can host up to 32 guests. Inside, you’ll find two double suites and two family suites, each equipped with a private bathroom, balcony, air conditioning, and TV channels. The entire property is non-smoking, and the space is bright, spacious, and designed for a relaxing stay.Rates start at NT$12,000 per night on weekdays (for 12 guests) and NT$16,000 on weekends (for 12 guests). Official receipts can be issued, making it ideal for family gatherings, reunions, or small corporate groups. The house is fully equipped with a kitchen, KTV sound system, automatic mahjong table, free Wi‑Fi, and family-friendly items like a baby bathtub, bed rail, and bottle sterilizer.Just steps from the entrance, a riverside lawn connects directly to the banks of Lanyang River, the largest river in Yilan. Guests can enjoy peaceful walks along the dike path with children, cats, or dogs—a perfect blend of nature and comfort in one ideal riverside retreat.

Hotels.Description: Sunny Villa—Our sincerity brings you a memorable journey.Sunny Villa is run by a retired teacher Mei-hui Su and her daughter-in-law Wei-rong Yang. “Sunny” is our attitude—we are always optimistic. We treat every visitor as our close friend, hoping to radiate soothing warmth anytime. On July 14, 2012, Sunny Villa was reported in Liberty Times, “Sunny Villa often sponsors local cultural and artistic activities and it puts Dongshan Section in the spotlight.” It was also chosen as one of the best stores in Tainan in 2014. Sunny Villa earnestly invites you to join our rural and humanistic feast.Director Hsu of Tainan City Government once saw our Honors Award Wall and said, “Sunny Villa is Miss Ho Yang’s (a writer) home.” Many visitors like Miss Yang’s wonderful sense of humor. Qin-han (a famous writer) complimented Miss Yang as the most attractive pictue in Sunny Villa. We often invites writers to stay here so that the visitors get the chance to have a close contact with them.In our garden, we set up a board with the word “laughchi” on it to promote the popularity of “laughchi.” On June 26, 2014, Liberty Times Net reported, “Laughchi makes Sunny Villa famous overnight. Granny Wang could’t stop laughing and she asked her son to show their utmost appreciation to the host at Sunny Villa.” Besides, we advocate jogging in the country road. We run with our visitors all around the neighborhood. In this way, our visitors can stay healthy, and the local people join us to jog every day.Our guest rooms are named after the fruits we grow. The fruits are offered to our visitors for free. We hold the activity of fruit picking on local farms. Melons, dragon fruits, papayas, watermelons, tomatos, tangerines and longans are all local products. In addition, we like to share the information about the local customs, history, and people with our visitors.Our guest rooms are all laid with costly logs. Every room is pleasantly tidy and bright. All the sheets are purely clean with the sunny odor. In each room, you can see through the octangle windows a vista of green fields and coconut palms. You can simply do nothing but sit by the windows all day long watching the breathtaking sunrise, sunset and the beautiful panoramic views. The fresh air and the quiet country life will fully relax your body and soul.Mr. Lu (a well-known antique collector) is our frequent visitor. He has come here for fifty-four times. He said, “The room is big and comfortable. I can sleep well here.” Sunny Villa is also your best choice for class gathering or honeymoon. So far, sixteen newlyweds and their relatives have lodged here. Hakohato Sadao (a Japanese backpacker) gave so much praise to our hospitality. Mitchell, the retired chief of French Tourism Bureau, has stayed here for four times. He falls in love with our cordiality and friendliness.A report in Tainan City Industry Magazine says, “Sunny Villa—Its sincerity brings every visitor a memorable journey.” Our philosophy is LPCM. Love is the power to move forward. Passion is in our blood. Cultural heritage is our mission. Miracle stories in the region are waiting for us to explore.

We’re the only one hosts in Tainan who passed the National Tour Guide.　　Local – the guest house won the official Hospitality Award　　The meaning of winning the official Hospitality Award for Taiowan One Piece Anping House is the recognition of our hearts of sharing the local life styles, special events and yummy food information with our partners. We would love to be your best local partner in your trip and share Tainan’s wonderful things with you!　　Welcome to Anping!********Easy (Free) Parking15~20 min walk – Anping Fort and the old streets, Anping Tree House, Sunset Platform (seaside)3~5 min walk – Bus Stops (2 lines: 2 and 99), fresh and yummy seafood, famous Anping Bean Jelly shop, convenience store, cafe10~20 min by bike – Taijiang ecological boat, Sicao mangrove green tunnel15~20 min by taxi (appr. $200) – Tainan Train Station, Chikan Tower (Fort Provintia), Garden Night Market, Blueprint Culture & Creative Park, Hayashi Department Store20~30 min by taxi – Tucheng Orthodox Luermen Matsu Temple, Salt Mountain and salt field village

Hotels.Description: Pingtung｜Red Garden ResortA blooming secret garden in the south of TaiwanYou pass through Kenting’s bustling main street and head toward Sail Rock. The number of pedestrians gradually decreases until, finally, your only company is the sunny skyline along the coastal highway. You make a sudden turn up a sloping gravel lane and continue unhurriedly along until your eyes light up at the sight before you: behold Red Garden Resort.An exquisite garden abloom with vibrant lifeRed Garden Resort is hidden down a little alley in Sail Rock. Open the gate and you are greeted by a little garden facing out over the sea which, as the name implies, is full of colorful red flowers. Though small in size, the terrace is delicate and orderly, arranged into multiple impressive layers so that the style of the garden changes depending on where you stand. Small stone carvings imported from Bali hide between blossoming shrubs; here a tranquil Buddha, there a calm little crocodile. It’s as if they are keeping company with the flowers or playing with the travelers. No matter day or night, this enchanting venue allows you to linger a long, long time.In keeping with the design of the gardens, the dwelling of Red Garden Resort is equally bright and romantic. Walls are accentuated with passionate orange and bright yellow paint, and are covered with winding, dark green vines. Looking up at the windows of the top floor left slightly ajar, you might imagine this to be the Taiwanese abode of Rapunzel, unravelling her long, silk-like hair out those windows day and night, awaiting the arrival of her prince charming.An exquisite and enchanting Southeast Asian fairy taleAn ingenious mix of exotic decorations from Bali and various other indigenous cultures greets you as you step indoors, giving Red Garden Resort a uniquely tropical, southern style, at once subdued yet bold. The bathrooms exhibit clay bottles of shampoo and shower gel, and volcanic rock flooring, the varied heights of the design elements echoing the multi-level composition of the gardens outside. Lying on the white bedding of the large wooden bed late at night, you hear the faint lapping of waves against the seashore. The subtle yellow lighting, the fresh cut flowers and the scent of sandalwood in the air are so charming that you feel loathe to let sleep overtake you.Your hostess Amy, in her long, flowing skirt, is the beautiful caretaker of this elegant garden. Passionate and strong, Amy was born and raised in Kenting. Giving up her dream of being a professional soccer player, her athletic vigor and perseverance allowed her to go from serving in a hotel restaurant to become an apprentice at another establishment opened by the hotel chef where she learned to cook and to speak English. She later took charge of her own restaurant, at which time she met her true love, an Englishman named Neil. Red Garden Resort is the fruit of their labor, bearing witness to their good fortune and happiness.Blooming in the hearts of travelersOriginally employed in the field of shipbuilding design, Neil found himself making frequent trips to Taiwan. An avid surfer, he would escape to the beaches of Kenting nearly every week. It was on one of those trips that he met Amy, who was working in a restaurant he patronized. Their exotic foreign romance culminated in Neil giving up his career to stay in Taiwan and start a family with Amy. At that time, Amy was growing increasingly weary of her hectic restaurant job, and began to imagine the contentment of a leisurely lifestyle in a garden paradise. In order to fulfill his wife’s dreams, Neil once again took up his design profession. He drew up all the designs and oversaw the construction work himself. The details of Red Garden Resort took shape in each meticulously drawn blueprint, as if with each stroke of his pen, Neil was bringing his commitment to Amy to life, each gorgeous flower nurtured with his love for her. So long as they hold hands, the flowers in their garden will bloom eternally in brilliant red.When you stay at Red Garden Resort, you feel like you’ve arrived at your own private villa. The atmosphere gives travelers the warm sensation of returning home for the holidays. As you enjoy a delicious breakfast under the garden trellis, the sea breeze caresses your skin and the sound of ocean waves rolls in the distance. Sometimes, you might find yourself lounging in a garden chair with a good book, at others strolling the beach in the sunshine. Passing your days in such cordial comfort, you feel utterly free. For over ten years, it is precisely this secret that Red Garden Resort has been planting in the hearts of travelers.

From Jin An Inn to Jun An Hotel, and now as Menting Roushi, it has carried the marks of over half a century, witnessing the rise and fall of eras and the passing of generations.In recent years, as modern hotels have emerged, this old inn slowly faded from the spotlight and even shifted to long-term rentals at one point. It wasn’t until 2019 that a passionate young team took over. Dedicated to preserving the original spirit of the hotel, they began to brush away the dust and breathe new life into it. Along the way, they carefully retained many elements with period character — such as wooden windows and vintage bathtubs — blending them with fresh design concepts and craftsmanship. The result is a warm, simple, and heartfelt space full of stories and a sense of nostalgia.

Hotels.Description: Tainan｜Chung Fu Inn Invigoration relay station for Tainan visitorsNo sooner do you leave the Tainan Train Station than the warm southern sun welcomes you. Rent a scooter at a nearby dealership, turn the ignition and set off! Turning into the lane, you see a three-story townhouse with ornate iron window grates, vestiges of former times. You push the wooden doors and enter Tainan’s Chung Fu Inn!Preserving the enchanting iron window grates of a townhouseChung Fu Inn is co-owned by a designer from Taipei and a building contractor from Jiayi. They were attending a wedding banquet in Tainan when the old local townhouses caught their eye. They went on to apply their respective specialties in refurbishing it and named it Chung Fu Inn, using one character from each of their names.Each of Chung Fu Inn’s two townhouses preserves the original brick walls and ornate iron window grates. Once you enter the lobby, you are greeted by antique Chinese medicine cabinets and an ancient television set, which belong to the owners’ personal collections. As you climb the stairs in the Da Fu building, you see the ornate cement air vents along the top of the hallway walls. The stairwell of the outbuilding has been painted in rich and various colors, giving the old edifice a novel and vivid look.In the Da Fu building, antique wooden frames are reborn as partition screens to divide the interior of the Tranquil Room. In the Shu Huo Room, an entire wall of ornate iron window grates creates charming inverted patterns in the sunlight. Inside the outbuilding, the decor of the little Qing Xin Room incorporates vivid blue wall paint and wood-framed cabinets. Raise your head as you walk up the stairs to the third floor, and you are greeted by an array of fluttering, white butterflies. When you sit in the old rocking chair in Small Balcony Room, the butterflies will guide you in recollections of beautiful bygone times.Wooden doors, tatami mats, antique sofasBeyond the townhouses, you find two wooden single-storey houses as you enter the alley near the park, each of which are rented by one party at a time. The living room of Villa Number 45 is furnished with two retro sofas, and an elevated room to one side offers you a place to sit and rest. Take the steps onto the second floor and find a tatami sleeping area under the slanted roof, where you enjoy the air made warm and fragrant by the sunlight.Across the way sits Villa Number 47, with a similar Japanese layout and decorative elements. The bathtub on the first floor is remarkable, but even more surprising is the polished bar counter at the far end of the living room! After night falls, a cork pops out of a bottle of red wine and glasses are poured one-third full. It’s bottoms up in a toast to friendship!Now this is the passion of Tainan! When it comes to Tainan, the most anticipated part for most people is all the delicious and diverse foods. Chung Fu Inn is assisted in this regard by a varied host of well-known snack vendors. Not only do the owners of Chung Fu Inn offer recommendations for local scenic spots but they are even considerate enough to prepare local refreshments for their guests. The feeling of friendship is richly felt at Chung Fu Inn and leaves an indelible impression of Tainan. Chung Fu Inn won’t be the last stop on your journey, but rather a relay station where you can rest and recharge. Take the cordiality of Tainan with you today as you mount your scooter, turn the key and set off on the next leg of your adventure!

Hotels.Description: Blue Lagoon Penghu B&B sits near the tidal belt and Chenggong Reservoir, and the wetlands are home to all kinds of migratory birds all year round. With its excellent location, Blue Lagoon’s windows are like observatories for the local bird life, making it a popular choice with nature lovers. The carefully landscaped environs include historical water vats, ox-carts (a sight gradually disappearing from modern Penghu), windmills spinning in the wind, and even a barbeque area. The authentic antique Penghu flavor of Blue Lagoon makes it stand out from the competition.The walls of the B&B are adorned with murals painted with the help of the neighborhood elementary school, and inside the lobby are tables and chairs lined up for the dining pleasure of the guests. Upstairs are chairs available for a cool night’s stargazing, and the solar water heater helps save energy and do our part for the environment. Two-person and four-person rooms are available, as well as the option to rent the entire building, and the bedding is themed around pure white, giving an air of class and cleanliness, while the bathrooms are divided into wet and dry sections. Blue Lagoon is also convenient to the city, as well as for getting to Beihuan and Huxi, and the planes taking off and landing nearby make for an amazing sight.

Our rooms are perfect for friends, families, married couples, and passionate lovers, and we have invested a great deal of effort to help our guests feel right at home. Holidays should provide an enjoyable getaway experience, and the cozy environment will help provide warmth and bring people closer while eliminating pent up stress. We are also pursuing continuing improvements to this new B&B to ensure its healthy, lovely growth! This B&B is located on a quiet street with refreshing air and is extremely close (just a 3 to 5-minute walk ^0^) to the Tourist Wharf and bustling boulevard. We are right next to a butterfly garden, a perfect place to hold delightful conversations with friends and family. Preparing quiet, clean and comfortable rooms for friends coming from afar to enjoy meditation rest for a few nights is truly a happy thing. Sharing is a joy,have a good sleep, and then enjoy the light, healthy, nutritious breakfast.      The hostess has a C class bartending license and a baking certificate will prepare you a glass of drink, handmade biscuits, and special toast.      The host of the house, who loves nature, is willing to share with you his experiences in natural ecosystems, from plants to animals, and covering the arts, humanities, and green building.

Standard occupancy is for two guests, with an additional charge of NT$1,000 per person. For groups of up to five, extra beds are not provided, and the sofa bed (with the same mattress quality) will be used as an additional sleeping space.
Our most popular room type, "Country Lane," offers a spacious 26-ping layout spread over two floors. The room features three large floor-to-ceiling windows and dual-sided sunrise balconies, with an ensuite bathroom and TV on each floor.
Connected by an outdoor staircase, the room offers unrestricted access, embodying the freedom and ease of travel.
A sunken bathtub is also available for a relaxing soak.
With a smile on your face,
Hum a little country tune.
Let your thoughts soar on the evening breeze.

Let go of all your sadness and gloom,
As they drift away with the evening breeze.
Forgotten on the country lane.

Country Lane is the most unique space in the entire building. The L-shaped thin folded steel structure staircase cleverly connects the two floors. The lower floor is an open living space with a large L-shaped sofa, perfect for lounging or sleeping, and can be converted into a double bed as needed. The upper floor is a spacious sleeping area with a cozy corner for daydreaming. Step out onto the balcony for a leisurely stroll or swing on the swing as you feel the breeze. The floor-to-ceiling glass windows on three sides offer stunning views, allowing you to enjoy the company of the sun, moon, and stars.

With a blue sky and a setting sun in your heart, and colorful clouds as the evening's gown, let go of all your sadness and gloom, as they drift away with the evening breeze. Forgotten on the country lane! This is the perfect mood for this space...

Xanado Xiao Wu Lai Vacation Village is located in Taoyuan Township. In 1971 responding to the request for assistance from mountaineering friends, the innkeeper registered the Village in 2003 and became the first legitimate characteristic B&B in Taoyuan County and a good merchant of the National Travel Card. The innkeeper would like to provide guests a comfortable, relaxing, leisure trip, and hope that he can bring people closer to nature for temporarily forgetting urban hubbub, finding peace of mind, and enjoying the mind feast.   Because natural forces originate from the forest, Xiao Wulai Scenic Area includes many spectacular attractions, and most attractions are within walking distance from the Xiao Wulai Vacation Village. Walking along the forest trail, you can reach the most famous Xiao Wulai Waterfalls, directly enjoy the Phytoncide emitted from the forest and the negative air ionization therapy released from the waterfalls.   In July 2011, a "Skywalk," similar to the concept of the Grand Canyon Skywalk, just above the Xiao Wulai Waterfalls, was opened to the public, where tourists can watch Xiao Wulai Waterfalls from above. The trail is paved with transparent glasses to give more different excitements.

"Mountain Fish Water Boutigue Hotel" is far better than its competitors by offering more than 20 rooms. With the advantages of room interior design and conference venue capable of accommodating up to 100 people, we are the only option in Jiji when it comes to company or group tours and meetings! "Mountain Fish Water Boutigue Hotel (formerly Jiji Resorts) is located closely to the Jiji Township Swimming Pool. Furthermore, the guests will be treated to a memorable accommodation experience through the relaxing atmosphere and comprehensive, thoughtful service.(Google Map) The brand and concept is inspired by the flower garden to portray the image of bees diligently collecting pollen, symbolizing industriousness and vitality, just like enthusiastic travelers from all over the world; although they are busy expanding their businesses or traveling everywhere, they must ultimately come home. As a brand new label, Bee House welcomes travelers worldwide to come back to the warmth of home through Scandinavian minimalism, comfort, cozy ambiance and thoughtful services. The overall spatial design employs warm, contrasting hues with a touch of vibrant colors to present a sense of liveliness and playfulness. In the lobby, the wood grain and vacant spaces create an aura of warmth and leisure through the ingenious lighting arrangement. Such ingenuities are abundant inside and outside the hotel. For example, the beehive’s hexagonal structure is used as the source of visual planning to fully embody express the concept and imagery of the Bee House. The comfortable space is matched with a comfortable recreational space, classic sofa and wooden furniture to create the refreshing, natural and unadulterated ambiance that has warmed the hearts of many a traveler! Bee House(Taipei Station Branch ) has six stories and 32 well appointed guestrooms with natural, rustic elements as well as sunshine-like radiance and dazzling colors to create painting-like vibrant colors. The unique and cleverly executed home décor will bring surprise and a smile on your face. At the same time, the Garden Café on the first floor ,From the generous wood accents of its interior, to the elegantly simple chandeliers, Garden Café embodies the sophistication of the Scandinavian style café.  Enjoy a hand crafted specialty coffee or espresso masterpiece in our specially commissioned handmade mugs and cups, and you will feel the warmth of every sip right down to your heart and soul.  Come in and be prepared to be greeted with the pleasant aromas of flower, fruit, tea and coffee, and thoroughly enjoy your precious moment of peace and comfort in the relaxed warmth of Garden Café. The Bakery serves mainly exquisite, European-style desserts and breads to satisfy the palate of our guests. Furthermore, in order to cater to our guests’ every need, we have created Internet services in the lobby together with other facilities such as launderette, play room, and self-help snack bar. We would like to provide you a comfortable accommodation and dining environment. Just like coming home, travelers will feel total relaxation of the body, mind and spirit.

Hotels.Description: Hotel located in Taitung CountyThe hotel logo adopts the four letters GAYA to form the Chinese hieroglyph of “tidal” this word. The blue G stands for the vast Pacific Ocean, the yellow A stands for the land that is full of golden rice fields, the red Y stands for the cultural integration of diverse ethnic groups in Taitung, and the green A stands for the central Embraced by the mountains, coasts and mountains.THE GAYA HOTEL Taitung determines to provide an ideal accommodation experience with a fusion of Taitung’s local culture and modern design concepts Located at the foot of Liyu (Carp fish) Mountain in Taitung, the city center where local Taitung folks are living with.  The old bricks that carried history telling the story of the past decades.  THE GAYA HOTEL site was the Taitung local tax bureau.  Adopting and transforming these old bricks and re-engraved into modern design, the hotel building inherits the familiar emotions of Taitung people.  THE GAYA HOTEL Taitung reappeared in 2017, detailing the history, combining the locality, and savoring the arts and culture.THE GAYA HOTEL emphasizes cultural impression, with mountains, ridges, streams, oceans, unique natural landscapes and aboriginal culture in Taitung.  Architect Mr. Yu-Ching YEH, experts at integrating old stories into design, has successfully designed and built several successful design hotels in Bangkok.  Based on Taitung’s rich and diverse natural and cultural heritage, he exudes the spirit of Taitung people’s kindness, honesty and harmony with nature.  The new design of THE GAYA HOTEL building and interior space adopts the dark and calm black bamboo forest in the reception hall, creates an oriental tranquility abmiance, and precipitates the aesthetics of Zen. Through the unique elements of Taitung, such as local delicacy, music, literature, modern art, aboriginal tribal life, and more, to create the brand THE GAYA HOTEL, bringing travelers a comfortable and profound accommodation experience.

Hotels.Description: Our 120-room CityInn Fuxing North has distinguished itself from other CityInn hotels that embrace the vivid tone. We have invited architecture crew from Japan to carry out the work of architectural concrete as its façade, and we have sought interpretations for remarkable Oriental Zen from Jun-Liang Chen, the country’s ablest curator, for the interior. The fresh and simple design here merges uninhibitedness and mellowness; travellers will have a comfortable rest and experience tranquility in the bustle of the city at its best. This is where you could collect yourself at the end of the day. Neighboring Taipei Songshan Airport and Neihu Technology Park, CityInn Fuxing North is only a two-minute walk from MRT Zhongshan Junior High School. All the famous sites in Taipei City are easily accessible by MRT here, and you will find all sorts of local cuisines at your choice on Jinzhou Street nearby; if you would like to experience the cultural atmosphere, you could take a walk to Minsheng Community to visit the characteristic coffee shops and creative design shops. The perfect location of CityInn Fuxing North not only suffices the convenient transportation needed for business and travel, but also meets the need of in-depth travel in Taipei City. With the energy and friendly smiles brought by our passionate receptionists, along with ample amenities, we offer great service like CityInn hotels always do. We aim to make a fashionable stay at an affordable price for every guest, and to make all our guests feel at home.

In 1981, a row of two buildings with a total of 12 households were built on the north side of the "Jingzijiao" temple, commonly known as "12 Households". Not only is SC HOTEL within walking distance to Taipei Main Station, the nearby 3 MRT lines also offer easy access to the neighboring Nanxi and Hua Yin shopping districts. The "Tiao Tong Commercial District" of ZhongShan North Road is known for its exotic neighborhood character reminiscent of the 1900s when Taiwan was under Japanese rule. At night, we encourage you to explore the narrow alleys filled with popular restaurants and pubs. In recent years, a large number of Taiwanese and Japanese ramen shops have made this neighborhood their home, creating charming fusion of pop culture and nostalgia. Our team is devoted to building a leisure culture, a comfortable atmosphere for wary travelers to rest and relax. Allow SC HOTEL clean and simple design to protect you from the noise and stress of the city, so you can immerse yourself in the beauty of the "Tiao Tong" neighborhood. Whether you're traveling for business or leisure, SC HOTEL can be your "home away from home" and you're always welcome!

Hotels.Description: Taitung｜Coastline AzureA long coast of unbroken ocean blueOne clear afternoon, you rush along Taiwan’s East coast Highway 11. As you round a corner, the vast, grassy landscape stretches out ahead of you under an azure sky. In the middle of this magnificent scene sits a welcoming, white guesthouse, resembling a countryside sketch from a European diary. Today, between the mountain and the sea, discover -- Coastline Azure. The elegance of European country lifeWalking up to Coastline Azure along the courtyard path, you see dogs at play on the lawn nearby. Remove your shoes and enter the lobby where refined leather seating and wooden furniture bespeak of the classic country life. Shirley, the owner of Coastline Azure, has decorated this space with her favorite owl imagery as well as local works of art. These eclectic elements work seamlessly together to create a style which is totally Shirley. Her floral print dress and graceful smile are as warm and bright as today’s sunshine. Shirley skillfully manages every detail at Coastline Azure, from the meticulous dinner table arrangements to the inspired decor of each room. Once a part of the bustling world of business, Shirley’s extraordinary sense brought her great success as the chief financial officer of such distinguished companies as Pizza Hut, China Synthetic Rubber Corporation and Levi’s. At the peak of her business career, Shirley also experienced the greatest mental and physical stress of her entire life. After a 21-day period of continuous work with no time off, she realized that without a doubt health turns out to be the greatest wealth. She vowed to give up her busy career and return to a simple life. A love of the Pacific Ocean led her to seek out property in Taidong, with a view of Green Island on the horizon, where she would build her own guesthouse. At Coastline Azure, Shirley delights in leading travellers back into a slower, simpler rhythm where they can enjoy a broad slice of endless azure blue. A beautiful vacation in the company of mountains and sea “We only use world-champion roast coffee beans in our house! If you’re lucky, who’s to say you won’t end up with premium Geisha coffee in your cup!” Working from her own ample experience, seasoned traveler Shirley aims to provide her guests with nothing but the best. On a leisurely afternoon, guests are welcomed by a taste of her own afternoon tea preparations: an array of exquisite and delicious snacks on a wooden platter, such as cream puffs with cool filling, handmade brownies, and Isigny butter cookies accompanied by a cup of freshly brewed coffee. Guests arriving at Coastline Azure ought to slow down and savour the fine flavor of their vacation. On the second floor, Coastline Azure has two- and four-person rooms available. Each room derives its name from the movement of the sun and moon through the sky. In the rooms called “Moon Companion” and “Star Gazing”, the warm yellow glow of the moon and the resplendent stars illuminates the pitch-black night sky. You can greet the first rays of dawn as you sit enveloped by the boundless ocean vista in rooms with the names “Listen to the Ocean” and “Sunrise”. Shirley’s meticulous planning of the small two-person loft allows guests to soak in exclusive tranquility as they sit quietly near windows, overlooking the ocean. After a night in such a room, you’ll understand that the connection to the landscape is the best part about this place. Step out onto the spacious balcony where the rhythmic slap of the waves sounds nearby and revel in the exquisite company of the sun, moon, and stars. Living by the boundless water If you feel like an even farther view, then ascend to the rooftop patio and gaze into the distance. At a glance, take in the entire coastline from Jinzun in the North to Fugang in the South. Turn toward the west and behold the mighty and continuous ridge of the mountain range. Wrapped in the embrace of both mountains and sea, forget your worries and return to the purity of yourself. With your spirit enriched and refreshed by nature, the exhaustion you brought with you has long since disappeared without a trace. At Coastline Azure, put contentment back in your step as you walk abreast the mountains and the sea and embark on your next journey.

Hotels.Description: "Ma chawu" in Pinayuanan means "Excellent" The owner was a teacher before. She attended a beverage preparation course for some reason. After she learned the techniques, she prepared one cup of tea for her husband someday. Her husband felt tasty after drinking and said "Ma chawu" to praise her! After the owner obtained the certificate of beverage preparation, she established a beverage shop named "Ma chawu" in her village, offering tea, snacks, coffee, and locally produced fruit/vegetable juice which are loved by neighbors and visitors alike. From the very beginning, the “Ma chawu Homestay” was a beverage store. Later, the owner started realizing that the Sapulju Tribal Village where he lives is an environment mingling beautiful natural scenery and abundant crops that outsiders visit frequently. To provide more complete services, the owner and her husband began the plan to run a homestay service. The brand-new “Ma chawu Homestay” is located at a site facing the sea and embraced by the hill at the foot of Jing Jeng Mountain. It overlooks the Pacific Ocean to welcome the first dawn in Eastern Taiwan. The homestay is simple, clean-cut and colorful in outer appearance in presenting stylish artistic beauty. Native indigenous features give this  innovative and modern homestay an authentic local touch. The “Ma chawu Homestay” is a B&B facility full of native features. By combining agricultural and indigenous art, it provides a cozy residential environment. Guests can also savor local agricultural produce and delicately prepared beverages to experience the native culture. Come and visit “Ma chawu Homestay”. It provides you an experience that combines stunning views, wonderful flavors, spiritual relaxation, and soulful joy.

Hotels.Description: Bamboo House is a traditional southern Chinese courtyard house hidden in bamboo forests at Zhushan, Nantou. With more than half of a century long history, the building was out of shape until recent years. Winston Lin, after years of working around the world, returned to his home village and renovated the house he grew up in. Hotels.Description: Taroko Home Stay is situated near Taroko Gorge, only a 3 minute drive from Taroko National Park. You can view the green mountains from afar and white clouds  spread across the sky. Deeply inhale the fresh air of Taroko Gorge to allow the good mountain and good water to put you in a positive frame of mind. Taroko Home Stay, situated in Taroko National Park, not only has a comfortable and elegant lodging environment, the park offers superb mountain and gorge scenery. The front yard of the home stay is an open grass area where you can run and play all you want. Holding group activities here is also a good option. This home stay with mountain and ocean charm has comfortable and warm rooms; even inside you can smell the fragrance of the grass outside the windows. Through the window next to the bedside, mountain scenery stretches as far as the eye can see. Slow down and take a relaxing Taroko trip, enjoying the quiet countryside life. At night, you can lay on the grass and watch the stars, and hear the happy singing of insects. On the misty mountain, the attracted gaze, moved soul, and the already merged body, all seem to belong to nature. What kind of feeling is that? I look into the distance. The mountains rise like giant towers, partially hidden by a misty shroud. The green skin of mountain goes through white fog, and makes the sky hazy. It seems like I am surrounded by clouds. At this time, not only am I relaxed, I sit on the green grass, and look at the sky. I rest for awhile at the juncture of blue sea and sky. Here, I am only resting for a while; and then, with the returning steps, the reddish afterglow on the other side of the mountain perhaps brings another state of mind.

Hotels.Description: Sitting across from a park amid the bustling city, PARK LEES does not simply borrow from the serenity of the park but rather uses this asset to explore our natural disposition and the soul’s longing for repose. Our hotel offers travelers an abode to be themselves and rejuvenate, close to yet separate from the urban hubbub. We hope that business travelers and tourists alike enjoy our minimalist design and attentive service and derive a sense of quiet peace and renewed energy from the park across the street.Architectural appearanceThe hotel is decorated with a simple color palette of black and white paired with gray hues, and fluid lines that dress the hotel in an elegant architectural cloak, while a crown of irregular black iron sculptural forms around the roof create a playful transition between the building and the sky above. The lanterns in the park make the hotel’s logo light up, like a beacon beckoning the travelers home to their haven in the harbor city of Kaohsiung. In the pavement outside the lobby doors, etched copper plates mark the latitude and longitude of the location. A green building The building’s exterior surface is coated with a thermal insulation layer, while gray-scale reinforced glass is applied throughout to block part of the heat. The rooftop is laid with insulation tiles, green plants, and solar panels that power the hotel’s exterior lighting at night. The building’s air conditioning and hot water use a heat pump and ice water heat recovery system, which reduces energy consumption. Inside and outside, high-performance LED lighting is used under a KNX (smart building) system and software which manages the light sources for different zones and times.Taking the "traveler's autonomous space" as the main axis, connecting each environment with coherent color temperature and line light and shadow, large-area floor-to-ceiling windows echo the outdoor sunshine and green, transparent gray glass and mirrors in the bathroom, simple and comfortable white desktop, casual details Ingenuity creates a stylish, comfortable and complete sophisticated space, with wood, iron, rock, light and shadow, and fine-quality elements integrated into the sensory design.

We always have a dream that we can develop a park belonging to us to reserve the forests and ecological lands, and to share with the traveling people. Therefore, in 2000, we started to work on Sun Green Holiday& #39;s soil preparation, planning of lines of motion, housing construction, and planting trees, bit by bit, to create an ecological Bed & Breakfast. In the 2002 Spring Festival, the operation of the B&B was officially started.    Rows of sweet-scented Osmanthus forest, camellias, huge Buddha cutters with maple trees, and other trees surround around the Sun Green Holiday, adding a bit more pastoral green to it. The retained trees to build the ecological environment in those days now seem to create a paradise for Sun Green Holiday. After so many years, Sun Green Holiday, a B&B in Sanyi, has continured changing and developing, and the young second generation has joined in with unique ideas that blending a lot of hand woodworking, painting, with spatial design, creating more colorful atmosphere to the B&B.    Cordial and passionate services are our only constant adherence, and we hope to introduce a more local culture of Sanyi to everyone.

Hotels.Description: Nan Chian Jade Garden is located in Nanzhuang, amid beautiful verdant countryside beside the road leading to Donghe, about 1 km from the Nanzhuang Old Street. It is a high quality Bed and Breakfast with convenient transportation and vast field of view. The appearance of Nan Chian Jade Garden is a European style of North America with a design reflecting the innkeeper& #39;s taste and intention, the overall feeling is elegant, sophisticated, and the presentation of the flow of light and shadow in the space varying with time, as well as the poetic beauties of the scenery changing window by window, makes you feel refreshing like being in a home of your earnest wish.   Here, you can enjoy the owner& #39;s art collection, and also the music of creeks, while leisurely strolling in the mountains and valleys, or sip a cup of coffee while chatting with friends, accompanying by the natural sounds of surrounding brook. For people like you who love nature, you can bathe yourself in the forest Phytoncide to feel the green fairy dancing in your body. Or, take a hike on old trails to flex your motor nerve. If, an exciting journey to Nanzhuang natural and cultural eco-tour is what you have expected, in addition to experiencing the simplicity of Hakka mien and cuisine, you can study the historical relics and tribal cultures of Saisiyat and Atayal tribes, or visit the Penglai River (Creek) fish conservation trails that you can not miss. Overnight Nen Chian Jade Garden, you can enjoy the night view of the landscape surrounding streets and the sparkling starry sky.   Nan Chian Jade Garden is a B&B certified by SGS, a certified Taiwan Host by the Tourism Bureau, MOTC, and a four-star B&B assessed by the Miaoli County Government. In short, the well-crafted Nan Chian Jade Garden is a name you can trust and a place to visit. Please make an appointment for your arrival to share the mountain quiet life together.

Hotels.Description: Manman Classic Hall is a traditional Fujian-style double-fall house. The front stone masonry is in a special hexagonal shape. The roof trusses are made of fir. Red bricks are not used much. The dragon-protecting kitchen has windows made of red bricks. You can see the outside from the inside. You can't see the inside from the outside; the layout includes two front and back halls, an atrium, a dragon-protecting courtyard and four guest rooms, two of which are large attic rooms, suitable for family accommodation. Under the elegant appearance of an ancient house in southern Fujian, each room is equipped with an LCD TV. The bathroom space is equipped with modern equipment and a flush toilet. The quality of bath towels and towels is comparable to that of a five-star hotel, allowing tourists to experience the nostalgic style of an ancient house. In addition, you can also enjoy the convenience and quality of modern life. At night, sit in the atrium, enjoy the cool air, chat, and look up at the stars and moon. The aesthetics and wisdom of these ancient architectural designs are best lived in so that you can slowly appreciate the classical and elegant beauty of life.

Hotels.Description: Coexisting with nature is the way to gain an experience of limitless wonder. Come to Yuchic (Yuchi), a place surrounded by mountains, and Sun Moon Lake, a place of quiet, unrivalled beauty that will sweep away all your cares and worries. Nunu Haus Guest House, located in this area, features an all-white building adorned with a wooden roof and window frame, resembling a European villa that sprung out of nature itself. Built with environmentally-friendly materials and solar powered, it is a green building that was created from and gives back to nature, providing a comfortable, all-natural atmosphere where people can lose themselves in the quiet ease of the scenery. Covering a large area, Nunu Haus Guest House features recreational facilities such as an outdoor area, BBQ area, and scenic observation deck. Brew a pot of tea and have a casual chat with friends in the outdoor area, or have a good time at the BBQ area. Enter the unique, elegantly designed building, where the owner’s care and thoughtfulness is apparent in every corner. The European decoration displays extraordinary class without losing its warm touch, and the suite rooms are brightly-lit, spacious, and possess an elegant, sincere atmosphere, making guests feel comfortable and at home. Emphasizing ecological preservation and environmental maintenance, Nunu Haus Guest House features not only a lush green outdoor area but glimpses of rare insects and animals, bringing new surprises to your travels. Don’t wait –plan a vacation to come enjoy the comfort and seclusion of a place surrounded by mountains, where you can relax and enjoy a comfortable break! Hotels.Description: It is a ocean paradise for the dialogue between mountains and the sea. Sea-hi B&B used to be the exotic scenes for filming television drama "Tokyo Juliet." Because here is only about 200 meters from the sea and the pebble beach. A dark house with a pitched roof sits on a green land, matched with a small house of European style and with elegant Japanese brick walls. A white cafe on the terrace, the house, surrounded by green grasses, banana, coconut, and flowers, exudes a lazy, relaxed, and free atmosphere. It is like being in romantic southern Aegean Sea or the Maldives in the Indian Ocean.   "Sea-hi B&B" is located in the East Coast National Scenic Area of Taiwan, with back to the hillside (to the east of Coast Mountains) and facing the sea (on the left bank of the Pacific Ocean), and is a garden architecture covering an area of ​​about 9,900 square meters, enclosed in a whole, a seaside landscape paradise. Staying here makes your secular anxieties suddenly vanished and feel the incomparable happiness, by listening to the sounds of waves, chasing waves, stargazing, moon gazing, watching the rising sun, the changing clouds, coming and going vessels, flying gulls and herons, or enjoy coffee and meals with distinctive flavors, or just watching the sea venting. Such a happy garden is waiting for people of same karma to share.

Hotels.Description: Its brilliant to stay at our house!The Rainbow Bridge Home-stayThe flourishing scenes have enriched the Rainbow Bridge Home-stay via various colors of blooming.  You would see the vivid red brought by the Japanese maples and gradient purple of Irises and wisterias.  The mediating green of the Water lilies and Pines.  Our nice coffee has added a color of brown with unforgettable coffee scent.  Furthermore, our Silk flowers, Rhododendrons and Hydrangeas play the stimulating roles to enrich the unique view of the Rainbow Bridge Home-stay.Locating at the center of the Award-Winning village for it& #39;s thriving and Eco-friendly, San Zhi Village.  Through the years of conservation, we proudly introduce you a rich and healthy ecology which is only in San Zhi.  A river that sometimes has the ducks comfortably swimming in it while an eagle has been seen few times on the sky.  With love and effort, we have successfully developed all kinds of nature plants.  At Rainbow Bridge Home-stay, you could be really surprised by the flourishing scene of the Maples, Wisterias, Water lilies, Irises, Silk flowers, Pines and Calamus.   Our unique garden always attracts heaps photographers over to take photos and artists to sketch during the Spring season. At Rainbow Bridge Home-stay, please enjoy the privilege of being our precious guest.  Our hospitable staff always welcome the guests with the home-baked coffee and herbal tea and they are out of charge. Have a walk in the Village for a good meditation, moreover, soak your feet into the nice chill river to feel really fresh.  We would like to also invite you to our wall-painting gallery which has been contributed by the Award-Winning artists.   Fulfilling your tummy next morning with our buffet-style breakfast.  Providing with the choices of Chinese and Western breakfasts.  All dishes are organic and some are from our own farm.  You would be guaranteed of a healthy and organic eating style.  In addition to the breakfast, we accept the dinner reservation and providing you with the choices of seafood, steak, seasonal vegetables and other oriental cuisines such as Japanese and Vietnam cuisines. Exciting with the great convenience to reach other famous scenery, e.g. Whit Sand Bay, Yehliu Geopark, Tamsui Old Street, and Cianshuei Bay.  Our friendly staff would like to assist you with the sight seeing guide and please feel free to ask us. The day since we have opened the Rainbow Bridge Home-stay, we have had many guests returned to stay again with us.  Our guest friends are not only for locals, but also from USA, New Zealand, Germany and England.  We appreciate everything that has given to us.  Especially thank to our lovely guests, thank you so much.  We would like to continue our passionate and love on this Home-stay.  Your enjoyment in the experience staying with us is the most important thing and the priority to us.  Thank you so much.

Hotels.Description: The three brothers (Huang Jiande, the eldest, Huang Jianchu, the second, and Huang Jianlong, the youngest), born in a family in farming for generations of Aboriginal small tribe, cherish the memory of the living environment of their innocent, passionate childhood of without lights, playing in the rice fields, going to school barefooted, feeding pigs, watering vegetables, setting up traps, pulling bamboo, shooting fish in streams, cooking and helping with housework. Suddenly, 50 years later, our journeys of life have mostly gone, and now what we are looking for is feedback and serenity, and wish to pursue a healthy, peaceful, and simple life in their remaining years.   Ever since, we have been thinking of "a falling leaf returns to the roots" and hoped that ancestral glory can come to us to help us creating a healthy living environment with the tribesmen together.  To be closer to nature, closer to the waters and mountains, and closer to creating a healthy cause, we have a dream to own a health farm, render it in a simple, natural, earthy way to allow us to have a lazy laid-back life accompanied by nature and share it with all good friends who like here.   Three brothers then actively brought the land 20 years ago. Beginning in April 2008, they have returned to tribe planning, followed by designing, in the same year on November 22 they started the construction, and officially completed the building and opened for business on October 3, 2009. We, three brothers, spent more than 2 years to complete the construction of this healthy farm.   Here has very beautiful landscapes, pleasant climate, and is an unexplored paradise on earth, where you can find a lot of amazing things in every corner. We hope the staying tourists can have the beautiful feelings comparable to traveling to the Swiss.   "Tumuyi" is my father's indigenous name. In the past, he was a farmer battling through hardship to live, inadvertently, at 38 years old, he died of hypertension and suddenly left us. To recall fondly and cherish the memory of father's kindness of bringing up us, hardworking, and helpful spirit of great love, and to awaken our descendants to attach importance to their health, the farm villa is therefore named "Tumuyi Healthy Resort."

She knows the customs and customs of Meinong Hakkas like the back of her hand, and can help tourists get to know Meinong in the shortest possible time. He is committed to promoting the traditional Hakka music, which is based on gongs and drums and mainly suona-like drum instruments. Sometimes he will improvise a "welcome song" to welcome guests from afar.Zhongzheng Lake B&B is located in Zhongzhen Community, which won the National Model Community Competition. The residents here attach more importance to the greening and beautification of the environment than residents of other communities. Zhongzheng Lake B&B is a cozy little building carefully built by the owner. Hotels.Description: New Taipei｜The Easy SpaceParty time on the coast in an old fishing villageHow long has it been since you went on a trip to see the ocean with a big group of friends, to have a few drinks and sing songs until the sun comes up? Make the arrangements, claim a weekend for your own, board a vehicle heading for the seaside, and make a beeline for a youthful party -- The Easy Space is the perfect villa for a carefree, seaside vacation.Vacation space in a villaTravelling along the seaside, only an hour by car from Taipei city, you come to an old forgotten fishing village in Gongliao bay. A faded red brick European style villa overlooks the ocean and reminds you of the former magnificence of the area. You pull the heavy glass doors open and step instantly into a different world. A lazy bossanova jazz tune resounds in your ears as you take in the extraordinary style of the living room with its high ceiling and crystal chandeliers. Seven-meter tall floor-to-ceiling windows allow you to take in the blue sky, the ocean, and the mountain ranges outside. The Easy Space was in fact originally a gift from the father of the hostess, Amber, to her grandfather on his 60th birthday 12 years earlier. Amber’s grandfather had left his hometown in the struggle to make a living and, despite achieving professional success, had always longed to return. With grandpa’s dream of returning to the countryside in his mind, Amber’s father went home and built the most fashionable European-style villa of the time.For the current hostess, Amber, The Easy Space brings back memories of beautiful vacations with friends. After leaving a pleasant life in the USA and returning to Taiwan for her family, Amber helped to revamp their old family villa, with the goal of allowing those fond childhood memories to live on. Upon her return, Amber also met her love, Michael. Now, through the everyday happiness of The Easy Space, the two of them share their mutual love and appreciation with every traveler who stays with them.Five secret oceanside bays for five different roomsYet the biggest surprise in this space measuring 250 ping isn’t the 100-inch Blu-ray home theater; there’s also KTV equipment, a sauna and steam room, a cocktail bar, and a fully equipped gym! There’s even a small reading room filled with Amber’s beloved collection of Japanese manga. Furthermore, plans are in the works to build an outdoor cafe with an ocean view for the enjoyment of The Easy Space guests.All five rooms here at The Easy Space were renovated by Amber and Michael’s own skillful hands to create a fresh aesthetic environment. If you love a big room, with a grand view of the ocean and sky, then your first choice will certainly be the “oceanside and sky” suite on the second floor, which puts you closest to the vast ocean and sky. The “fisherman’s bay” suite on the first floor is equally large and gives you the same generous front row seat to beautiful scenery. Around to the side, you find the “garden scenery” suite in the color of violets, a space situated just right to give you a view of both mountains and sea from the balcony.Though it doesn’t directly face the ocean, the “mountain and sea landscape” suite on the second floor is painted an enchanting Tiffany blue, and presents an irresistible choice for travelers. If you love the simplicity of the mountains and long to hide away in comfort and security, then the “hilltop cloud” suite was designed precisely for you. With large windows facing majestic mountains and one entire wall painted with a tunnel motif, you’re left wondering where that road into the distance may lead. Tonight, you may take a train ride in your dreams, setting off for a paradise where friendships are eternal.The forgotten, yet most beautiful, fishing village in the northeastAfter finishing Amber’s delicious homemade breakfast, take a walk into the village under a clear, azure sky. Maoao Fishing Village, the most beautiful fishing village in the whole northeast, lies between Taipei and Yilan and is extremely close to the villa. Once bustling and lively, it now lies tranquil and serene. Old houses are preserved and exude a generous and friendly ambiance. You greet an elderly neighbor resting in the shade of a doorway, and play with the kittens rolling around in the sunshine. You snap a few photographs as you reluctantly prepare to leave, taking beautiful memories back with you.The ocean breeze gently blows as you look back up the hillside to The Easy Space, and images of the flourishing and decline of the fishing village play in your mind. The faded red brick building before you holds aloft the resplendent colors of youth, inviting you and your friends to make plans to return soon to this quaint fishing village in the northeast.

Hotels.Description: "Jilufugan Art and Culture Homestay" is located in the Sabuyou Tribe of Xinxing Village, Jinfeng Township, nestled between mountains and the sea. Upon entering the village, a striking artwork depicting a thorny ball, a symbol of Paiwan traditional culture, immediately catches the eye in front of the homestay. The building itself is a two-story reinforced concrete structure, constructed with traditional stone slabs.The homestay owner& #39;s late mother (Hu Shunli) was one of the eight chieftains of the Sabuyou Tribe (of the Skado family). She personally carved and painted traditional Paiwan cultural life on the wooden pillars at the entrance, the main pillars inside, the eaves, and the interior walls. She also depicted her memories of the old tribe and its life in paintings, using the walls of the house as her canvas.The homestay owner, Wu Jiuzi, said that she initially wanted to run "Jilufugan Art and Culture Homestay" to commemorate her late mother& #39;s dedication to traditional culture. She has also displayed her mother& #39;s belongings and traditional Paiwan artifacts in a showcase. It also allows visitors to gain a deeper understanding of Paiwan culture, so the house is decorated with many Paiwan cultural installations and artworks, making it feel like a small indigenous cultural exhibition hall.

Hotels.Description: Yilan｜Cat Sky HouseFollow the cat to a playful old house in the countrysideA comfortable autumn breeze blows through Yilan, as the Annong River reflects the dazzling sunlight. Strolling along a country lane between farmers’ fields as chickens cluck and dogs bark, you somehow feel like closing your eyes when suddenly your gaze is caught by a building colored red and orange: Cat Sky House, the brightest traditional courtyard home on the bank of the Annong River, sits waiting between rice paddies for travelers to visit.Rich and delightful countryside courtyard homeWalking into the courtyard at Cat Sky House, everything is brightly colored, with cute, playfully arranged scenes all around. The courtyard preserves the traditional cement ground covering, as grass grows in cracks that opened up in the cement many years before. Several cats, stretching out beneath a red sun parasol, continue rolling around. Your host Lisa walks toward you with a smile. After retirement, she and her husband, Paul bought this house, originally in ruins, for the street cats that they had adopted. They have since remodeled it into a cute courtyard house full of cats. The moment you enter the house, you are greeted by a warm aroma - you discover that it’s the smell of the home-baked welcome cookies being prepared by Miss Tian, the housekeeper. In the kitchen, the same warm color theme you have seen elsewhere at Cat Sky House continues, and the old wood-burning hearth remains as well. Watching Miss Tian’s busy movements, you feel a sense of returning to your family home in the countryside.And why have they chosen Yilan as the place to pursue life after retirement? Originally living in Taipei, Lisa says with a laugh, “We do it all for these little animals!” Following the growth and independence of her children, Lisa gradually started to adopt cats. First one, then another, then a third… the more cat adoption information she saw, the more she took in, and before she knew it she had seven or eight cats living in her home! A while later, after going on a trip with several friends, they suddenly became inspired to buy a house in Yilan where they could retire to one day, to live together and take care of one another. This was the birth of Cat Sky House. As Lisa says with a laugh, “You have to have your own life!” Retirement is not the finale, it is the start of a new life.Peaceful, easy times in the countryCat Sky House only entertains a single group of guests at any given time, so you can relax completely and enjoy the company of your friends in your own exclusive building. This country-style home filled with miscellaneous goods will set you completely at ease. Stepping into the bedroom, you take in the colorful decor on the roof beams, as well as the cute figurines lying on the bed and in front of the windows. The pristine white sheets are soft and welcoming, inviting you to fall asleep to the singing sounds of insects.Walking outdoors, Paul excitedly shows you the sweet potato leaves he just picked in order to give traveling guests the most natural, flavorful breakfast possible the following morning. At this time, however, a sumptuous afternoon tea has been prepared to welcome you, and it is up to you whether you enjoy it outdoors or inside. Sitting in a corner of the courtyard, admiring the expansive country fields and the soothing breeze, you enjoy passionfruit jam on handmade cookies with hibiscus wax gourd tea. Chickens cluck as they walk around the courtyard in a scene that seems right out of a peaceful, pastoral painting.A sumptuous countryside breakfastYou wake at the break of dawn to the sound of clucking chickens, barking dogs and the aromatic breakfast that awaits you. Walking to the breakfast table, you’ll certainly be shocked at first sight of the table full of sumptuous foods. You may even think you’ve overslept and your hosts have skipped right to preparing lunch! Besides Paul’s own sweet potato leaves and corn, there is a host of other seasonal vegetables. Delicious egg flatbreads sprinkled with cilantro delight the taste buds. Lisa proudly states, “Our egg flatbreads are made with indica rice milk, making them softer, and they’re really hard to come by!” At that moment, the housekeeper delivers a freshly baked pizza to the table! The melted cheese invites you to eat just one more slice. After you are full, Lisa will provide you with all the info you need about local sights to see.Cat Sky House maintains the old-school retro lifestyle and pastoral tranquility of an old courtyard home in the countryside. In such a place, time simply slows down. With Lisa’s humor and Paul’s warmth, you’ll certainly see how genuine the interaction between people can be. When you arrive at Cat Sky House, you’ll see just how fun the countryside can be. In this old courtyard home, you can even follow the cats’ lead, to gaze upon a new slice of sky.

Hotels.Description: Fullon Hotel (Tamsui Fishermen's Wharf) is located in Tamsui Fishermen's Wharf, adjacent to the estuary of Tamsui River, where you can see Guanyin Mountain from afar and overlook Bali ferry, embracing beautiful scenery. Whether staring at the sunset in Tamsui or seeing the sights of mountain or sea, it is a stunning experience. The hotel is built to look like a floating luxurious ocean liner; therefore has the name of Love Boat of Fullon. The hotel features 198 rooms, with relaxing atmosphere of ocean everywhere, and provides you with an ultimate considerate and royal service. Other recreational facilities include SPAs, swimming pools, gymnasiums, etc. The theater-style column-free conference room can accommodate up to 100 Chinese style tables, or a thousand of Western style tables. Around the hotel, there are shopping arcade and arts avenue, where offer travelers one-stop leisure and shopping experiences. The hotel is next to the famous super revolving scenic tower-- Valentine's Tower, which built by Lih Pao and costed over three hundred million NT.
