Hotels.Description: Yilan｜Chang HouseA Dwelling That Breathes Along with NatureFollowing the perfectly straight country road, you drive into a golden rice paddy with farm houses scattered throughout. Rolling down the window, you stretch your head out to admire Yilan’s pastoral landscape, the rice stalks by the roadside laiden with grain sway in the gentle breeze to welcome travelers. Following the road signs onwards, you approach your destination: Chang House, in perfect harmony with the natural world, and enveloped in the breeze rich with the aroma of rice.Tasting local refreshments in a classic Yilan residenceHanson is the owner of Chang House. Wearing a warm smile and wooden clogs, he walks out to greet you, leading you along the slate pathway into the back yard. Pushing open the screen door, the wind and sunlight dance together as you see the unique desserts and traditional refreshments that Chang and the housekeepers have prepared for you. As they place the local flavors of Yilan upon the table, you admire the plate arrangement and local ingredients. Taste a bite of kumkuat, enjoying the sweet & sour flavor; salted plum cakes, a local delicacy, stuffed with dehydrated fruit, get sweeter the longer they are chewed; roasted wheat flour tea with a sprinkle of crispy bun cake combines the most classic traditional flavors; wash it all down with a cup of warm honey peach black tea to warm the stomach and the heart.Designed by famous architect Huang Sheng-yuan, Chang House is the most representative residential building in Yilan. The height of the ground floor allows one to appreciate both the view of the fields and the painting-like mountain scenery. Slow down your pace and appreciate the rhythmic interaction between the courtyard and the surrounding natural environment. Even when sitting indoors under the midday sun, you can sense the movement of the wind. The sun floods indoors through large floor-to-ceiling windows, bright and warm. The cubic structure, the square-shaped courtyard, the single pink plumeria tree highlight the year-round beauty of Chang House.A home accordant with nature and founded on peopleEight years in construction, Chang House is founded upon people, accordant with nature, and fused with the local culture. “Looking down at the design of our house from above, you can see the square-within-a-square shape  of the Chinese character for return. It is built upon the concept of home, which is precisely what I wanted.” In order to implement this ideal, Hanson waited eight years for the design and construction to be completed. He used patience and trust to exchange for what he loved most.Moving alone from Yilan to Taipei, Hanson got a job as a hairdresser after graduating from high school in order to help ease his family’s economic pressure. Along the way, he met the most important person in his life - Sister Lan. After saving a bit of money, they decided to move together to Yilan and build a home they could call their own. Even though an accident quietly took Sister Lan from this world, her warm spirit had already had a profound influence on Chang House. Hanson says that the property upon which Chang House is built was bought by Sister Lan, so no matter what, he must continue her dream of making her dreamland a reality.The greatest luxury is in fact very simpleChang House’s five suites have all been named after the rooms formerly inhabited by members of Hanson’s family: the Master Bedroom, the Mother Room, the Eldest Daughter Room, the Little Daughter Room, and the Guest Room. All rooms are simple and elegant, while retaining a cozy warmth. Hanson lived with his family in this home for ten years before deciding to share it with the outside world, allowing even more people to stay in a local Yilan residence. His hope was that travelers could also share in their experience of life in this special living room and in this courtyard.In the morning, you enjoy a delicious Chinese-style home cooked meal made entirely of seasonal vegetables and fruit grown in their own garden. Afterwards, you lie in the spacious front yard enjoying the aroma of the rice paddies. In the afternoon, you curl up in a corner of the courtyard with a book. The evening is the most important time of day at Chang House - you climb to the rooftop from where you can enjoy the expansive natural scenery. This is the most magical moment of all, when the golden sun setting beneath orange clouds creates a splendid play of light and shadow across the open fields. It has been said that human beings require sunlight, air, water, and trees. After coming to Chang House, you realize that all you need to do is open your eyes and relax your mind, and all at once, all of these wonderful elements are yours!

Hotels.Description: Taitung｜Juhu VillaJourney to a mountain residence of endless surprisesYou drive along a winding mountain road and the silence along the way gives you the feeling that you’re about to arrive at a secluded, secret place. The natural scenery out the car window excites you as you approach Juhu Villa; a quiet place brimming with vitality.A treasure chest of natural wonders deep in the mountainsXiao Hei, the lively little black dog, approaches the car to welcome you upon arrival. You see baskets of freshly-picked tangerines, and a bunch of hardy bananas on a wooden table. Wearing simple clothing and a bashful smile, your amiable host, Jin-Tian, approaches. Pointing to the freshly harvested bananas on the table, he says, “Have some! Don’t be shy!” This place exudes a generous and friendly ambiance. With no neighbors in sight, you quickly make the acquaintance of the sky, the earth, and the abundant wildlife.You walk with Jin-Tian up a sloping road towards the independent lodging area. Beautiful primrose blossoms line the road, butterflies dancing between them. Xiao Hei and the endless mountain scenery accompany you on your stroll as you feel your mind and body being cleansed. Jin-Tian points to the distant mountains on either side, saying, “Our land extends from here to there…” He names for you the many tree and plant species along the way; tomatoes, persimmons, dragon fruit, banana... “Listen! That’s the call of the muntjac deer!” Pointing once again to the far off mountain ridge, “Formosan serows inhabit those mountains!” Jin-Tian is even able to climb up the wire obstacle course they have set up with his bare hands, or quickly ascend the trees above the river valley like a young boy playing in the mountains. Following his footsteps, you feel like you are exploring a treasure chest full of natural wonders, discovering endless surprises.A mountain household with a view of the Pacific OceanAfter climbing the steep road, you catch your breath on the mountain terrace looking out between the high mountains. Suddenly you catch a glimpse of light reflecting off azure waters: the faraway Pacific Ocean. As the sea breeze blows by and you take a deep breath, you feel just like a mountain spirit.Three white bungalows sit to one side of the road, simple and elegant. French windows allow the beautiful scenery to merge into each residence. In the Maroon Oriole Residence, furnished in the style of a Chinese court, you feel immersed in the refinement of the pink and red decor. In the mustard yellow decor of the Collared Scops Owl Residence, you enter the magnificence of classical European style. The colors of the Formosan Blue Magpie Residence are just as lively as the bird for which it is named, with elements of maritime Greece mixed in, giving you the impression of an ocean voyage. No matter which residence you inhabit, all have a spacious balcony overlooking the mountains, and a large bathtub in a roomy bathroom to help spoil your world-weary body.Make your way to a world-class villa with unparallelled mountain viewsThe sky is still light after you finish checking in, and Xiao Hei seems to know that you want to go out to play, bouncing around and wagging his tail. Jin-Tian has finished his farming work and invites you to experience an activity with a set itinerary. With expectation and excitement, you and your friends jump aboard the little blue work truck as the steep mountain road and beautiful environs foretell of the unimaginable journey to come. Jin-Tian stops the truck on a flat section of the hillside as a crested goshawk spirals above your head and into the distance. Looking down you see the Changbin plains and the Pacific Ocean beyond. You seem to be able to make out Green Island in the fog off the coast. Hanging from a large tree by the hillside is a swing, and after being reassured by Jin-Tian, you bravely give it a try. Your extended legs feel the rushing of the wind as you surge forward, gripping the ropes tightly in your hands. You feel like a small bird enjoying the swiftness of soaring through the air. You feel you might even be able to jump into the Pacific Ocean before you. You can’t believe that such a private, world-class scenic spot could exist here in Taiwan.After dark, Jin-Tian’s wife, Mei-jyu, prepares a full table of organic cuisine for you. After dinner, you chat with your friends in the open air mountainside dining area, enjoying the comforts of this farming household. Afterwards, you might again explore the mountain environment with Jin-Tian, encountering once more a little muntjac deer, a flying squirrel, or perhaps an owl.In the early morning light, you enjoy a multicolored vegetarian breakfast. Deep in the mountains, you experience the beauty of a more primitive lifestyle, exploring the precious surprises that nature offers. When it is time to leave, your reluctance to leave transforms into immense gratitude as you give thanks to the rich offerings of the natural world, and to Jin-Tian and Mei-jyu for their passionate love of nature and their unreserved sharing.

Hotels.Description: Every traveler hopes to stay in a clean and comfortable space, to allow body and spirit to relax completely. Da Ziran Xiuxian Homestay provides different styles of accommodation experience, including Red Promise in floral images, Golden Kingdom, exotic Season Rain, Bali Sentiment, Blue Rhapsody, Green Forest and Green Bodhi which love the forest phytoncides. Dream allows travelers to enjoy quality and romantic accommodation in the peaceful and simple town. Besides providing quality accommodation and cozy public spaces, the hospitable owner treats every guest as his own family and friend, offering delicious and healthy breakfast prepared using local agricultural products, allowing every guest to feel like being at home and have a memorable journey to Nantou before heading towards the next journey. Da Ziran Xiuxian Homestay is at about 500 meters and a 7-minute walk from the train station, it only takes about 40-minute drive to famous international tourist attractions such as  Sun Moon Lake, Formosan Aboriginal Culture Village and Xitou; popular sites such as Houtanching Recreational Area (Sky of Star Month), Fongguiedou in Sinyi Township, Paper Dome in Puli, and Checheng are all within the vicinity as well with convenient traffic connections. It is suitable for friends or family outings to experience the different seasonal natural sentiments, including plum blossom in winter, cherry blossom in spring, fireflies in summer and maple leaves in fall, to enjoy the fun time of the Slow Life. The meaning of traveling is to make the most heart-moving documentation of places you have been to, it may be magnificent sceneries, or may be folk customs you came in contact with; regardless of your intention for traveling, Da Ziran Xiuxian Homestay hopes that every traveler visiting here may return fully packed with happy memories!

Hotels.Description: Would you like to take a trip and deeply experience Alishan’s sunrise, sea of clouds, forest, railway, sunset clouds, and tea village? Visit us, have some tea, and go hiking! From the 50 kilometer point of Alishan Highway, turn right toward Tanayiku and go straight for about 2 minutes to reach us. We are located at an elevation of 1060 meters, with a mild climate year round, surrounded by lush greenery and fresh air. Beautiful mountain mists and magnificent seas of clouds are our regular visitors; come here and enjoy a rare moment of leisure and tranquility, listening to the sounds of the birds and insects in the forest and peacefully gazing off at the mountain range in the distance. There is nothing artificial about the beauty of this place, only the praise of nature. Our little wooden building stands tall and unflustered throughout time within the refreshing mountain forest, looking out at Tanayiku, surrounded by the verdant mountains, making people forget all about the noise of the city. Suite rooms feature warm, simple layout, bright and spacious, while retaining a homely atmosphere and making guests feel perfectly comfortable. We provide meals prepared from organic, seasonal vegetables, whether it’s the homestyle-cooking restaurant or Tsou Tribe Aboriginal Flavor Restaurant, guaranteeing use of only the best ingredients to provide guests with a happy, secure dining experience. We provide homegrown high mountain tea, bringing you a taste of Alishan’s local specialty, as well as expert local travel information and trip planning to make sure your trip is worth it! Call us at 05-2586608 or 0932-843889.

Hotels.Description: Discovering Zileju(Cicada-Home). Zile is another name for Cicada. Zileju is situated on Mei Lun Mountain in Hualien City. There is a Pine Garden next to it. In this beautiful environment, you can often hear the chirping sound of cicada that seems to be urging us to quickly step into this beautiful environment; therefore, we called our home stay “cicada.” Here, you can enjoy a great view of Hualien City. To the right, there is the Central Mountain Range, and, to the left, is the Coastal Mountain Range. In this natural scenery, you are far from the disturbance of the noisy city, and enjoy the most grand and simple baptism of Mother Nature.  When you step into Zileju, Taiwan red pines and an array of stars greet you. The purple-dancing Cape Primrose, pink and romantic morning glory, and lavender also welcome you. We provide the most friendly service, the most comfortable facilities and enjoyment, allowing you to unwind and forget the stress of work by bathing in the mountains, sea, sunlight, and air of Hualien. Zileju welcomes guests who have taste and a love for nature. The day and night of Hualien: Morning- Sunlight shines on the newly awakened Hualien City. The sunlight shines through, and lights up the grand Central Mountain Range, and also shines on the beautiful Pacific Ocean. Sunset- Afterglow sweeps across the sky, a breeze gently blows, starlight and street lights are faintly discernible. Night- Looking over Hualien night scene, you see glittering lights, as moon light gently shines on the ground and stars twinkle on the sky. The croaking of frogs and chirping sounds of cicadas is like a natural symphony. We serve a delicious breakfast, personally made by the inn keeper, consisting of a tasty hamburger, together with fresh and tasty lettuce salad and seasonal fruits; as for drinks, guests can choose juice, hot cocoa, or hot coffee. After eating breakfast, you will have all the nourishment and energy you need for the day !

Hotels.Description: Pingtung｜Ocean Paradise ResortEndless azure views from a resort beside the seaUp in the mountains of Kenting, beside the endless azure ocean, you discover a beautiful, pure white guesthouse. Two buildings sit like the two wings of an angel overlooking the sea and the human world. After circumventing the small town of Hengchun and driving past endless rolling hills and grasslands, the Ocean Paradise Resort appears before you, your companion for a beautiful vacation.Blessings of sea and sun in a white dreamlandThe sea breeze in southern Taiwan, the shrubbery along the road, and the midsummer sun all feels like a beautiful daydream. Your car stops before the distant scenery of the eight great mountain ranges which surround the small town of Hengchun. You look out at the pair of buildings with white walls like the two wings of an angel speckled with small windows, each one hiding the angel’s secrets. A couple of wiener dogs rush towards you wagging their tails, with your host Lisa waving and smiling at you, welcoming you to this tranquil, white dreamland. Walking indoors, you see the azure sky and deep, blue sea through the large French windows, and all of the exhaustion you may have carried with you along your journey slips away into that distant azure horizon. Next, you enjoy delightful afternoon tea on the lawn, tasting desserts and admiring the scenery. You walk with your special friend to the ocean lookout and wonder at the beauty of the golden sunset, offering each other a kiss under the blessings of sea and sun.Twelve guest rooms offer a vacation in the company of the seaTwelve rooms, like twelve keys to happiness - Daybreak, Splendid Sun, Sunset, Moonlight, White Cloud, Blue Sky, Rainbow, Starry Sky, Meadow, Jade Wave, Spring Breeze, Summer Peace - each room providing beautiful vacation scenery to accompany you.Each four-person suite is sure to provide your family with warm memories; the outdoor gardens overflow with verdant scenery, the red Chinese hibiscus in full bloom provide the perfect backdrop for solid-wood, Southeast Asian furnishings as pleasant music plays in the background. In the simplicity of “Double Room A” the lapping sea provides the background music as you recline on the balcony in wooden lounge chairs discussing life. “Double Room B” has additional mountain-view windows and is relaxed and comfortable. The “VIP Double Room” is the most attractive of all, with a bathtub that offers an ocean view, allowing for the tender enjoyment of both water and sunlight. In the evening, if you are lucky, you may pull open the curtains to behold the moonlight sparkling on the surface of the ocean, with the Milky Way sparkling overhead.Happiness in the Kenting hillsWhen morning breaks, you and your special friend walk to the first-floor dining room and choose a table near the windows where you enjoy a delicious breakfast beside the ever-present blue sea. You pick up your book to read a few pages while your partner writes in a journal, both of you enjoying this tranquil time.Children frolic with the weiner dogs on the lawn outside the window, while the cattle ruminate over the grass in the neighboring field. You feel like you’re in nature’s paradise. The ocean is like a secret left in the human world by the angels. In this place, you feel like blessings are always near, as if that distant ocean is always nearby.

Hotels.Description: Hotel HistoryRespond to the twenty first century tourism development movement, Ministry of Transportation & Communications developed on Twenty First Century Taiwan Tourism Strategy, and created a high quality sightseeing environment concentrate in local community, ecological community, and variety as the main principal. To continue promote tourism, the Executive Yuan Tourism Development Team appointed Chiayi County government and Tourism Bureau to carry out the scenic resource investigation and management arena agenda for Ali Mountain region. In March 2001, Ministry of Transportation & Communication completes the grade review as national class scenic area and declared management region. In the same year, established National Scenic Area Administration Office in Mt. Ali on July 23rd. On September 4th, President Chen came in person for the grand opening.Story of DevelopmentEight years ago, government operated Alishan House entrusted Chao-Li Hotel Management Advisory Company for business management. Afterwards, Alishan House has obvious improvements in hotel amenities, and became the five-star holiday hotel at highest altitude in Taiwan.Future PerspectiveChao-Li Hotel Management Advisory Company officially contracted with Forestry Bureau in December 2004, and obtained the first non-governmental investment BOT case qualification from Forestry Bureau. Chao-Li Hotel Management Advisory Company anticipate to build a five-star holiday hotel at the current address in approximately two years, and expand it to 150 guestrooms with plenty facilities upon completion. Once again, push Mt. Ali to be the best sightseeing region in Taiwan.

Hotels.Description: The construction of the Lake Side Resort was commenced by the Fu Li Development Co, Ltd. in 1995 and the hotel opened in March 1999. In 1999, the Fu Chuan Development International Co, Ltd. was awarded the "Promotion of Private Participation in the Tourism and Recreation Infrastructure in Puli Liyu Lake Scenic Area Project" by the Nantou County government. Facilities were added, such as 116 rooms from the previous 68, a floating restaurant and Lotus Cafe. The hotel is the only recreation and holiday hotel built at Liyu Lake in Puli, Nantou. From here, guests can reach Puli downtown by a 10 minute ride. To ensure guests& #39; safety during their stay and indulgence in the wonderful lake view, the hotel is constructed with a highly safe steel structure that endured the 921 earthquake of 1999, taking a perfect score for its structural safety. The hotel consists of 4 main buildings. When you enter the lobby, you will see the stairs on both sides connecting to the carefully designed conference hall on the 2nd floor. The conference hall is suitable for holding meeting and training activities by organizations. In buildings A, B and C, rooms of different types, styles and sizes are available to meet guests& #39; needs. Lake Side Resort is located right on the carp site of the Seven Carp Lake auspicious sites. A long time ago, before the willow causeway was built, the Carp Lake resembles a lively and shiny carp. When the sun sets, the crimson light shines on the lake surface as if the scales of a swaying fish . The reason why the willow causeway came into existence can be traced back to legends of various sources. I have always favored the legend that the Japanese built the causeway to penetrate the part of the lake resembling the fish maw when Taiwan was under Japanese rule for fear of any talent incubated from the power of Feng Shui. As in Feng Shui, there is a saying that destiny comes first, fate second and Feng Shui third and this is upheld by the Chinese. And the Japanese did it to sabotage the power of Feng Shui here. Whatever the case may be, this brought us a view comparable to the willow causeway in the West Lake. And you can enjoy it with your own eyes. Never miss the spot when you are around.

Hotels.Description: New Taipei｜Fish HostelTake a Free-Spirited Journey to YinggeOh, you travelers who wander aimlessly to the ends of the world like a fish swimming the world’s oceans, where do you want to travel to today? Travelling wherever you will with your pack on your back, you arrive at the Yingge train station where, across the way, your eyes are drawn to a building with aquamarine blue window frames. That is the blue, the color of freedom, from which the home of a traveler is constructed - Fish Hostel.A traveler’s home, a rest station while journeying the worldAccording to legend, a gigantic parrot roaming the blue skies once decided to settle on a mountain ridge in the western part of New Taipei City. The moment it perched itself, the story of “Parrot Brother Rock” (literal translation of  Ying Ge Shi) was born and slowly passed on by word of mouth to one day become the “Oriole Song” (literal translation of  Ying Ge) we know today. Over the years, the traveler’s melody was added to the Oriole Song. Fish Hostel sits directly across from the Yingge Train Station, perfectly situated to welcome those drifting souls to take a rest along their journey.As you enter the main hall, a large tree limb is used as a merchandise display to the left side of the entrance. A variety of small products from far-off locations hangs from the branches. Available for purchase are ethnic clothing items with tribal designs, handmade jewelry, and much more. Your host Emma also loves travel, and has brought back a rich and diverse world with which to decorate Fish Hostel. “Since this is a traveler’s home, I wanted to give everyone a peaceful and comfortable feeling!” One entire wall on the first floor is covered in graffiti principally composed of blue and white colors, creating an ambiance of peace and harmony. The design was entirely created by Emma who gave life to her ideal through each brush stroke. Emma’s conviction is that, through her skillful creation, fish that once wandered to the ends of the world without a home now have a place to return to. She hopes to energize the travelers that come her way.A little backpacker’s abode built from bountiful graffitiKicking off your shoes, you head upstairs where you find tidy rows of simple wooden bunk beds that have supported the travel dreams of travelers from around the world. Besides backpacker accommodations, Fish Hostel also offers two- and four-person rooms. The keyring for the room shows a fish swimming through a little heart, like a nimble fish which can, in the blink of an eye, bring you back to the Little Sun Room. The Little Sun Room has its own private balcony and ample comforting daylight. The light bathes the warm tones of the room in which the compelling breeze lightly sways your beautiful dreams. A hand-painted wall with ocean-blue as its base color leads you along to the Big Sun Room. The color designs lead you to the splendid yellow flowers blooming in the Big Sun Room, as if keeping watch over anyone who sleeps soundly in the two double beds. A soft, bright green floor mat covers the floor beneath the beds, to allow guests the utmost level of relaxation and enjoyment.ΙΧΘΥΣ is the Greek word for fish, as well as an important spiritual symbol for Fish Hostel. In the early days of Christianity, when believers were under persecution from the Roman Empire, they would use the Greek word for fish with graceful arcs drawn above and below as a secret sign to identify each other’s status as believers. “It is my hope that every traveler who comes to Fish Hostel can find companions that they are compatible with, as well as to be in the peaceful presence of Jesus.” Emma says that fish are just like our souls; we are all in the middle of a journey, step-by-step to complete our own lives.A traveler’s chance encounter leads to the completion of lifeSurprisingly, the multi-talented host of Fish Hostel, Emma, redid her university test in order to choose her beloved industrial arts design program. During her student years, she worked as a pottery teacher, using her income to accumulate an impressive store of travel memories from all over. Just like the rich and diverse decor of the living room, Emma used movement to fulfill her heart and spirit. During the summer break of her second year of university, she was an artist in residence in Jiufen. She met many friends thanks to that opportunity. “They were all doing what they wanted to do, and it showed me that life can be very simple.” After two months in residence, Emma had imagined her ideal blueprint for her life, and the dream of opening a guesthouse slowly started to sprout in her mind. She recalls, “I didn’t want to wait until some time in the distant future. I could do what I wanted to do even while I was a student.” After she had made up her mind, she rode all over on her scooter to find a location. She found it on day three. By day seven she had created her business plan! Her past travel experience along with her meticulous craftsmanship all helped to nurture the development of Fish Hostel! “Our lives are always full of speed and light, and Fish Hostel opens a little chink in that speed.” The walls are covered in passionate messages, as well as Emma’s own hand-drawn map of local travel spots, awaiting travelers to continue to add to the map. At Fish Hostel, travel is like an ongoing dialogue. At Fish Hostel, no matter what language is used, whether vocal or silent, whether the dialogue is outwards or inwards; souls that are in love with travel will continue to rush forth as if pushed by a warm current, hurrying onwards for the next ocean journey.

Hotels.Description: Longmen House Bed & Breakfast was built for the Chen family in 1924 in the traditional Hokkien sanheyuan style, which incorporates three structures around a courtyard, and has been converted into a bed & breakfast in the hopes of sharing the beauty of Penghu’s traditional fishing-village style. When you first turn the oxcart-wheel door and enter Longmen House Bed & Breakfast, you’ll be met with a carefully crafted tiled map of Penghu. Then, after knocking on the stained wooden door, you’ll set foot on a red-tile floor and enter the central courtyard, flanked by traditional tiled windows and equipped with bamboo chairs and redwood bed, like a trip backward in time. The outdoor pavilion was hand-built by Mr. Chen from driftwood over the course of four months, and sits near another recently completed “Penghu boat” pavilion which is perfect for lying down in and enjoy the starry nights. One of life’s great pleasures is dining in these cool pavilions, enjoying a fresh Penghu seafood barbeque under the beautiful nighttime skies. Or you could sit in one of the second-floor balconies, looking out across the starry night sky and enjoying the sea breeze as you sip on a cup of coffee or tea. During these tranquil nights, troubles and stress just seem to melt away. Come visit us at Longmen House! Website: http://www.longmenhouse.com.tw

Hotels.Description: Sun Moon Lake’s Jing Xin Yuan Rural Bed and Breakfast is located in Seshui Community near Sun Moon Lake (Yuchih (Yuchi) Township, Nantou County). On Provincial Highway 21, on Zhongtan Road after passing Dayan Tunnel, take a right and enter. Conveniently located, with nearby tourist sites including Sun Moon Lake, Formosa Aboriginal Culture Village, Taiwan Adventist College, Lienhuachih, Shueili (Shuili) Checheng, and Puli, this is the ideal place to stay on weekends or vacations when planning your trip to Nantou. Seshui Community resembles a lotus blossom in a valley, featuring a beautiful environment, great scenery, and rich produce and ecological resources. Community resides worked together to build a very special ecological village which was selected as one of the Top 10 Classic Villages in 2007. It produces two specialty products, the first of which is Seshui Pottery, made from top-quality Baixian clay, which does not require the use of glaze. The oxidized ashes given off by the wood-fired baking process gives the finished pottery a varied appearance, making each piece a special, unique product. The other speicalty product is Seshui Royal Tea, which derives its name from being one of Taiwan’s top quality black teas. It was once the tea of choice for Japanese emperors; the name also refers to serving tea. All tea leaves are organic, handpicked with one bud and two leaves, and free of fertilizers or pesticides. Excellent quality guaranteed their place in the Assam cultural revival. We welcome you to try out this special “Japanese imperial tea.”

Hotels.Description: Taoyuan｜Goo Dian Coffee HouseA happy little house beside a verdant green valleyYou drive out of the city on a winding country road and head deep into the mountains. Opening the car window, the breeze brushes by smelling of green grass. Slowing down the car, the layers of greenery outside the window put you in a fine mood. Turning a corner, you come upon a traveler’s relay station in the mountains - Goo Dian Coffee House is subtly located in a valley on Lala Mountain, embraced by the blue sky and green environment and just waiting to bring you in touch with the natural world.Situated in relaxed and carefree mountainsShutting off the engine, you hear the wind flowing through the mountains. As you breathe the cool mountain air, you smile and raise your head to take in your surroundings; a simple wooden house sits in the embrace of the green mountain forests. House and forest merge together, creating a harmonious scene. Tiantian (literally means “sweet”), the enthusiastic little Corgi, rushes forward to welcome you with his big, round eyes. You follow Tiantian into the relaxing environment of Lala Mountain.Attached to the wooden reception building is a two-level outdoor coffee terrace. You sit comfortably in a chair sipping a cup of flavorful coffee. The terrace is without windows and doors, so there is no separation between you and the grandeur and magnificence of the mountain range. The Daman creek flows by, revealing the vitality of nature. After a heavy rain, you may have the good fortune to see white gauze-like clouds enshrouding the emerald green mountains. Those clouds also envelope your worries, and you feel convinced that all your troubles will slowly scatter with the clouds and mist.Serene life in the mountain valleyIn your bedroom, host Lin has created a cozy, simple decor that mirrors the rustic character of the mountains. In the three double rooms - the Maple Leaf, Ginkgo, and Wistaria rooms - elegant color schemes further accentuate the endless green scenery outside the windows. Lying lazily upon the soft bed, you can admire the myriad transformations of the mountains as you drift naturally into slumberland. The three-room Sakura Suite is large enough to accommodate a large family on vacation together. In the afternoon, playful children can feed the koi fish in the nearby pond while adults chat about life in the living room. The wooden swing hanging outside the house brings innocent smiles to the faces of young and old alike. In the evening, you prepare a simple late-night snack. After everyone has eaten and drunk to their heart’s content, you sit enjoying each other’s company. It is such simple things that fill life with happiness.A generous and friendly ambiance is the best spiceLin lives here with his younger brother and parents, working together to operate Goo Dian Coffee House and maintain the vast forest park surrounding it. His cute, taciturn father has created an area for raising special and unusual animals, while his mother is responsible for cooking and taking care of the fruit trees. For the convenience of travelers from afar, Goo Dian provides both breakfast and dinner using vegetables from the local mountain landscape to satisfy the taste bud of their guests. Fresh, crisp bamboo shoots, crispy yet tender trout that is grilled to perfection - with fine skill, the chef produces dish after dish of beautiful, seasonal cuisine, with a mother’s home-cooked touch. It is almost as if you’ve returned to your own home away from home in the mountains.Early spring is the time to appreciate the sakura blossoms and in summer, you can savor the fragrant sweetness of juicy peaches. Winter is the time to marvel at a romantic landscape of snow-covered mountains. Stay for a single night at Goo Dian Coffee House and allow your body and spirit to be completely absorbed into the embrace of Lala Mountain. Leave the gloom of the city far behind and return to nature to enjoy the beauty of mountain life.

Hotels.Description: Lansin Villa Bed and Breakfast is located next to Shueidiliao(Shuidiliao) Gas Station at the 438.6K mark on Provincial Highway No. 1 going from Donggang to Kenting. On the east side is Dawu Shan and the Dahan Shan Mountain Range, and on the west is Liouciou (Liuqiu), Fangliao Fishing Harbor, and the Grouper Fish and Shrimp Breeding Area, and the surroundings are home to expansive agricultural fields producing black pearl wax apples, Aiwen mangoes, pineapples, and other fruits and vegetables. Nearby is the Lansin Villa Farm, producing ghost chili peppers (the world’s hottest) and DIY processing experiences. Rooms come with the latest facilities and equipment, including 42-inch liquid crystal TVs, double-person massage tubs (huge bathrooms), separate wet/dry sections and spa body showers, 6-foot Simmons ventilated spring beds, sofa beds, dust-free fire-proof wooden floors, 3-ton separate-style air conditioning, massage chairs, private parking, and free Western-style breakfast. From 2012-2013, we were selected as an Ecological Tour Partner Accommodation Business by the Pingtung Forest District Office, in 2011, as an Artistic and Cultural Accommodation Partner Business by the Pingtung County Government, and in 2012, as a Hospitable Bed and Breakfast Business by the Tourism Bureau. Located between Kenting National Park and Dapeng Bay National Scenic Area, this is the most affordable place in the area. The best value trips may include day or night tours of Kenting, spending the night at Lansin, and the next day visiting Dapeng Bay and Liouciou (Liuqiu) and experiencing the Fangliao agricultural and fishing industry.

Hotels.Description: Reasonably priced accommodation in B&B is hard to find, but Pusu Garden Bed and Breakfast provides surprisingly good value with a clean, simple and comfortable accommodation for guests to enjoy and experience the countryside living.  Pusu is a perfect getaway for a short break from bustling city. Conscientious selection of domestic cooking ingredients for breakfast is our preference. Pusu serves traditional Taiwanese-style breakfast with seasonal vegetables and fruits.  To provide a healthy, local and seasonal food is our goal and fulfillment.  Such as rice porridge with sweet potato, its simple, yet distinctly homey flavor fascinates every customer.  Moreover, Pusu provides homemade CIABATTA sandwiches, fresh blended sugar-free drinks and seasonal fruits for breakfast during vegetables low season.We plant small amount of large-leafed black tea and coffee by nature farming. They are growing in rough open field without any chemical fertilizer and herbicide. Farming is a painstaking job, yet we enjoy it and will persist. By farming we touch the soil, perceive the blessing and the harvest from the Mother Nature that reminds us to be modest and always cherish all we have. During your stay we will share our nature farming black tea and coffee with you and they are also available for our guests to purchase as featured local farm gifts.

Hotels.Description: Shuitou No. 40 Traditional-Style Bed & Breakfast was built during the Qing dynasty and features a traditional-style layout, structural s style known as “11 Supports” or “Large-Size,”and a front and rear hall connected on the left and right sides. It is a large traditional residential building facing southwest. A 7.5 meter courtyard is located outside the entrance, and nearby are a group of Deyue Tower old Western-style buildings, Jinshui Elementary School, Shuitou 18 Beams, and Huang Family Youtang Garden, a second-grade historical site, making this a hub of tourist attractions. Shui Diao Ge Tou Bed & Breakfast is named after a famous poem by Su Dongpo as well as its location close to the water. Here you can experience the wisdom and charming layout of Kinmen’s old buildings, and feel a sense of spiritual fulfillment. These old buildings have a long and colorful history, the weathered stone slabs have stood firm against the test of time, and the mottled red bricks and tiles still shine after a long rain. Life is to be celebrated and cherished. Share a moment of peace and quiet with family and friends, and hold it as a beautiful, lasting memory – this is the sublime power of our traditional-style B&B. Hotels.Description: My wife and I met in college and our family has been growing tea in Alishan for several generations. As the eldest son, I returned with my wife to my hometown after getting married, originally planning to make a living growing tea. However, after hearing about new trends in the leisure industry, I started considering changing the family business. My wife and I spent 6 years studying Chinese and Western cooking, baking, making drinks, bed and breakfast operation, restaurant management, and obtaining a license. My wife, who had never studied design before, managed to create a plan using paintbrush, and in 2006, our dream finally became a reality. Featuring a southern European style, the building’s design includes light yellow walls, red roof tiles, and wood strip patterns, displaying a rich European recreational style, with distinctly separate front and rear buildings. On a bright, clear day, it looks particularly lovely and inviting. Pension Seasonstar is located at Alishan Xiding, with views of the sunrise, sunset, and magnificent sea of clouds. As this is the famous Alishan tea area, surrounded by mountain mists in the distance all year round, the tea grown here is particularly sweet, smooth, and refreshing. We like to make friends with travelers by sharing our lives and feelings with them. An elderly Japanese man and his sister came to visit the Japanese colonial era elementary school, lovers have proposed to each other here, and wedding photographs have been taken here. Sometimes a entire family comes out to enjoy this place, and really, the happiest moment is being able to make our friends smile.

After retiring from the police force, the owner carried on his spirit and concept of serving the people, renovating his home (legally-certified bed and breakfast #521), located in an area of great natural beauty, thus continuing to serve the public. The name of the establishment comes from the Atayal word “Yi Lu Mi Su,” which means “I like you, I welcome you!” Yi Lu Bed and Breakfast is located in the Atayal Tribal Area, providing guests with an authentic traditional aborigine living experience. The building provides great views and comfortable accommodation, and the sound of birds and cicadas can often be heard in the mornings and evenings, leaving a lasting impression. In the summer, guests can walk on our private, narrow, winding pathway to Huangrou Stream, where they can play in the water. In the evening, they can brew tea, have a drink and snacks, or chat on the outdoor deck. Guests can bring their own BBQ, and the kitchen is available if you’d like to cook your own dinner, making this place just like home!

Some of the villagers who were relying on raising oysters and shelling oysters for a living, and some were relying on raising laying hens. Coming to stay here, you can enjoy oysters cuisine, watch the sunset, oyster fields, egrets forest, and fiddler crabs; playing with sand bathing, blowing sea breeze, and enjoying the beauty of nature. In this piece of intertidal zone, there are numerous ecological activities, waiting for you to visit. Our B&B is a traditional Sanhe Yuan house of Minnan style. B&B lived a 90-year-old white-haired grandma, a friend from Indonesia, a handsome Labrador stray dog, and me. Here is where I grew up and is also my mother's family home. Welcome you to my hometown to experience the intertidal ecology, the mien of the fishing village, traditional Sanhe Yuan building, and making friend with enthusiastic villagers. I believe that if you stroll through the alleys of low wall, you are sure to find out more.... Thank you very much.

Hotels.Description: Taitung｜David SamStrong VillaA seaside mountain vacation with sunlight and shadeDriving down the eastern coast, your car turns a corner and leaves the ocean behind. Another left turn and you head towards the entrance to Hsiaoma Hoping Mountain as an alley opens up between flowers to one side of the road. Wind ripples the trees and grass beside the alley as you make your way expectantly towards the end of the road where David SamStrong Villa is situated. You can’t help but wonder what kind of pleasant surprises await.A tender dream stacked in layers upon the hillsideA gray building sits upon the hillside. The concrete walls of David SamStrong Villa maintain their original color and are coated with a monolithic finish, the building itself square-shaped, like a stack of toy building blocks. Suddenly, a burst of bright yellow enters your line of sight. As David, the host of this guesthouse, explains, that splash of color represents his frame of mind. Every day is a splendid vacation under such blue skies.Originally employed as an engineer in a computer company, David has a resonant laugh and a soft heart. While performing his military service here in Taitung, David fell in love with the beautiful mountains and ocean vistas of the area. In order to give his elderly parents a place to retire and rest, he built a personal residence in the Taitung hills. At that time, now 10 years past, he spent his days tending the fruits, vegetables, and plants in his gardens. Three years ago, he began planning construction of a bed and breakfast, in the hopes of introducing even more people to the beauty of the simple life. Once built, he named this second building by combining his English (David) and Chinese (SamStrong) names. Thus, the jocular name David SamStrong Villa came into being.Framing the various postures of sunlightDavid limits admission to a single group of travelers at one time. In his villa, you can relax and live it up, and are guaranteed your favorite corner to lounge in. First floor accommodations consist of two double rooms which exhibit simple concrete-gray walls sprinkled with large splashes of yellow decor, yet are devoid of fancy furniture. Instead, large windowpanes allow the vastness of the Pacific Ocean to spill indoors. The semi-open design allows you to linger in the courtyard, strolling along the verdant garden paths. Alternately, you can sit in your doorway in a comfortable loveseat, savoring the sun-bathed hills in the distance. You can also stroll out behind the stairs, finding a wall fashioned with rectangular openings of different sizes through which the sunlight dances and plays in magical ways all day long.Climbing the stairs to the second floor, you find a living room and a kitchen in the same simple, down-to-earth style. Gray walls accentuate the natural warmth of the wooden furniture. David’s own handmade dried fruit preserves sit to one side of the dining table for the enjoyment of his guests. Two lounge chairs, ideal for sunbathing and admiring the emerald green mountainside, await you on the balcony outside. Gazing towards the base of the mountain, sky and sea meet at the horizon in a poetic landscape where time seems to stand still.Straightforward design highlighting spectacular viewsThe following morning, you are greeted by a table full of David’s handmade delicacies. Such things as eggs, salads, hibiscus tea, peanut butter and bread - all breakfast ingredients are organically grown and prepared by David and his mother. This distinctive, nourishing breakfast is made even more enjoyable by the blue backdrop of the Pacific Ocean beyond the windows.Light and shadow play through every corner of the semi-open and dynamic design of David SamStrong Villa. Wherever you go, you follow the tracks of sunshine and shade, whether standing or sitting or lying down. The green of the mountains and the blue of the ocean always seem easily within reach. How could a single day living in such luxury possibly be enough?

However, to become a B&B was not our original intention. She was graduated from the National College of Arts, was a talented artist swaying her capabilities in Taipei workplace, before experiencing a series of frustrations. Because of studying the Dharma, she changed her interpretation of and attitude toward life. Her master named the B&B Wisdom Garden Homestay.     The environment of Wisdom Garden Homestay is quiet and elegant, each room has a totally different style, does not have luxurious décor and building materials, but the furnishings are from the hostess's ingenuity, an accentuated rendition of the talents and intentions of the hostess. Wisdom Garden Homestay, a building with strong Chinese style, is many foreign travelers' favorite. Zen Joy Floor, a layout of the natural materials, has a distinctive flavor, while the Star Hunt Floor at the top of the building surrounded by french sashes is suitable for group meetings or spiritual exploration. Not much deliberate publicity making, the owner said, an arrival is a success.    In the first month of spring, frogs cry, fireflies carry lanterns, in the second month of summer, shining stars fill the sky, in early autumn lilies are all over the hillsides, and late winter Canola flowers wave in the wind. Wisdom Garden Homestay may be your mind bosom pal.

Hotels.Description: Originally a fruit farmer, Mr. Guo wanted to provide his family with a place to rest and was tired of an environment full of pesticides. Using the existing stonework and garden techniques, he converted the fruit farm into a pine tree area and the family home into a bed and breakfast, providing his family with a place to rest as well as a surplus of produce to share. A 10 minute drive from Meishan City, it features a unique wild pine tree area with nearly one hundred unique Taiwan white pines, black pines, osmanthus trees, and cherry trees of various sizes. It was built by Mr. Guo and his family, who spent 13 years to create the finished product. Currently, we offers courses in handicraft, an all-natural, wild vegetable restaurant, and more inland areas for you to slow down, relax, and be close to nature, creating your own natural wilderness life. Ours is a simple, down-to-earth bed and breakfast, featuring a beautiful environment in harmony with nature. The name comes from the Bible, as we hope this can be a place for people to leave behind the distractions of the city and put their minds and hearts at ease, enjoying a break from their busy lives so they can take on the next challenge. The owner is more than willing to share about the process of creating the bed and breakfast; a miraculous story you don’t want to miss out on!

Hotels.Description: Hua-xiang Business Hotel is located in the most bustling shopping area in Zuo-ying District, Kaohsiung. Within one minute’s walkfrom the hotel to the shopping area.  It is conveniently situated only 15 minutes by car from the Zuo-ying High Speed Rail Station. Many old brand restaurants cluster there selling scrumptious delicacies such as Nan-chang buns,Zheng-kou-wei(true taste) roast duck,  Rong-yuan pie & porridge, Jin-hua pastries , Shanghai Zui-ji(chicken cooked in wine) , Liu’s preserved vegetables with pork pot,  San-Niu (three- cattle)beef noodles.  The renowned “Rui-feng Night Market” is only 15 minutes’ driving distance from the hotel. The market is the largest, most well-managed quality night market in Kaohsiung with more than 1000 booths, selling countless types of thing. Delicious and inexpensive snacks give each visitor unforgettable mouth-watering experience that attracts frequent reporters for interviews. A ten minutes’ walk from the hotel can bring you to the shopping area of Lian-chih-tan（Lotus Pond）where Kaohsiung Zuo-ying Wan-nian Folklore Festivalis held annually . The festival, originally a local temple celebration in Zuo-ying, under vigorous promotion by local people, cultural workers, religious and Kaohsiung City Government in recent years, has evolved into the equally most representative activity in Kaohsiung City with the Kaohsiung Lantern Festival.  Nearby attractions such as the Confucius temple, Chi Ming palace, Spring and Autumn Pavilions, Wu-li Pavilion, Dragon and Tiger Pagodas, and a host of specialty snacks eateries there have all fueled the city with excitement and created a famous temple tourist spot.The hazy dawns and evenings atLian-chih-tan（Lotus Pond）unveils a mysteriously charm beyond description that one must not miss out !

Since then, she realized that seeking temporary lodging with a pet in Taiwan had been unfairly treated.   Based on doggy empathy, Qiao Mom decided to build an exclusive vacation paradise for pets and the owners, and White Sun thus became the first pet-friendly B&B in Taiwan. And through decades of steady operation, White Sun becomes the best place to go for canine friends and fellowship gatherings.     Situated on the hillside corner, White Sun has an area of ​​6,600 square meters, as a paradise hidden in a field road of Ji-An Township, Hualien. Upon entering the park, you can see a large lawn covering more than 2,130 square meters for dogs to run and chase happily without restraint, which not only lets the doggy owner be able to completely relax in the green field, but also leaves the dog obtain physical and mental balance in a woodland.     There are five biking trails surrounding the White Sun, and you can ride a bicycle strolling along and enjoying the beautiful views of the hillside and the leisurely fun. A restaurant designed by David Michael, a renowned designer, is really a comfortable dining environment, where the effect of visual sense has been extended and the warmth of European countryside style was added in.  Each room has a different creative idea, including the rustic, classic minimalist style, the European aristocratic style, etc., the only thing in common is that a vast expanse of green grassland presents outside the windows. Mattresses used here are all steel wire bi-layer with independent cylinders, matched with a soft silk quilt, 100ï¼ cotton bedding, to allow visitors to have the most comfortable sleep quality. The delicate equipment is rarely found in the other B&Bs.  You can enjoy together with your dog White Sun specially selected itineraries, whether whale watching, one-day or half-day river trekking, a true family travels.  Welcome you with your dog or dog-loving friends together to White Sun to relax and experience the leisurely pleasure of life.

Hotels.Description: In front of Yu Xuan Yuan Bed & Breakfast is a green tunnel, and behind it, a pond and garden. Situated on Tainan Road 90, it is in close proximity to the hundred-year-old mango tree green tunnel, as well as fields of lotuses and paddies of rice. Looking out across the Jianan Plain, a huge expanse of greenery and fields as far as the eye can see, is an amazing experience. In the early morning or at dusk, why not take a walk or ride, watch the sun rise/set, breathe deep of the fresh air, and relax? Or how about just taking in the majestic sight of Mt. Guanzihling (Guanziling) A mere 15-minute walk will get you to the Lotus Information Center, and one kilometer to the west sits the Linchupi Cotton Trail. About five kilometers to the west lies Xiaonanhai Natural Ecological Park, and 1.5 kilometers to the north is Lianhua (Lotus) Park. Baihe Township is 4.5km south of Yu Xuan Yuan, and about 14km to the east is Guanzihling (Guanziling), a wonderful place for a drive or a ride, with the promise of hot springs at the end! Behind Yu Xuan Yuan itself sits a “secret garden” complete with fountain, lotuses, and carp, as well as a beautiful pagoda that combines classic and modern design. With fruit trees and shrubs abounding, the air is crisp and clean, making it a refreshing place to relax and listen to nature, far from the madding crowds. The lotuses are at the best between June and August each year, filling the air with fragrance — and if you want to fully enjoy them at their peak, the best time would be between 6am and 8am. In March, the cotton trees bloom, while May sees the golden shower trees on show; April and May are also when the mangoes and passionfruit are at their best, while June offers the chance to try your hand at picking fully ripened mangoes. December, meanwhile, is the perfect time to try picking, or just appreciating, the lotus roots and having a go at making lotus flour — and of course, you’ll need somewhere to spend the night too! A stay here is truly great for the mind, body, and soul. Yu Xuan Yuan Bed & Breakfast has been running for over 13 years now, and was even recognized by the Tourism Bureau, Republic of China (Taiwan) in 2011 as one of the “100 Happy Stays” and received a “Taiwan Host” award in 2012! It truly is a place well worth a visit!

Alishan has rich, diverse natural resources, and the Guanghua area in Alishan is known as nature's ecological paradise. In the early summer, glittering fireflies dance in the woods, brightening the darkness of the night. Suddenly, you'll come face to face with the Formosan White-faced Squirrel, as it hops from branch to branch. This eco-trip will give you a chance to take a closer look at a variety of  ecology that our ecosystem offers.                                                                                         Alishan B&B - Star Resort Ecological B&B is located along Chiayi's County Road 159, near Shizhuo, Fengqihu and Alishan Forest Recreation Area. The conveniently located B&B is in a quiet, beautiful and expansive garden. The cool mountain breeze and wonderful sounds of birds chirping and insects buzzing are like music to the ears. Enjoy a cup of fine tea with the hospitable B&B owner and rejoice in the delightful and simple mountain living.                                                       Alishan B&B - Star Resort Ecological B&B has rooms that accomodate 2 to 6 people. The carefully decorated rooms are spacious, bright, warm, elegant and comfortable. You must not miss the delicious homemade meals that the lady of the house prepares. When various dishes such as fresh bamboo shoots and fresh tender wild greens arrive to the table, the tantalizing smell will wake up your appetite. After the meal, go to the forest with the owner, who's also a professional eco-tour guide, and explore the unique ecological resources and habitat that wild animals forage in.

Hotels.Description: The owner of this B&B is Mr. CHANG, Shih-Yuan. To commemorate the ancestor, the B&B is named Qing Taoyuan Homestay representing the name of CHANG, Qing-Lai, his father; CHANG WANG Chung-Tao, the mother; and part of his own name Yuan respectively. The name is adopted in the hope that their off-springs will remember the hardship of developing the home at the very beginning and that the B&B will serve as a  Shangri-La, allowing every visitor an experience different from city life. It is an individual blue and yellow villa, resembling a castle standing tall and firm in a wide meadow. The outdoor courtyard is specifically designed and arranged by the innovative ideas of the owner decorated with stone, pavilion and recreational facilities in presenting delicate and secluded landscape guiding visitors to the dream-like fairy tale land while serving as a playground for children. The guestrooms are designed in modernized concise style adorned with wooden flooring and comfortable bedding. In this way, every room is subtly designed by the owner like his own room to provide a clean and comfortable living quality for every guest. "Kenting - Qing Taoyuan Homestay" has a great view and allows you to look far into the mountains . You may look toward the mountain ranges along the “Niu Shan Ling Mountain and further to the lake scenery of the “Lung Luan Lake” and the birds flying around there. While taking in  the dawn, be sure to take a big breath of the fresh air. When strolling in the garden, stop occasionally to find the species of the birds that are singing. Enjoy the fund of the wild field and the beauty of sunset dusk. Before turning in, do not forget to look upward and say good night to the stars. Travel is to discover another level of life! A quest for the fun of life.

Every person reserves a place for dreams in their heart, and should you wish to discover new surprises, take a music and flower tour and visit Arce Wisteria Bed and Breakfast.

Hotels.Description: This is a very special B&B. Its open-structured and permeable decoration is full of art spirit, showing the style of fashion and indicating the freedom and lifestyle. Surprisingly, the B&B host, Mr. Dai, is a young and cheerful man, and his friends call him Dai. He is fond of independent travel, and occasionally saw loft-style B&B's when traveling abroad. The open-structured space with no partitions and freestyle design had attracted his attention. He started to have a dream. It is hard to imagine that this humorous and friendly young man was a perfect salesman with outstanding performance in the banking industry. However, his life was filled with work. He worked long hours and attending social functions, and often came back home at late night. He suddenly realized that what he was missing when he saw his children sound asleep. At last, when he was 40, he made an important decision - to retire. He found his own way after tendering his resignation letter. He desired to make his dream come true. What he saw abroad affected him and made him eager for action, and he started to make plans. He wanted to bond with his children when it was not too late, let them grow up in a great environment, and realize his dream - running a special B&B. After thinking carefully, he settled down in Hualien - the most beautiful area in Taiwan. He spent two years completing his own buildings- from design and plan to selecting materials and constructing, and he gradually completed the perfect B&B in his mind. He owns two buildings for the B&B. Building A, with dark red brick walls, vintage electric fans, visible  pipelines and log doors, makes you go back to the 1950s. Building B, with black iron partition cabinet, leather sofa and glossy floor, shows an ornate style to make you feel like displaced in time and place. There is no other B&B like Ji Ye Jing Zhan Villa Homestay in Taiwan. Dai hopes that travelers can experience the happiness he had experienced before as long as they visit Hualien- no flight ticket, not going abroad, and no tiring flight.

Hotels.Description: Creek is in front of my house, behind the house the hills, mountains on one side and water on the other. Insects buzz and birds chirp and they are everywhere. Floral aromas emit. No hubbub of the city, only mountains and waters, and filled with the fragrance of nature, and ears filled with the sounds of nature& #39;s call.  Here, take a deep breath to relieve your physical and mental fatigue, here is the travelers& #39; warm home on their journey. Taumi Community in Puli is seemingly a barren marsh, a large depression of streams, but it has the largest frog species in Taiwan, damselflies and the largest number of fireflies, Grandma Frog--Wang Hui Mei was so plunge into the frog world. The host couple of "Grandma Frog Farm House" after working for a lifetime career and fatigued, they settled the fancy Taumi environment and choose to retire here. Wang Hui Mei originally engaged in teaching flower arrangement and site layout in Taichung, she has a unique sense of beauty and self-confidence, single-handedly led the B&B Planning and design of the room, but also unexpectedly surrender to frogs, birds and other small animals under innocence. Wiped off the makeup and took off costumes, dig in the pond bare-handed, and become Grandma Frog, Wang Hui Mei has no regret. Although called her Grandma Frog, she really is not old. It is the children call comes. But for understanding frogs and committed to it, that is her most vivid impression and joy of life .Both she and her daughter made a certificate for the narrator. She understands fully the voice of frogs, features, and characteristics. When talking about the fogs, she can speak on a subject with great familiarity, and a grin. Following their lead to observe frogs will be the most unforgettable memories of the stay. Grandma Frog Farm House, every lovely bits and pieces are all touching little stories. Perhaps you later will forget Grandma Frog of Puli Taumi, but I& #39;m sure you will not forget. The eco here ... and our story ... will give you a feeling of lifetime of memories ~

Hotels.Description: Spring Feng Bed and Breakfast is located in Jhongliao (Zhongliao) Township (Nantou County), facing Jiji Mountain in the east and Jiji Township in the south, and located a 35 minute drive from Sun Moon Lake. In order to experience the simple life, the owner decided to build a farm and pond on his own land after retiring. Here, he has arranged every plant and tree and included a vegetable garden. For environmental reasons, he weeds by hand, makes his own organic fertilizer, and reuses wastewater and rainwater so as not to waste natural resources. This makes the garden rich in ecology, with tree frogs, Muller’s barbets, Chinese bamboo partridges, and scops owls. During the spring, summer, and fall, the frogs begin singing in the evenings, causing quite the commotion and staring at us, wondering why people never give them a round of applause. The pleasing sound of chirping birds in the morning seems to be calling us to wake up, get out of bed, and enjoy the fresh air outside! Looking off at the mountains in the distance and watching birds flying in pairs, one cannot help but feel their heart open up and mind be at peace. The total area is approximately 9000 square meters, including 700 Taiwanese indigenous cinnamon trees. The bed and breakfast itself occupies about 2500 square meters, including a parking lot, cinnamon oil refining DIY activity, special cinnamon spiced cuisine (cinnamon chicken, golden eggs, fried rice, and tea), cinnamon products (cinnamon shampoo, body wash, mosquito repellent, hand lotion, and lip gloss). Guests can enjoy cinnamon baths with fragrant oils, helping them relax and relieve pressure.

Hotels.Description: About TLHThe Lees Hotel The company’s core culture is based on the artistic persistence and the corporate governance of the founder Dr. Lee Deng Mu; with a background in arts, architecture and business, Dr. Lee uses his natural acuity for business management and arts and culture and established a five star hotel complete with humanities, services, aesthetics, and facilities. The aim of the hotel is to treat the guests with honor. Also, by creating a living space full of aesthetic and cultural ambience, guests can easily encounter antiques, paintings and other art works in the lobby, hallways, or other unexpected places.  The aesthetic of the building The design of the building is based on the Chinese character “zun”, which in ancient times refers to the utensil the emperor uses to drink wine. By using the shape of the word as an exterior design expresses the company’s respect towards guests and staffs. The building material uses granite panels to express a sense of honor, glory and generosity. The main wall is Italian styled with four different colors of imported pearl mosaic panels and shifts color under different angles of sunlight. The aesthetic of the spacesThe lobby is presented with the simple and modest modern new classical and decoration art styles. The overall design uses marble floors and maple wood integrated with indirect lightings along with a collection of many art works. The ten meter high ceiling atrium uses metal and glass to design a large modernistic overhead art piece, echoing with the restaurants on the second floor. The abstract paintings painted by the founder Dr. Lee Deng Mu are hanged on the lobby walls, adding a spacious and imposing ambience to the lobby.

Hotels.Description: Hua-xiang Business Hotel is located in the most bustling shopping area in Zuo-ying District, Kaohsiung. Within one minute’s walkfrom the hotel to the shopping area.  It is conveniently situated only 15 minutes by car from the Zuo-ying High Speed Rail Station. Many old brand restaurants cluster there selling scrumptious delicacies such as Nan-chang buns,Zheng-kou-wei(true taste) roast duck,  Rong-yuan pie & porridge, Jin-hua pastries , Shanghai Zui-ji(chicken cooked in wine) , Liu’s preserved vegetables with pork pot,  San-Niu (three- cattle)beef noodles.  The renowned “Rui-feng Night Market” is only 15 minutes’ driving distance from the hotel. The market is the largest, most well-managed quality night market in Kaohsiung with more than 1000 booths, selling countless types of thing. Delicious and inexpensive snacks give each visitor unforgettable mouth-watering experience that attracts frequent reporters for interviews. A ten minutes’ walk from the hotel can bring you to the shopping area of Lian-chih-tan（Lotus Pond）where Kaohsiung Zuo-ying Wan-nian Folklore Festivalis held annually . The festival, originally a local temple celebration in Zuo-ying, under vigorous promotion by local people, cultural workers, religious and Kaohsiung City Government in recent years, has evolved into the equally most representative activity in Kaohsiung City with the Kaohsiung Lantern Festival.  Nearby attractions such as the Confucius temple, Chi Ming palace, Spring and Autumn Pavilions, Wu-li Pavilion, Dragon and Tiger Pagodas, and a host of specialty snacks eateries there have all fueled the city with excitement and created a famous temple tourist spot.The hazy dawns and evenings atLian-chih-tan（Lotus Pond）unveils a mysteriously charm beyond description that one must not miss out !

Hotels.Description: Sometimes you call your lover or best friend "My sweetie," and that is exactly why we name our B&B as "my sweetie homestay"! Just imagining how a husband would treat his beloved wife, we have the same feeling to share the pure food and friendly people with you. Taking friendliness and health as the business theories,"my sweetie homestay" is committed to providing the tourists a healthy and non-toxic accommodation. "Friendliness" means being friendly to the earth, which means cultivating and tilling without using insecticides, chemical fertilizer or herbicides. The host is an eco-friendly farmer supported by the County Government. In the plantation, we planted lots of trees, constructed a water lily ecological pond and only use natural detergents and cleaning solutions. We try our best to be friendly to the Earth. Inside the house, we put the furniture made of logs, and set up the barrier-free facilities. There is less decoration in the house; thus, we make low pollution and reduce the chance for people breathing in the chemical substance. We try our best to be friendly towards people. The host is a food expert and has the certificates of Level B and C technician for Chinese culinary and for baking food. He knows well that chemical additives are harmful, so he selects the best natural food ingredients for you. You can experience the plantation life and cook with clean ingredients. My sweetie homestay is located in Kelin Village, Dongshan Township, Yilan County, and is close to resorts like Luodong Sports Park, night market, Plum Blossom Lake, Kelin Fountain, Annong River and E-long goat farm. The B&B is near Luodong River, and you would have an extensive view - the sunrise in the morning, the sunset in the evening, and stars and moon at night. Besides, you would see Guishan Island on your left and San-Ching-Kung on the right. The scenic beauty will definitely refresh your mind. Welcome to the best B&B of Yilan!

Hotels.Description: The name Beras Manor Kenting is a transliteration inspired by the Indonesian phrase meaning “a manor by the rice fields.” Nestled in an organic environment, the property is surrounded by rich natural ecosystems—frogs croak, insects buzz, and birds sing throughout the day. With a bit of luck, guests may even encounter fireflies at night. The view through the large floor-to-ceiling windows resembles a painting, constantly changing with the seasons and offering a unique experience every visit.Beras Manor Kenting provides a comfortable and nature-connected vacation setting. Its unique geographical location, surrounded by lush tropical greenery, creates a peaceful and refreshing atmosphere for visitors. The B&B’s design incorporates natural elements, blending harmoniously with the landscape to offer guests a relaxing and rejuvenating stay.Conveniently located just a short distance from Kenting Main Street and the major attractions of Kenting National Park, the manor is only a 2-kilometer drive from the historic Hengchun Old Town. Guests can easily explore famous beaches, night markets, and scenic spots. Whether day or night, the surrounding tropical ambiance offers a complete escape from the everyday.The rooms at Beras Manor Kenting cater to a variety of needs, whether you're traveling as a couple or with family. Each room is thoughtfully designed with modern and minimalist décor, creating a warm and cozy experience. The beds are soft and comfortable, ensuring a restful night’s sleep, and the bathrooms are clean and well-equipped—making guests feel right at home. Some rooms, such as the Scenic Double Rooms, even feature private balconies where guests can enjoy the view, soak in the sunset, or gaze at the stars.With its excellent environment and high-quality facilities, Beras Manor Kenting is an ideal destination for vacationers. Whether you're here to admire the beauty of nature or to find a quiet place to unwind, this charming retreat offers the perfect stay.

Hotels.Description: Natou｜Jiji Village B&BA traditional courtyard farmhouse where time temporarily stands stillAs you pass over the Jilu Bridge, cross farmers’ fields, and survey the rolling hills, the distracting thoughts in your mind all dissipate. In a moment, you seem to transcend space and time, returning to olden days where you encounter a traditional courtyard farmhouse, majestic in its old age and exuding the genuine ambiance of 1950s Taiwan. You feel as though you’ve walked into the type of picturesque pastoral landscape described in ancient Chinese poetry. Jiji Village B&B possesses a sunny verdancy, the courtyard of a mountain getaway, and host Mr. Liu’s love of the land.Deeply felt memories of childhoodYou and your friends disembark and put both feet on the soft, grassy ground as sunlight shines through lattice covered with loofah gourd vines. You pass through the wooden front doors surrounded by spring couplets, and admire the red brick walls which bear the traces of passing time. “Come right in and have a seat!” You hear Mr. Liu’s friendly welcome as a small, yellow dog named Cachito greets you. The name Cachito originates from a Spanish folktale, and Mr. Liu regards Cachito as a gift from heaven.This spacious, modern three-building courtyard is full of layers. The sunlight and air from the front vestibule and rear courtyard are able to penetrate inside through large, wooden-framed windows, imprinting the window screens with numerous beautiful silhouettes. The huge space is divided by wooden panels and doors, and to both sides, the refreshing greenery of potted plants is seen along the hinoki promenades of the left and right buildings. The entire space encourages you to slow your pace and wander leisurely around, taking in the scenery.A true reflection of the 1950sFrom the roof beams inside to the steps in the courtyard, from the low stone walls to the courtyard well, entering this house of wood and stone is like stepping into the childhood memories of Mr. and Mrs. Liu. According to Mr. Liu, “Wood and stone are two key elements here at Jiji Village B&B, because the veins in the stone and the grain of the wood are respectively identical inside and outside. So, too, should be the mind of man and woman.” Mr. Liu hopes that all travelers who visit here can perceive the sincerity which this building emits. Pushing open the rosewood screen doors and heading to the second-floor rooms, the floorboards creaking underfoot are reminiscent of childhood days chasing siblings up and down the halls and stairs. Jiji Village offers three guest rooms in old fashioned styles. The walls of the Taiwan Fir Tree Country-Style Room are constructed from Chinese fir, and the woody aroma permeates the room. The Japanese Tatami Room is exceedingly comfortable. Yet the most romantic of all is the Classic Chinese Canopy Bed Room. Mr. Liu searched far and wide to find this traditional bed. The room is also furnished with an ornately carved dresser, embroidered red pillows, and an antique gramophone phonograph player, creating a romantic dreamland for you and your lover.A traditional farmhouse infused with modernityBeneath a single yellow light bulb, Mr. and Mrs. Liu prepare dinner beside the traditional wood burning kitchen hearth. Mr. Liu cheerfully carries out plate after plate of authentic vegetable and meat dishes; juicy bamboo shoot with meat, organic loofah gourd fresh from the garden, braised bean and pork, and healthy burdock consommé, all made with love. After the meal, you chat over the tea table off to one side of the dining room, admiring the traditional Taiwanese tea spread and delicate ceramic teaware. Mr. Liu also has a traditional Japanese tea spread with tatami seating. Hollows in the floor allow you to extend your legs comfortably as the moon shines through the windows and reflects off the tea in your cup. You walk out into the courtyard to appreciate the tranquil evening and the cool, countryside air. The summer sun, just like a farmer, rises early, illuminating the bright green lawn in the courtyard. Waking to the shadows dancing in the passion fruit orchard outside your window, you walk spritely downstairs to find that Mrs. Liu has prepared a sumptuous breakfast of refreshing salad and rice milk, reminding you of the happiness to be found in simple things.After retiring from the air force, Mr. Liu felt homesick and so decided to return to his childhood home in Nantou and start a guesthouse business. He could not have anticipated that he would encounter the devastating Jiji earthquake which rocked Taiwan on the 21st of September, 1999. That traumatic event did not dishearten Mr. Liu, instead inspiring him to begin the activity of “Orally Recounting History” where he did relief work to aid those affected by the disaster. He and Mrs. Liu set up a vendor’s stall selling Job’s tear milk on the street, using their love of their homeland to get back on their feet. First, they opened a restaurant based on all of the old, traditional recipes they could find by interviewing the local elders, inviting travelers to taste the local flavors of Jiji. Yet they never forgot their original intention to open a guesthouse. Thus, after opening their restaurant and winery, they devoted themselves wholeheartedly to the operation of their guesthouse, a road that they have walked together, supporting one another all the way, using past frustrations to nurture their aspirations. They based their blueprints upon childhood memories, inviting travelers into their traditional courtyard farmhouse, to enjoy tranquility, happiness, and contentment.
