Hotels.Description: The owner of Yun Ju House has 5 brothers and 1 uncle, and the 6 families gather together every Chinese New Year’s or major holiday. So the owner and his wife dreamed of having a big house where everyone could comfortably stay, and thus built this place in the outskirts of Jiaoxi as a vacation villa for relatives working in other parts of the country to return to. In order to maintain accommodation quality, whenever not occupied by relatives it is open to travelers who happen to make their way here. Yun Ju House is situated on a countryside path, with different scenery throughout the year, from the time of rice planting to harvesting. The little birds will serve as your alarm clock, and on clear days you can gaze out at the beauty of Guishan Island and the Xueshan Mountain Range, making this a great place for a day trip. Rest your weary body in the hot springs and enjoy the serenity of the countryside fields. Many of our customers choose to rent out the entire building. The first floor includes a spacious living room and tea brewing area with complete facilities for guests to use, while the spacious activity area behind the building lets guests fire up a countryside BBQ, chat with a group of friends, go for a leisurely bike ride through the fields and appreciate different scenery throughout the year. Located in a quiet spot away from the noise of the city, we’re a 2 minute bike ride away from King Car Ecological Orchid Garden, a 28,200 square meter greenhouse area where you can see butterflies and a sea of orchids. We’re a 3 minute drive from the Mary Leu Carving Art Gallery and 6 minute drive from Jiaoxi City, making this a great place to plan an art and fine cuisine-themed trip.

Hotels.Description: Looking at the map of Kinmen, Kinmen looks like a bone, and the B&B is located just above the middle of the bone in the "Hengcuo" Village. This is the fastest way for people who don't know Kinmen to find this B&B, and it is also the most impressive. Hengshan Laoye Villa is located in the natural village of Hengcuo, just in the middle of Qionglin and Housha. It is particularly located in a moderate location and has convenient transportation. It is about seven kilometers away from the city centers of Jincheng, Shanwai and Shamei, about four kilometers from Shangyi Airport, and about 12 kilometers from Shuitou Pier. It takes more than ten minutes to walk to the adjacent Qionglin Underground Tunnel Scenic Area. "Qionglin Settlement" is one of the representatives of Kinmen's traditional settlements. It retains a large number of traditional Minnan buildings with swallow-tailed horses on back. In addition, the ancestral temples are the largest and most distinctive. In addition to the "Cai Family Temple" of the main ancestral family, each house also has its own ancestral hall. Two of them are in the same three-story building, so they are known as the "Seven Eight Ancestral Halls". Someone once used Tao Yuanming's "Peach Blossom Spring" to describe the village of "Hengcuo". Therefore, the village is located in a basin surrounded by trees. So when you enter from the path, you will be very confused. But after walking a few dozen steps, you will see a stream and a large lawn. There are small fish playing in the stream and turtles bathing in the sun. The teal ducks and water birds are swimming leisurely in the river and looking for food.  You can also watch birds walking or foraging on the lawn, as if they are not afraid of people approaching. Then you will see several houses located in this basin, and the Hengshan Laoye Villa is one of them.  Especially due to its superior geographical location, natural environment and lack of excessive man-made development, it upholds the concept of symbiosis between man and the environment, creating this village like a paradise. Therefore, you can see many birds coming to live in this building, and you can also see otters, Kinmen's protected animals, here. The creek in front of the B&B is connected to the sea. You can walk 400 meters along the village path. The first thing you see is a small intertidal zone. In the intertidal zone, you can see cute mudskippers bouncing in the water. Fiddler crabs are constantly shuttling in the caves. Groups of small crabs will dig in the sand in a spiral shape when people get close. Of course, there are many unknown creatures living in this intertidal zone. Walk dozens of steps along this intertidal zone to see the beautiful, deep and boundless sea. If you encounter a recession, When the tide is high, you can dig clams in this large intertidal zone and enjoy the fun. When the tide is high, you can sit on the shore and listen to the sound of the waves, which can calm your mind, or you can take off your shoes and socks to play with the waves.

Hotels.Description: If there is a name that can stir your emotions, it is The Lalu(Han Bi Lo in Chinese), even if each word in the name costs a hundred million dollars. In 1901, Mr. Ito built a small wooden cabin on the Lalu Peninsula for vacation use and called it “TheFor hundreds of years, with strict entrance control, only senior governmental official, generals, prime ministers, and emperors are allowed into The Lalu. Therefore, a myth is created to this building. However, how did The Lalu  come about?In 1923, the Japanese Crown Prince Hirohito visited Taiwan and appointed The Lalu to be his official residence. He rebuilt the small wooden cabin into a two-story building and added eight guest rooms, including the east and the west wings, dining room, conference room and more. From this time on, The Lalu turned itself from a luxury vacation home into an official government guest house.In 1949, when the Chinese Nationalist Government retreated to Taiwan, The Lalu became President Chiang Kai-Shek’s hostel, used primarily for vacation use and to entertain foreign head of states.In 1998, Mr. Cheng-Yi Lai, chairman of the Shining Group, received a phone call that filled his heart with tremendous excitement and doubt. For the past 30 years, his dream was to build a world class hotel along the shores of Sun Moon Lake. The man that made the phone call indicated to him that The Lalu was for sale.However, buying this historical building was not going to be a simple task. The seller was asking for a sum of NT$ 270 million  and made it clear that it was not negotiable. It took over a year of hard work and negotiation, with the end result closing at the firm asking price of NT$ 270 million. Mr. Lai recalled and said, “Which name is always on people’s mind without ever needing any advertisement? This name has its place and historical value in public’s mind so the name itself is priceless. Even with millions that we spent on it, I think it’s still a bargain.”After 5 years and an investment of NT$ 1.86 billion, using the theory of utmost simplification of Zen style as the architectural design core from our award winning international design team, the renovation of this historical hotel began. It was rebuilt from the original palace style 6 story building, saving only its beams, columns and floor and replacing everything else. The new design divides the building into three separate building (building A, B and C) for different purposes. Building A is the main guest house. Building B is the structure that houses entertainment facilities such as the Spa, gym, Jacuzzi and Members Clubhouse. Building C includes the Villa area, conference facility, Library and parking lot. On March 3, 2002, The Lalu reopened to the public with its new design and resort style .

Hotels.Description: Miaoli｜ChooArt VillaBreathe with Nature and Return to the Tranquility Embraced by the ForestThe ripples of the green pool water reflect the beautiful shadows of trees in your mind. Close your eyes and let the mountain breeze brush against your body. Passing by the Longteng Broken Bridge, you are driving on the mountain road to Sanyi, Miaoli County. When the car enters ChooArt Villa, the fragrance of flowers and plants floats in the air and a large striped-dove flies in the sky. Behind the hidden wooden door, your exclusive holiday is expecting your arrival. Here, you breathe with nature, while the mountain and woods embrace you with their beauty.Share with Nature the Leisurely Vacation in Mountain Woods Under the rooftop garden of irises, the vine-covered buildings of ChooArt Villa in the valley are beautifully arranged in a haphazard way like stylish tree houses, while staying close to nature. You enter the lobby with the floor-to-ceiling windows and doors, have a cup of coffee and rest for a bit. Sit in the sofa chair by the glass window, browse through some magazines or books, take in the scenery and just enjoy the leisurely time.Step down the outdoor stairs, and you find yourself at the pool, where the verdant camphor woods above provide you with shade. When the wind blows, the tree branches and leaves flutter, and the shadows on the spring water sway to a natural rhythm. You sit on the deck chair as your lover floats relaxingly in the water. Your cheerful mood is accompanied by the chirping of the birds. Everything is just so delightful and at ease.Sun, Tree, River, and Moon; Planting Four Relaxing Sleep SpacesBeing built along the contour of the hill, four double rooms of ChooArt share a simple character, and they breathe and live with the woods. Walking into the “Tree Spring” double room, time seems to slow down here. In the bedroom space, three camphor trees stretching up toward the light are surrounded by the glass windows. Get closer to the window, and you’d enjoy the relaxing melody composed by the bamboo forest and the creek outside. Take off your clothes and get through the U-shaped corridor by the greenery balcony, you’ll arrive at the spacious bathroom with the forest view. The “Sunny River” room offers the view of the ruins of the Broken Bridge. You may listen to the sound of running water and enjoy the quiet peace here. The sunlight penetrates the transparent floor-to-ceiling gauze curtains of the “First Sun” room, while the bed with the gauze canopy brings you a sense of the romantic holiday. You can also walk through the glass passage with the reflection of the blue sky to the bathroom. In the “Tipsy Moon” room, you can admire the enchanting starry sky and the lush scenery.Taste the Authentic Taiwanese Flavor in the Creative CuisineAs your stay at ChooArt includes two meals, you can enjoy the culinary delights that incorporate  creative ideas with local ingredients. In the evening, you step into the dining room on the second floor, where the chef will demonstrate how the food is carefully prepared in the open kitchen. There are refreshing appetizers, hearty salads, and creative dishes with a variety of artistic senses. Of course, the highlight would be the surf and turf meal combined with the seared short beef rib and coral hind from Penghu, bringing the perfect ending to the evening. In the morning, the breakfast contains a bowl of warm vegetable porridge and small dishes made with the ingredients purchased from the local farmers, all with simple seasoning for you to savor the most natural flavors.The name of the villa, ChooArt, is the Taiwanese word for trees, representing a tribute to the land and local hospitality. The team is dedicated to the coexistence of the ecologically sustainable architecture and nature. This dedication also leads ChooArt Villa to be the Gold Winner of the 2017 FIABCI World Prix d’Excellence Environmental Award (as “Oscars Award” of the real estate industry). The team believes that a good balance can be achieved by planting trees while building houses. Just like Brian, the amicable CEO, said: “A lot of things should not be taken for granted, we must learn how to adapt to nature.” His respect for the earth also deeply affects the employees of ChooArt. Working as a staff here, not only one’s capability is a must, but the attitude one bears would be the key. The staff here learn from nature while serving each traveler wholeheartedly.Before you leave, come to the lobby and enjoy some Chinese tea and a good chat with the tea master. With a cup of fine tea, reserve some quiet time for yourself. The aroma drifting in the air just reminds you of the thoughtfulness of ChooArt and the wonderfulness of being embraced by the forest.

Hotels.Description: Number 36 Lighthouse Home Stay is situated in Hualien City, and is the home stay closest to the ocean. Along the coast, there are many recreational facilities, which allow you to easily step closer to this beautiful ocean. The homes stay owner is very friendly, and makes every guest feel right at home. The old lighthouse in memory: Originally it was pure white. In 1980, Hualien Harbor was extended, and the lighthouse was demolished; a new red lighthouse was later built. The lighthouse during our childhood was a landmark where we gathered and played, and also a place we went to when we are bored. No matter how we played, we and the lighthouse are inseparable. The lighthouse became the most loyal playmate. Now, I have also established my own white lighthouse, and I also hope to provide travelers the best recreational choice in Hualien. You can enjoy the beautiful views of the Pacific Ocean from your room. Lying in bed, you can see the sunset and hear the sound of wave crashing. Outside the building, there is an ocean view platform where you can drink coffee leisurely, and enjoy the ocean scenery. Our scenery is worth appreciating and will relax you. Number 36 Lighthouse is the only place with the magnificent sunrise in the east, sea breeze and bright moon at night, sea viewing, wave listening, and the sight  of fishing boats entering and exiting the harbor. Local delicacies, from seafood and bomb scallion pancakes, temple pole black tea, Gong Cheng steamed buns to Yi Hsian won ton can all be eaten nearby. You can also rent motorcycles to travel to each scenic spot. We arrange trips to the famous Nan Bing (Nanbin) and Tzu Chiang (Ziqiang) Night Markets, Bei Bing Park, the beach, Farglory Ocean Park nearby, and also whale watching and river tracing trips.

Hotels.Description: The Radium Kagaya International Hotel is located in the Beitou district of Taipei City, less than a 5 minute walk from the Xinbeitou Metro Rail Transit (MRT) Station. Conveniently situated across the hotel are historic landmarks such as the Beitou Hot Spring Museum and the eco-friendly Taipei Public Library (Beitou Branch).AccommodationsThe hotel offers 90 exquisitely appointed Japanese Sukiya style guestrooms ranging in size from 13 pings to 32 pings. All guestrooms feature cypress wood or marble hot springs bathing facilities, generous living spaces, premium mattresses and luxurious down beddings for an unforgettable night’s rest.  Public and Private Hot Spring Rooms The public hot-spring facility overlooks the picturesque Beitou mountainside and is equipped with indoor bathing areas, sauna and steam rooms allowing guests to experience total relaxation. 17 individual hot-spring rooms provide guests with the utmost privacy; these bath houses employ cypress wood and natural millstones as themes, displaying various different decor, and providing guests with another type of choice. The Spa by Socie (5F)Operated by Japan’s top spa “Socie”, using renowned E-SPA skin care products imported from England, employing a tranquil interior design and professional techniques and treatments, bringing you a once in a lifetime luxurious serenity.Dining (In Room)The chef serves a traditional “Kaiseki” meal comprised of numerous dishes featuring the freshest ingredients from Taiwan and Japan while employing classical cooking methods originating from the Noto region of Japan, the birthplace of the original Kagaya. Each dish and utensil has been handpicked to enable the guest to experience a truly authentic Japanese meal. Tenshou Restaurant The restaurant overlooks the lush mountains of Beitou. Aside from the Kaiseki meals, Tenshou provides authentic Japanese dishes for lunch and dinner. Tenshou also has  7 private dining rooms to cater to larger parties, family gatherings and business banquets. Yuuduki Bar (2F)The bar overlooks Beitou Park and serves an impressive collection of Japanese sakes, red & white wines, imported and local beers.Function/Conference Rooms (6F) Conference rooms are located on the sixth floor and are adorned in the traditional Japanese-style. The 6 rooms cater to small and larger groups depending on the need. The venues are equipped with complete conference facilities and meal facilities.  Guests will leave with an unforgettable meeting experience.

Hotels.Description: Nestled along the coast of Zhuangwei Township in Yilan, 9G Love Ocean Villa is conveniently located less than 1 kilometer from several top attractions, including Lanyang Animal and Botanical Kingdom, Zhuangwei Sand Dunes Visitor Center, Yi Qi Yuan Ranch, Zhuangwei Beach Swings, and Yongzhen Seaside Park. The villa offers free parking in front of the property, suitable for tour buses or 4–9 cars, and receipts are available—making it ideal for families, student groups, or corporate outings, whether arriving by car or bus.Although the villa consists of two separate buildings—the Main House and Windmill House—they are rented together as one exclusive booking, with only one group hosted at a time, ensuring privacy and a relaxed experience.There are 17 rooms in total, including: 1 single room (shared bathroom), 1 double room (shared bathroom), 9 double suites, and 6 quadruple suites. Rooms are allocated based on the group size, and unused rooms are securely locked.The base occupancy is 28 people, but the villa can accommodate up to 65 guests with extra beds. Facilities include a spacious 25-ping (approx. 82 sqm) outdoor BBQ area with sunshade and restrooms, a kitchen, KTV karaoke system, electric mahjong table, free Wi‑Fi, as well as baby-friendly items like a bathtub, bottle sterilizer, and bed rails. With its proximity to the beach and multiple attractions, Love Ocean Villa is a perfect choice for family-friendly and pet-friendly group stays in Yilan.Rates start at NT$22,000 per night on weekdays (up to 28 guests) and NT$28,000 on weekends (up to 28 guests). Official receipts are available. This villa is highly recommended for family reunions, class gatherings, and company retreats looking for a spacious and private getaway.shared kitchen, coffee machine, and Wi-Fi. It’s also a pet-friendly accommodation, welcoming furry companions for a cleaning fee of NT$1,000 per pet—making it one of the top choices for private pet-friendly stays in Yilan.

Hotels.Description: Yilan｜Shire GuesthouseThe Tranquil Life in a Secluded AlleyOn a balmy afternoon, you set aside your busy life and take a leisurely stroll across the Luodong Sports Park. In the quiet alleys behind the park, among the many rows of residential houses, you see the elegant Chinese characters of the Shire Guesthouse sign. You need not go far to find your ideal lifestyle after all, for it now appears right before your eyes.The leisure to be found within a secluded residenceThe term “Shire” comes from Ｔhe Lord of the Rings and is the place where the Hobbits live. Shire Guesthouse is precisely like the Shire we know from the movies; a warm, leisurely, peaceful life amid the natural beauty of the land. In this place, your hosts Ivan and his wife Ivy have realized their ideal lifestyle. The moment you set foot in Shire Guesthouse, you are greeted by genial sunlight spilling across a soft carpet through large French windows with warm wooden furniture everywhere you look. The design of Shire Guesthouse has a simple beauty which is not showy. The red brick flooring throughout the ground level makes for a cozy living room, extending under the dining table and into the kitchen. The pastiche stone walls stealthily absorb the humidity of the Yilan air, making for ideal temperatures all year round. Even staying indoors, it is easy to find a spot to sit or lounge or flip through a book and enjoy a leisurely time.Ivan, who began learning landscape design when in university, has unique tastes and specialties. He worked with many important construction companies after graduation. The Luodong Sports Park is one of his works of which he is particularly fond. Later on, he fell in love with Ivy, after which time they worked together to realize their aspirations to build a guesthouse. Before retreating into their Shire lifestyle, Ivy who was born in Yilan was working in Taipei as a clothing assistant. Though the bustling city has its charms, Ivy longed to return to her familiar hometown. As such, when Ivan proposed returning to Yilan to open a guesthouse, Ivy threw herself into the project without hesitation in order to create a beautiful life with her lover. A beautiful evening with the BeatlesFollowing the pastiche stone walls upstairs, the unadorned whitewall design evokes the simple life, alleviating your everyday exhaustion. Walking into the shower to wash away your fatigue, the multi-colored porcelain wall tiles add a splash of excitement to life. Continuing the solid-wood theme of the Shire, the bedroom’s wooden pillars were handpicked by Ivan himself. The unpreserved Taiwanese cypress shows the vestiges of time, like the process of the beautification of life itself. In the quiet of the evening, you are accompanied by the Beatles singing “A Hard Day’s Night” as you recline on the retro leather sofa reading a book until the vinyl record clock on the wall points to 11 o’clock. Even nighttime at the Shire is full of vitality. If you are lucky enough, you may have the pleasure of engaging in deep conversation with Ivan and Ivy, which may be the start of a secret adult meeting. Make an appointment on a whim, chatting happily over some drinks from their private red wine collection - tonight you feel just as content as if meeting with intimate friends for the first time in ages. The courage to face your ideal lifeAs the first rays of sunlight spill into the room, you feel prepared to meet a new day. As your footsteps on the stairs signal your descent to the ground floor, Ivy starts to cook a hot breakfast and the delicious aromas fill the air - the Shire menu changes in accordance with the seasons. Yet one thing always stays the same: the courtesy and consideration extended to all travelling guests. The daily menu and ingredients are flexible, so that even the picky traveler can eat their fill. If you haven’t eaten enough, there is no need to feel awkward - Ivy will happily cook another portion for you! “You need a full belly to be able to head out to have fun!” Ivy’s warm, impassioned laugh and your full belly fill you afresh with energy.The appearance of the ideal life may be a little journey with your sisters, a delightful trip with your sweetheart, or perhaps running off bravely on your own adventure. As such, Ivan and Ivy have the consideration to offer a special package for independent travelers, as a way to assist you in setting off on a new life. If it is in your destiny, perhaps Ivy can even accompany you in exploring parts of Yilan you’ve never seen. “In fact, Ivy always says that I’m just like a hobbit, which is why this place is called the Shire.” Ivan smilingly jokes about Ivy. From time to time, the sound of their quarrels and laughter fills the whole house. The Shire feels like a simple, ordinary space, yet it is filled with an indescribable energy that brings warmth and happiness to all who stay there. Hotels.Description: Miaoli｜Spend TimeSpend time soaking in hot springs and enjoying nature by the lakesideThe afternoon scenery unfolds before your eyes as you drive up into the mountains in Dahu Township, Miaoli County. There, you find Spend Time guesthouse which melds into the landscape between mountains and lakes, resembling a picturesque painting.Enjoy Mother Nature’s genuine welcomeAs you walk down the stone path from your car to the guesthouse, you are surprised to discover that the main building sits right beside the lake. Water and mountains wrap around on all sides. Vivid flowers and trees abound. You are met by a delicious breeze and dancing butterflies. As you stroll around the wooden guesthouse, you can sense that nature has already prepared a full itinerary for you.Wandering by the flowing brooks on a bright sunny day, you can observe wisteria and sakura flowers in early spring and tung oil tree blossoms toward the end of the season. In the golden autumn, the sycamores turn red and you can behold the starry sky while steeping in hot-spring pools at night. During summer evenings, you open the balcony doors and the fireflies make their debut as the lake shimmers before your eyes. Spend Time guesthouse is always ready to serve you something spectacular whenever you swing by.Beauty in the scenery, the cuisine, the people, and the hot springsAt Spend Time, not only can you enjoy all the beauty that nature unselfishly provides; various kinds of local delicacies and homemade wines are also on offer. The roasted strawberry beer chicken and German-style pig’s trotters are must-try dishes. A Chinese-style breakfast with mouthwatering steamed breads is served lake-side every morning. The housekeeper and all the staff are exceedingly hospitable. You might even have the opportunity to taste unique, homemade grape and kumquat wines.Commonly referred to as “beauty springs”, the sodium bicarbonate hot-springs are one of the distinguishing features here. Spend Time guesthouse insists on providing an authentic hot-spring experience with no extra water or chemical additives whatsoever. Even the bath in your room runs with delicate spring water. The public pools at Spend Time are made from various materials in a number of shapes and sizes, some of them with controllable water temperature, and provide travelers with a uniquely refreshing hot spring experience.Building a dreamlike garden paradiseSpend Time guesthouse is the realization of a common ideal held by two mutually supportive friends. Mr. Lin loves creative work and is captivated by art. Ms. Cai adores working in the kitchen and is also fond of gardening. After a bout of serious illness several years ago, Mr. Lin accelerated his plans to retire and open a guesthouse, inviting Ms. Cai to help him realize his dream. One of the partners took charge of designing the space, and the other took responsibility for the gardens and the creative cuisine. In this way, the seemingly parallel lives of an artist and a housewife came to intersect in the planning and implementation of a beautiful dream.Why not find a day to come “Spend Time” here? Come enjoy this dreamlike garden paradise, relax in the pure, fresh hot spring, savor the gentle surroundings, and delight in the simple pleasures of nature.

Hotels.Description: At 243 km of Taichung Highway No. 2 (National Freeway No. 3), exit at Jhushan (Zhushan) interchange and turn right towards the direction of Xitou, Lugu (Nantou Highway 151), pass "Chuxiang Bridge," along the mountain road, pass Lugu Towansjip--the home of tea. Along the way you will find there are over one hundred tea houses, and you may pick a tea house to enjoy tea or chat with people there about tea. (At 13 km) there lies a Neihu Elementary School, it has wooden school buildings, which are very rare and worth a visit. Arriving here, it is easy to feel the natural coolness, which is the result of the vast forests. Proceed to (18 km), pass "Moso Bamboo Highway," then you have arrived Xitou. The beauty of Xitou is in the mist, which is cool and pleasant. At the entrance of Xitou Nature Education Park, there is an "Moso Avenue", beside the avenue a "poetry corridor." A "Gigantic Bamboo" of 6 floors high is the world's tallest Dendrocalamus giganteus Munro. Next, go to "Ginkgo Tea Garden,", in the garden you find "Ginkgo Hotel." Xitou is also a special zone for Moso bamboos, Ginkgo Hotel in Chinese is named "Meng Zong", the name after one of 24 filial sons in Chinese history. The Hotel used to be a three-story building, each story is designed for having 24 rooms; therefore a total of 72 rooms. The number of 72 rooms sounds matching the stories of"24 sons of Filial Piety and 72 Virtuous," to shine on the historic events. The business philosophy of Ginkgo Hotel focuses on implementing of "elegant, cordial, and attentive" qualities for creating the most friendly ambience. Ginkgo Hotel is endeavored to keeping 3-star rating quality honor. Xitou is about 1000-1650 meters in elevation and enjoys spectacular views of multitudinous morning sunshine and multifarious evening overcasts. From the sky roof of Ginkgo Hotel, you can overlook Xitou's panoramic view. Guest rooms are decorated with specially produced Moso bamboos providing charcoal air purification, and other charcoal supplies, which obtain a high satisfaction rating. For 40 years, Ginkgo Hotel has served over one million visitors, scholars Yafang specially selected Mr. Zhang Daxiu's poems of Xitou, hired calligraphers Mr. Chen Lianzhong to write the poems on ancient cypress boards for exhibitions, sharing the masterpieces of cultural and creative productions with staying tourists. After the 921 earthquake reconstruction, each floor is designed to have 18 rooms, and the building has 4 stories; therefore, it has a total of 72 rooms. We prepare foods with local flavors and support the concepts of maintaining good health, diligently keeping our star-rated quality, and launching new services. Ginkgo coffee, fun of making tea, listening Xitou story. "Bamboo grilled rice" and "rice with dried bamboo shoots fast food" are innovative. Xitou is a suitable place for enjoying your vacation, fitness activities, nourishing the mind and body, temporary stay, and relaxing life. Colleagues of Ginkgo Hotel would be happy to provide you depth interpretation services, accompany you strolling in the mysterious forests of Xitou, elegantly experiencing the beauty of Xitou and the quality of Ginkgo Hotel services.

Hotels.Description: "1969-Elixir of Love" is tucked away in a small alley across from Yongfu Elementary School in Tainan's West Central District. This very alley was famously described by the late Tainan literary figure Yeh Shih-tao as "Snail Alley." His former residence still stands within this quiet lane.This townhouse, built over 50 years ago during the 58th year of the Republic era (1969), retains its original terrazzo flooring and a colorful pebble stone bathtub. We have revitalized the old house, giving each room its own character. We hope travelers visiting Tainan will find a room that speaks to them, and experience what Yeh once described as “a place where people can dream, work, fall in love, get married, and live a leisurely life.”Located in the heart of Tainan City, the townhouse is within walking distance of key attractions such as the Tainan Train Station, the Confucius Temple area, Chihkan Tower, Wu Garden, Hayashi Department Store, and the famous Du Hsiao Yueh Dan Zai Noodles. Public bus stops and T-Bike rental stations are also nearby, making it easy to explore further sites like Anping Old Street and Sunset Viewing Platform.Motorbikes can be parked at the alley entrance, and car parks are available nearby. We also offer discounted motorbike rentals from a designated shop near the train station.In his essay Memories Like Clouds, Yeh Shih-tao wrote: “I bought an old house to live in at the head of Snail Alley, drawn by its location—just behind the bustling Miyako Theater in West Gate Town. It’s like a peaceful valley tucked within the lively city.” We invite you to experience the calm and unhurried lifestyle that Yeh so beautifully captured, right here at 1969-Elixir of Love.Let me know if you’d like a more concise version for marketing material or booking platforms.

Hotels.Description: Kinmen｜Live GuesthouseEasy listening every day at Kinmen Live GuesthouseAfter a flight across a stretch of ocean, you follow your map into the alleys and laneways of Kinmen. In contrast to the other large settlements in Kinmen, Oucuo Village is a simple, tranquil place, allowing you the time and space for romantic wandering. Turning down that unassuming little road, the sea breeze carries the sound of a guitar to your ear. Lively and spontaneous, the melody carries you into the daily life at Live Guesthouse.Blank space for your imagination to unfoldLow walls constructed of irregularly sized bricks with old, darkly colored wooden doors open inwards to a courtyard decorated with a few large potted trees. The faded paint of the old wooden chairs create a pleasant vacation atmosphere. The main hall connected to the courtyard serves as a common living room for travelling guests. The simple furnishings add luster to the old building. An artistic painting and two acoustic guitars hung high on the walls speak about the daily lives of the hosts. The afternoon sun slants into the enclosed courtyard of this traditional Minnan house, while clothing hung high in the breeze to dry sways as if to the rhythm of the Live Guesthouse beat. “Why not come this way, your room is over here.” The male half of your couple of hosts, Xu-Ran, is from Beijing. With his special accent and style of speaking, he leads you inside with a smile. Live Guesthouse has one double room, and two loft-style four-person rooms. The small room is perfect for visiting with a friend or to enjoy the the freedom of travelling alone. The interior paint appears new and original - a large swath of white wall intersected by a stripe of aquamarine creates just the right contrast with the other red brick floor, creating an atmosphere of harmony and vitality. In your room, there is a poem in simplified Chinese, and a different poem, expressing the emotions of Chinese poets, has been left in each room, corresponding with the customs and style of Kinmen. The charm implicit in the poem’s simplicity corresponds precisely to the impression that hosts Xu-Ran and Wang-Ling leave you with.A guitar’s melody like a slow, dreamy eveningLive Guesthouse invites you to arrive without a plan. Wang-Ling and her older sister established “Local Methodology”, providing an ideal opportunity for exploration. Even a short conversation with Wang-Ling opens the cultural landscape of Kinmen up before you. Even though she has married, she chooses to remain in Kinmen to follow her dreams. Fortunately, her husband Xu-Ran also prefers the pace of Kinmen to the big city of Beijing. As such, he was willing to pack a bag, grab his guitar and follow his wife back to Kinmen to put down roots. Some afternoon, you may also get the chance to explore Xu-Ran’s secret music collection with him. He is himself a guitarist who performs in the band Momo Sky, and has insisted that each room be equipped with a CD player so that he can share his collection with travelers. Perusing the lyrics in the CD booklet, you feel a warmth lacking in today’s online music world. It matches beautifully with the slow rhythm of life in Kinmen.Other than compact disk music, if you are lucky, you may get to see a live performance, acoustic guitar music lingering in the courtyard. Xu-Ran’s focused and easy music merges into the old courtyard home. You might take a book and sit quietly on the sofa, or grab another guitar and play in harmony. In this sunset composition, you smile as you strum one final chord and the sound echoes leisurely into the night and into your dreams. Stroll along the beach and explore Kinmen daily cultureEarly in the morning, before the town has really woken up, the music from the night before still echoes in your ears. Your step is particularly light after a sound night’s sleep, you carry the light snacks prepared by Live Guesthouse down towards the beach. Less than ten minutes from the guesthouse, you can see Oucuo Beach, where people, searching the island for traces of war, come to marvel at the scenery a tank stranded in the sand. You slip out of your shoes and step onto the fine, white sand, the slow sound of the Kinmen wind resembling the resonance of plucked guitar strings. The calm surface of the ocean is just like a poem - perhaps, if you slow down and simplify your life, you can truly appreciate the moment in which you live!

Hotels.Description: A story: a young child, playing under the apple tree, said goodbye to parents in the brisk and set off to find the legendary treasure of happiness.  Years later, the child, after travelling around in the world and becoming white-haired, returned home only to find that the treasure was under the apple tree where he said goodbye to their parents before."  Standing on the grass in front of the house, the air is extremely clean, the owner Wenxuan said: "To the right is my son& #39;s school, 12 people a class, to the left is my prayer chapel, in front of me, the organic rice field I am working on, followed by a .... There is ..., on the hillside." Under the warm winter sun and the dark skin, the abundant joy of life is hardly concealed.  "Whenever he closed his eyes to rest, prayed silently, his eyes seemed to be lift up to the high altitude overlooking the bustling city, where people lived like ants blindly making money, spending money, and working again," and then Wenxuan decided to return to his hometown.  "Looking at the designs being refused one by one, my heart felt cold, I cried out loud uneasy, because, I didn& #39;t see the future, how distant is it." Hostess Su Qing described the impact of life-turning process.  "I have no way to get rid of the genetic bones of creative desires." Wenxuan, an Information Engineer, and his father is an average-people turned sculptor, but he found his creative outlet on his wife& #39;s interior design field. In order to have a place for creating sculptures, he started to arrange a studio; however, the arrangement lasted for two years, because of his haunting perfect aesthetic perception.  Children grew up, the house was finally completed at the beginning of the year, and then looking back, the journey has already lasted for six years. Originally, it was a decision made without hesitation to put down everything in the city, though I lost something, all is worth it, because what I have now are impossible, even devoting whole life, to get from a city, rustic life, paddy waves, rice fragrance, noise of children& #39;s frolic, and the hometown mien, which I believe are luxurious hopes.  I often also think that it was lucky for people of our generation have a chance to return, look at the children, and think of myself, what I am worried about is that how to pave a smooth home returning way for the kids and let them know that there is a way back home they should remember, and the parents at the home will always light up a lamp waiting for them.

Hotels.Description: Slow down the pace. Listen to the sound of your heart. Enjoy the nature and the country life. Pearl Homestay is in Shanhou Folk Culture Village, Kinmen. Shanhou Folk Culture Village consists of 18 Minnan style old houses built during the Qing Dynasty. The construction lasted for 25 years to build the finest houses. To this day, the old houses remain the same as they were first built. The traditionally living space is well presented. Shanhou Folk Culture Village sits on the back of Shishan, facing Dongge Bay. Every morning when the sun rises up from the horizon, the sun shines into the halls. What's more Shanhou village used to be a restricted military base. Thus the environment of Wuhu Mountain is well preserved. There is a trail up just outside the village. There are also wetlands nearby where you can see native plants and insects. The abandoned military base, the intertidal zone are within walking distance. Traveling by bike is also a good way to go around. There are mountains and the sea around the homestay. You don't have to travel far to see and feel the nature. Slow down the pace and feel the tranquility. Enjoy the view of the moon and the stars. All the hustle and bustle of the city are miles away. Enjoy the nature, the fresh air and the lovely plants. When you stay at Pearl Homestay, look up to the sky and you will see clouds, birds, and butterflies. And there are organic vegetables that I grown myself for breakfast. Kinmen souvenirs available for free.

Hotels.Description: Located in the northern foothills of Mt. Dagang and with natural cold springs, Spring Hill Resort is an oasis from the rat race for the body, mind, and soul. Sitting on over 23,000 square meters of land, it is focused three themes: health, art, and culture. We pride ourselves on our promotion of cold-springs tourism, along with flower-filled walking trails, karaoke, a study, a children’s room, nude bathing pools,and springs cabins, . The hotel is focused on promoting a slower pace of life, and the pools, whether private ones in the rooms or large public ones, offer natural, nourishing springs bathing. In terms of dining, our Chinese-style meals use seasonal ingredients sourced from the surrounding Tainan, Alian, and Tianliao areas, prepared by our creative chefs. We also offer elegant Chinese-style set meals and Western food including handmade Italian food, along with high-quality teas, coffees, and fruit juices to help you while away a relaxing afternoon. The main dining hall can accommodate 110 people and our conference room is of the highest quality, providing all the necessities, along with snacks that can be tailored to your conference’s needs. Our 30 high-class guest rooms average around 50 square meters, and include private baths and dry/wet segregated bathroom areas, offering a perfect mix of springs bathing and spectacular scenery. Additionally, we are near well-known tourist destinations like “Moon World,” the three-century-old Chaofeng Temple, Erliao (a great place to catch the sunrise), Chaoyuan Temple, and Qishan Old Street, providing a wonderful travel experience for guests of all ages.

Hotels.Description: Songhe B&B is located along the scenic and wide Taose Highway in Gongguan Township, Miaoli County. It& #39;s next to Ren& #39;an Community Center along Mountain Road, with Tianquan Temple nearby. Behind the B&B are lush green mountains, hiking trail and Exercise Park. A hike up the mountain offers a birds-eye-view of Gongguan Township and the beautiful night scene of the entire Gongguan Town. This area is surrounded by greenery and flowers, sounds of birds chirping, insects buzzing, butterflies fluttering about and fireflies flickering at night. The soothing sounds of water running in the farm field ditches and fish swimming in the pond remind visitors from the busy city of the carefree country lifestyle and childhood games, such as catching grasshoppers and fishing for loach.                      Nearby attractions in the southern part of Miaoli include Miaoli Hakka Mansion, Hakka Cultural Museum, Shengxing Station, Tenglong Bridge Ruins, Taiwan Oil Field Exhibition Hall, Miaoli Pottery Museum, Da Hu Wineland Resort, Wenshui Old Street, Qing& #39;an Tofu Street, Tai& #39;an Hot Spring Area, Wugu Cutural Village, Westlake Village Resortopia, Sanyi Wood Sculpture Museum and Sanyi Wood Sculpture Street. Scenic attractions in the northern part of Miaoli are Shitan Xiancao Street, Mt. Xianshan, Nanzhuang Old Street and Mt. Shitou. Seeing is believing. All of us at Songhe B&B welcome you to Miaoli to enjoy the beautiful scenery.

Hotels.Description: Room reservation number: 0952165761 /05-2511378    Website: www.mimiyo.com.tw    Email: mimiyo7@gmail.com    Mimiyo is located at an elevation of 1400 meters in the Tsou Tribe Dabang Community, Alishan (Chiayi County), surrounded by mountains and greenery as far as the eye can see, away from the noise and dirt of the city, letting guests put their worries and cares behind them. In the Tsou language, “Mimiyo” means “running off,” and it was chosen by Afayi Nuozhaqiyana, the owner, in hopes that guests can take a casual, spontaneous vacation without having to worrying about anything. Rooms include wood or bamboo clothing hooks, dressing tables, tables, benches, desk lamps, and tissue boxes, all handmade by the owner. Balconies and bathrooms come with huge French windows featuring mountain views that change throughout the day. Sit at the wooden handmade table on the partially outdoor balcony and have a cup of tea while looking at the mountains and clouds, reading, or anything else. For those who would like to learn more about the Tsou Dabang Community culture and ecology, the owner, who is licensed, can arrange 2-day 1-night in-depth tours.

Hotels.Description: To watch watch the Alishan sunrise, you do not have to go up to Zhu mountain in the darkness anymore! Even more amazing is that the first ray of sunshine at Alishan is embracing you! That's called "Watching Sunrise at MEI YUAN LOU LANDSCAPE HOTEL." MEI YUAN LOU LANDSCAPE HOTEL sits beside the "Dragon Head" road at Highway No. 18 (57.5K) and at an elevation of  1,280 m. It takes 20 minutes to drive to Rose Lake from here; it takes 40 minutes from here to drive to Alishan. It is at the doorstep to Yushan National Park, Alishan National Scenic Area, Mt. Tatung Trail, Ruitai Trail, and Dulishan Trail. This is just like visiting the Lotus Flower Peak. It is called "the Verdant mountains surround Dragon Head, sunrays and cloud kiss MEI YUAN LOU." MEI YUAN LOU LANDSCAPE HOTEL is a multifunctional leisure and recreational park designed by Japanese design master Sasakibe with consideration for the local terrain, the microclimate and the seasons, the alpine forest, and the rich natural ecosystem. The design theme is : "Watch the sun rise from the east and clouds from the west, and kick the morning dew as you explore the surroundigns. Gaze out over the Jianan Plain as hearths and lights are lit. until they are joined by countless stars in the sky at night." Mountain horticultural crops are used for your organic and healthy meals;  Ju-Lu Tea leaves a delectable aftertaste for joy and memories during your journey. MEI YUAN LOU LANDSCAPE HOTEL "Cares for every guest."

Hotels.Description: Many people are asking if Mirage is not the translation of Mei Haiqi...Ah, how did this come about?It was really a headache to design the name of this B&B...You can search any name you want on Google, otherwise they are all very common names, such as: Aegean Sea... My mom chose it... HahaBecause my brother loves drinking coffee, one time when he met the owner of a store in the city, my brother asked the owner about the origin of his name. The owner talked a lot and made me realize that a name must have a story!By chance, a friend told my brother that it could be called a mirage…My brother thought it seemed pretty good, but it was too common and the name was hard to pronounce. I didn’t expect Wikipedia to have an explanation.[The English word comes from the Latin word mirare, which then comes from the French word mirage, meaning "a strange sight seen," that is, a mirage. 】Our homestay, Meihaiqi, is a transliteration of French into Chinese.Everyone has a dream in their heart. My brother and I dream of having our own house.I built the entire house from scratch by myself.Of course, it is difficult for me and my brother to design a house with our talents.So as a second choice, I personally handled the interior design and furniture decoration;Now that we have our own dreams, why not let more people know about our dreams?So my brother and I's dream will be known to the world from now on!!【Notes】All accommodations include free round-trip pick-up (ferry) service from Penghu Airport (Magong Pier). Please inform the flight or ferry schedule 30 days before check-in.Free breakfast is provided according to the room type (there is a catalogue). Double rooms provide 2 breakfasts, quad rooms provide 4 breakfasts, and so on. The quota per person is 50 yuan, and you can purchase additional breakfasts at your own expense.Breakfast is served from 7am. To protect the rights of tenants, pets are not allowed.To maintain community peace, please refrain from making loud noises inside or outside the homestay after 10pm and before 7am.Smoking, drinking and other illegal activities are strictly prohibited in this property.Please take good care of all facilities inside and outside this homestay.Valuables should be kept properly by yourself. Please be sure to carry them with you when you go out. This homestay is not responsible for their safekeeping.To save energy and reduce carbon emissions, please be sure to turn off the power and electrical appliances in the room when you go out. Thank you for your cooperation.This B&B has surveillance cameras installed in the lobby and at the door. If you have any concerns, please do not book a room.Guests who book a room in this B&B must live with the B&B manager. The B&B manager stays in the B&B to prevent guests from having urgent needs and needing to hire someone to handle the problem. If guests need to book a room in the whole building or book individual rooms, we cannot accept this. Please do not book a room. Thank you.【Delay and Refund Instructions】If you wish to change the date for any reason after remittance, please notify us 7 days in advance and the room can be reserved for three months. Otherwise, the deposit will be forfeited without further notice.Instructions for cancelling a reservation (the following refunds are subject to a handling fee of 100 yuan):If you notify us of your cancellation 14 days before your stay (including the day of your stay), your deposit will be fully refunded or retained for 6 months.If you notify us of cancellation 10 to 13 days before the check-in date (including the check-in date), 70% of the deposit will be refunded (with a handling fee of NT$100) or the deposit will be retained for 6 months.If you notify us of cancellation 7 to 9 days before the check-in date (including the check-in date), 50% of the deposit will be refunded or the deposit will be retained for 6 months.If you cancel your reservation 4 to 6 days before the check-in date (including the check-in date), 30% of the deposit will be refunded or the deposit will be retained for 6 months.If you do not notify us of cancellation 3 days before your stay (including the day of your stay), we will not accept any changes or cancellations.If there is force majeure (such as typhoon, earthquake, etc.) on the day of check-in, resulting in the cancellation of flight or boat flights (subject to the announcement of the local county or city government), you can choose to: refund the deposit in full or keep the deposit for 6 months.If the county is in a red tourism alert area on the day of check-in, the B&B will refund the deposit in full.If you need to book a room or want to inquire about any further questions, please contact Mirage B&B at [0910-884-720 (Xiao Yuanzhe)].Transportation Information:【Satellite positioning】Satellite coordinates of the B&B: Longitude (E) 23.577413 Latitude (N) 119.583507

Hotels.Description: A Hakka old house located in Ruisui Golden Hot Springs, and at the foot of Hutou Mountain. It has window frames in bagua shape and fine windows of cast iron, rustic wooden doors, outlining the house& #39;s history. Mr. Huang loves to enjoy nature and collect antiques, after retirement, fate acquired this beautiful Hakka old house under the hillside by chance, with the mood of entertaining friends, named the house "Sun•shine Hot Spring" and hangs a wooden sign to start a new life of operating a B&B business.        Now the Sun•shine Hot Spring is under the operations of the second generation, Terry and Alma born in the 80s, who love travel. Although they are seemingly younger, they have rich and pragmatic ideas, continuing the spirit of antique-loving of the previous generation, but added a creative idea of accommodating the new generation backpackers to turn the Hakka old house a new page. Mr. Huang Tairan wanted to let the Sun•shine Hot Spring can provide more comfortable services and gradually step into the market for foreign backpackers. Together with his wife, they study the aesthetics of interior design, with unique ideas and a limited budget, they blended Huang& #39;s collection of antique furniture with the building to revitalize the old house and created a minimalist style that brighten the eyes of admirers.

Hotels.Description: "Penghu – Baisha - Chenhai"    Chenhai Village, Baisha Township is located in the suburb of Magong. It is a small village with an  abundant marine ecosystem and is far away from the city. Its tranquility and simplicity comfort many urban residents. Currently many Fukienese traditional houses still remain in the village, inhabited by simple villagers. The streets in the community are designed in a concise and neat manner and the ambient areas are also conserving fresh and nature touch pertaining to this smaller village. When you open the door and set the foot in “ChenHai Bay”, you will be instantly impressed by the unique design. Intimate conversation with the visitors and clean-cut comfort rooms, it gives a home-like secureness and coziness. You can easily get near to the sea on the Tsen Hai Beach not far away from the B&B. During high tide, the beach here is also an absolutely safe water activity ground. You can also participate in the SUP paddling races held by the B&B, competing with foreign friends hailing from every corner of the world. When the tide recedes, you may gather prawns, crab and shells in the vast exposed inter-tidal zone while looking over the Penghu Maritime Museum and northern islands around Yuan Bei Island. During the night, the beach is also teeming with life as prawns and crab emerge from the sand. You may take part in the “Bao Tung” fishing activity and experience the marine life in close distance under the twinkling stars. It is really a perfect location for the family to spend some leisurely days.

Hotels.Description: TSC Hualien Hotel is located in Guangfu Township, Hualien County, was a sugar refinery of a private 【Ensuiko Sugar Refining Co., Ltd.】 in the Japanese colonial period. The buildings were constructed according to the "Building Standards of Official Residences" of Governor-General of Taiwan, and the current Japanese-style wooden dormitories were constructed in 1936 for staff quarters purpose. It remains 27 buildings, consisting of 73 rooms, and other quarters for single employees (now renovated as a Creative Studio), dorms for officials on business trip, clinic, offices, etc., a total of five wooden structure buildings. After renovation, the Japanese-style dormitories have been transformed into a hotel with historic characteristic style. The housing is divided into Japanese log cabins (room for two) and parent-child log cabins (room for four) and family log cabins(room for four)etc. Each room is a wooden structure building with the most primitive style. It features comfortable environment, soft colors and lighting, introverted calm design style, makes you still feel the beauty of Japanese culture, while escaping from the urban jungle to cast off tensions. We at TSC Hualien Hotel cordially invite you to stay and experience the elegance of Japanese-style log cabins.

Hotels.Description: The building compound is located outside Dashe, Zhushan, and is a traditional-style structure with an impressive layout. The outside is covered with six-sided bricks, an example of rare Kinmen craftsmanship. As our B&B is one of the few to be housed in an officially designated historical building, a trip to come appreciate its beauty is well worth it.Follow the little road by the Zhushan shooting range and it leads to the traditional-style Taiwanese building compound in what seems like another-worldly paradise. Inside is an ornate gate created by expert craftsman, a spacious central courtyard, rosewood, and old-fashioned wood chairs. The bedrooms contain valuable antique carved beds, dressing tables and modern ceramic bathroom facilities, plasma TVs thoughtfully incorporated into wall decoration, classic romantic bed curtains, bedding, and wireless Internet. The experience is a beautiful, uplifting blend of the antique and modern.Flowers grow in a large traditional water jar, increasing the natural beauty and representing the spirit of Kinmen. Inside the building are antiques used in early times, such as stone beads, stone mills, and chicken bowls. There is a moving tale behind each of these items, and we welcome you to witness for yourself the evidence of our ancestors’ wisdom and efforts, hoping this becomes a place to relax your body and soul. Welcome to Zhushan No. 41 Bed & Breakfast, where you can take a break to appreciate the beauty of this old building. We hope each visitor is a precious contribution to the development of Kinmen.

Hotels.Description: SSSlife Hotel is a Tainan hotel for petty-bourgeois girls. It is located in the city center. It is within walking distance of Tainan Railway Station, Guohua Street Snacks, Tainan Art Museum, Lin Department Store and other popular attractions. Wander in the alleys and feel Tainan’s slow work and the tastes of old Tainanese. You can eat ten kinds of special snacks if you save on renting a motorcycle or taxi.Standard hotels are too expensive, and the equipment, services and cleaning quality of the homestays are different. Youth hotels are the cheapest but they often can’t really relax and rest-a rare holiday trip. I want the kindness and comfort of the homestay, but I also want the cleanliness of the hotel. And convenient equipment, and don’t forget to plan carefully-SSSlife Hotel  is born for your needs. Without the restraint of a hotel, you can feel the human touch of a hotel; the hotel is clean and safe, but we are not less.Even the single rooms are equipped with bathtubs that are rarely found in rental houses, and each room type provides bath salts and Dyson hair dryers. You can soak in the bath as much as you want. The tri-fold high-density mattress makes it easy for people to sleep well to light sleep. In the alleys of the hotel, there are Wenqing coffee shops and Japanese grocery stores. Almost all Tainan snacks are also within walking distance. Relax and simply spend an afternoon.SSSlife Hotel  is also an old house in Tainan’s Centennial Alley. It was renovated by the design team. The new design meets the old elements. The whole building is made of white and wood as the main color. The compact Japanese and Western styles seem to take you into Tainan. history.Completely relax from the busy life, and deeply feel the charm of Tainan's alleys. Let the hotel no longer be just a place to sleep for a night, returning to the hotel will also become a good memory. SSSlife Hotel  is looking forward to sharing a beautiful human touch with you.

Hotels.Description: A new generation of bed & breakfast, Shanming Shuishe is a veritable paradise nestled amongst verdant mountains. The owners, Mama and Papa Wang, are nature lovers, and strove to create their own beautiful home amongst nature. Now they invite you to come and enjoy the beauty of birdsong and the fragrance of flowers in their quite country homestead, far from the madding crowd. Shanming Shuishe is located in Shuangxi District, New Taipei City, only a short six minutes’ drive from Pingxi/Shifen Train Station and close to Jiufen, Fulong, and Gongliao. As the city nearby continues to grow and change, Shuangxi retains a sense of simplicity and nature, giving visitors a sense of traveling back through time to the 1950s and to a more sedate, relaxing way of life. A licensed bed & breakfast, Shanming Shuishe boasts a combination of natural beauty and attentive hosts, making it an elegant, comfortable home away from home for any guest. Equipped with cable television, karaoke, and other entertainment facilities, it’s a perfect place for couples, families, small groups of friends, or company retreats. If you have any questions about your visit or your travel itinerary, please contact Shanming Shuishe at (02)2493-3969, (0915)731-371, (0955)064-131, or through their website at http://www.smss.tw

Hotels.Description: In the announcement, I've told everyone that the B&B is simple and unadorned. There is no high class furniture and decoration, no luxurious facilities and no professional services. You may have questions. What does the selling point of my B&B? I will tell you the answer. I sell the scenery of Penghu to you. I had not been to Shili in a long while.  Every time when I thought of it, I would burst into tears. When I was a kid, the road of Shili was next to the beach, and the sea and the sky were of one hue. The fishing sampans were hauled on the beach, and I stood on the beach, feeling that it was a merging space, like what it said in the Disney cartoon Atlantis: The Lost Empire, "It is part of it, while it is also a part of it." But now, the huge sea walls and overweight tetrapods have occupied the coast, crushed the memory of childhood and broken off the dialogue with nature. The coast is disappearing. Now, I look at the tide water rising and ebbing and the shadow changing on the sea surface from the glass window in the house, and I haven't done this for a long time. The people who visit here always praise that I am clear-eyed. What chance would it be for me to find such a nice place? When it comes to this question, I feel distressed about it. Sadly, I have to tell you that there were other places and coasts more beautiful than here in Penghu. But what have we done to the beautiful islands? People keep constructing buildings and ignore the destruction of ecological environment. If you feel touched when staying here, please love the land you live on. So I often sell my B&B with the sad irony of, "the more destruction in Penghu, the higher the value of my place." Chengqian, a small village. Thanks to being small and without large budgets, few destructing construction appears in Chengqian, which forms part of the natural coastline and the rich ecology of an intertidal zone. You can see prosperous Magong City on the other side, the tortuous islands of Xiyu Township and the precious location of the inner sea, Dacang village. The blue sea and sky of the day and the glittering stars of the night present the original sea viewing of Penghu. We hope you will like it.

Hotels.Description: Songhe B&B is located along the scenic and wide Taose Highway in Gongguan Township, Miaoli County. It& #39;s next to Ren& #39;an Community Center along Mountain Road with Tianquan Temple nearby. Behind the B&B are lush green mountains, hiking trail and Exercise Park. A hike up the mountain offers a birds-eye-view of Gongguan Township and the beautiful night scene of the entire Gongguan Town. This area is surrounded by greenery and flowers, sounds of birds chirping, insects buzzing, butterflies fluttering about and fireflies flickering at night. The soothing sounds of water running in the farm field ditches and fish swimming in the pond remind visitors from the busy city of the carefree country lifestyle and childhood games, such as catching grasshoppers and fishing for loachThe town& #39;s  most beautiful bikeway and hiking trail is along the mountain. The B&B has bikes available for guests to use. It& #39;s very convenient to get to nearby neighborhoods, such as downtown Gongguan, Hakka Mansion and Oil Mine. Take a walk to the Hakka Village and see a variety of seasonal fresh vegetables growing in the farm fields - taros, strawberries and red dates. When flowers bloom, the colorful blossoms attract many butterflies to the area.The beautifully landscaped B&B courtyard evokes the local Hakka flavor and is equipped with barbeque facilities and kitchen utensils. The B&B can order BBQ food items for guests, and guests can also go to the supermarket or vegetable market to select the freshest vegetables and fruits. Our price is average, but our service is thoughtful and extensive, and our equipment and accessories in the guestrooms are very high quality. You will be guaranteed to have a fulfilled country style vacation. The living room has complimentary coffee and tea for guests to enjoy. This is a great place for a few friends to gather and catch up on each other& #39;s lives and forget all their troubles.

Hotels.Description: Farglory Hotel Hualien towers north coastal mountains at an altitude of 220 meters, with back to the mountains and facing the sea, and vast horizons. Standing in Farglory, to the east, overlooking the deep blue Pacific Ocean, to the north, the bustling city of Hualien, to the west, the magnificent Central Mountain Range and East Rift Valley, and to the south, scenic Eastern Coastline and Marine Theme Park. The mountains and the sea are intertwined, a beautiful heaven. The Hotel used Victoria Palace building as the imagery theme of design. Welcome hall is designed to have a ceiling of 28 meters high, making everyone feels the comfortable and spacious space when stepping into the Hotel. Guest rooms use auto climate control for seasons. Interior decorations are all upscale materials. Each guest room has a viewing balcony to allow each guest to enjoy contemporary Victorian prosperity and senses to the fullest to achieve the perfect leisurely vacation mood. The Hotel features five top-level restaurants and bars, including the Oriental Garden Restaurant, a Chinese restaurant that fully use local ingredients of Hualien, exotic British Garden Restaurant, Aki Kusa Japanese Restaurant has deep Zen inspiration, the Piazza KTV Bar is the beauty in the nights, and the Cliff Lobby Lounge where you can enjoy carefree. The Hotel is surrounded by the tree-lined trails and viewing platforms, connecting all outdoor attractions and indoor facilities, such as the statue of the poet garden landscaping, Garden Walkway, Fire Dance Plaza, each is an ingenuity crafting. The hotel won international awards in 2010 World Luxury Hotel Award, which is Taiwan's only one The Coastal Hotel, and in 2011 obtained a 5-Star Mark from Tourism Bureau, MOTC, the first International Tourist Hotel honored in Hualien.

The Fuyam's owner makes good use of natural landscaping to create a slick place for relaxing, and waits for the blessed or destined people to come to share this paradise on earth together.   Fuyam Tourist Home is located in northern Taiwan's most aerobic Lalashan Forest Reserve, near Qara Stream valley around 800 meters in elevation, giant stones stand in great number, trees, flowers, and grasses are dispersed, and all charms vary with the seasons, a beautiful retreat like a paradise. By the owner's skillful planning, design, and layout, Fuyam offers several log cabins with different sizes, gardens, and landscaping space, set off by trees, bamboos, flowers, ponds, and streams, making you feel more quiet and beautiful.   Natural terrains and materials are used in space landscaping, creating a unique atmosphere and layering. In recent years, in addition to local visitors, more and more foreign tourists have come here especially attracted by Fuyam's fame, some visitors even went straight to Lalashan upon arrival in Taiwan for a weeklong stay, in order to enjoy the natural environment bit by bit. Even just sitting In the outdoor patio, drinking tea, reading books, it is a great enjoyment. Hotels.Description: We are the legal house inn No.63 in Taichung city. Moon Lake House Inn,, Introduction Xinshe is the largest fluvial terraces in Taiwan. Ten thousand years ago, the activities of human beings had already existed here, and a century ago Bai-Len Canal was constructed here, a considerable feat of irrigation works at the time. The climate is cool and comfortable, and the best breeds of mushrooms, loquat, grapes, and Oncidium grow here; pleasant scenery, convenient transportation, floral festivals year after year, and attractions everywhere, here is the Yangmingshan in Taichung. Mon Lake House Inn, B&B, is located on the side of Moon Lake Fluvial Terrace, facing Dongshih on the opposite side of Dajia River, having vast horizons, extending peaks of Mt. Hengling, Mt. Yuanzui, Mt. Shaolai, Mt. Xiaoxue are presenting in front of you. In the night, bugs chirp and frogs chant, and Taiwan No. 8 Line looks like Galaxy with lights on. It is hard to imagine that here is just one km from Xinshe downtown, and we have the convenience of a city and the tranquility of rural life. Your host and hostess are born gardeners, crazy lovers of flowers, both personally planted the flowers and trees, which all are nearly 30 years old; the original appearance of the house has been kept for more than forty years. Decorations come from family and friends, including Papa's wind drum of more than 60 years old, Mom's dowry table and ancient shoulder pole for selling vegetables, younger sister's trophies of exploring the world, my son's paintings, and my daughter's drawing cards, etc., A little bit here and a little bit there are all our intentions to make you feel the warmth. The old house is the most mini here. We have only three rooms that can accommodate up to 8 people. Wireless Internet services. If you are interested in plants, you are welcomed to visit our secret garden. We advocate the concept of "Leave No Trace" and environmental protection activities of health and low-carbon; therefore, we hope the visitors bring their own personal toiletries,ex: towels, toothbrushes, and razors,etc. We welcome your family or friends together to appreciate the natural and cultural beauties of Xinshe, and enjoy the quiet simple happiness of our little home.

Hotels.Description: PAPO’A LABS: A Breathing Poem of the CityWe were born on this land, raised in this city.Our founder studied and started his first venture in Tainan—drawing inspiration from humble alleyways and learning humility from weathered city walls. With gratitude and courage, we have returned to the place where the dream began. Through the form of hospitality, we say to Tainan: “We are home.”More Than a Hotel—A Way of Living in TainanPAPO’A LABS may look like just a hotel, but its soul is closer to a “breathing anthology of poetry.”Through design, we converse with old buildings; through service, we pass along the warmth of human connection; through stories, we weave the memory of the city into your journey.Here, you are not a passerby, but a temporary neighbor of this ancient city. Perhaps around a corner, you’ll encounter the familiar fragrance beneath the arcades; perhaps at the breakfast table, you’ll be served not only food, but also the proud rhythm of life that belongs to old Tainan.Rooted in Tainan, With a Heart Set on the WorldWe believe that passion makes places visible, and stories memorable.PAPO’A LABS chose to take root in Tainan not for romance, but because we know—when the soul of a city is preserved with care, it can walk confidently onto the global stage.That is why what we want travelers to feel is not just “a stay,” but an experience of resonating with the heartbeat of Tainan.A Touch of Humor—Because Travel Should Be EasyDon’t worry—we are not an archaeological museum, nor a library.We will make your bed with great care, but we might also slip a little note by your bedside reminding you to “take one more look at tonight’s stars.” We can lead you through centuries of culture, but even more so, we hope you leave with a smile, saying: “I’ve never experienced Tainan quite like this.”PAPO’A LABS: Rooted in Tainan, With a Heart Set on the World.We look forward to meeting you,and writing your next beautiful chapter,between tradition and innovation.

Don’t forget to bring your camera and leave behind beautiful memories. We hope you enjoy a wonderful atmosphere from the moment you enter Xin Yuan House. Every guest is instantly impressed the moment he or she enters the room – it’s a castle for princes and princesses, straight out of a fairy tale. In 2000, we were honored as the Most Beautiful Garden Bed and Breakfast by Yilan County. The garden is full of a variety of flowers, attracting a number of newlyweds to take wedding photographs here. We’ve also been the setting for several television shows as well as being interviewed by Japanese TV and thereby earning the reputation of having “more authentic style than England itself.” People often ask, “What’s the best part of being a bed and breakfast owner?” When friends wave goodbye and say, “When I have time, I’m definitely coming back!” Xin Yuan House is a rest stop embracing happiness, leaving guests with a feeling of warmth and happiness as they depart and knowing the wonder of this place will always be a part of their memories.
