Hotels.Description: Le Méridien Hotels, renowned worldwide for their deep connection to culture and art, trace their origins to the fashion capital—Paris. With a forward-thinking and trendsetting essence, Le Méridien not only provides guests with a flawless stay but also offers an inspiring journey of effortless exploration.Officially opened on December 3, 2010, Le Méridien Taipei is located in the heart of Taipei’s fashion and arts district—Xinyi. Rooted in the curatorial concept of contemporary art, the hotel embraces the theme of "light and shadow," seamlessly integrating art into every corner accessible to guests. This non-traditional approach fosters direct interaction between guests and artistic expression, transforming the hotel into a dynamic gallery space. The curated collection features nearly 700 works and installations by contemporary artists from Taiwan, China, Japan, Korea, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Belgium, spanning various mediums and forms. Through these visionary artworks, guests are invited to engage their senses and ignite their creative thinking.Designed with a modern and minimalist architectural aesthetic, the hotel meticulously crafts 160 guestrooms and suites, offering six distinct room types with lofty ceilings. Each room is thoughtfully furnished with the Sealy bed, a 60-inch flat-screen TV, an immersive surround sound system, high-speed internet, a multimedia hub, and an illy espresso machine, creating a seamless blend of comfort and functionality for both work and relaxation.The bathroom design exudes refined sophistication, featuring a rainforest shower, a bidet toilet, and premium large-sized amenities from the American brand MALIN+GOETZ, harmonizing sustainability with luxury. Additionally, most room types include an independent bathtub, set within a spacious and elegantly designed bathroom, offering an indulgent and immersive bathing experience—transforming each stay into an unforgettable journey of refined comfort.Le Méridien Taipei brings together a diverse array of dining experiences, crafted with meticulous attention to detail to offer the ultimate gastronomic indulgence. My Humble House Restaurant showcases the exquisite artistry of classic Cantonese cuisine, presenting refined and masterfully prepared gourmet delights. Latest Recipe curates global delicacies, offering freshly made-to-order creative dishes that captivate the palate with boundless surprises. Meanwhile, Latitude 25 Lobby Bar harmonizes the cultural essence of illy® coffee with an exclusive selection of fine wines coveted by connoisseurs worldwide, creating an unparalleled ambiance for relaxation and refinement.In 2024, the hotel unveiled two new in-house dining concepts. Drip & Dough offers a tranquil ambiance with warm wooden tones and a contemporary artistic flair, featuring hand-brewed coffee from Cupping Room, a Hong Kong-based champion roastery, paired with exquisite pastries and light bites—inviting travelers to immerse themselves in a leisurely, sensory journey. TIPSY Sparrow, a collaboration between a Michelin-starred chef and an award-winning mixologist, reinterprets classic cuisine through a modern lens, creating a social dining experience inspired by French and American flavors. The bar also introduces an exclusive selection of cocktails infused with the rich essence of Taiwanese tea, delivering a uniquely sophisticated and innovative tasting experience.

PostalAddress.StreetAddress: No.38, Songren Rd., Xinyi Dist., Taipei City 110, Taiwan (R.O.C.)

Images.Name: 純淨豪華客房
Images.Description:
409 Square Feet / 38 Square Metres
Located on the fifth through tenth floors, the Deluxe Rooms at Le Méridien Taipei take contemporary luxury to a new level. An understated neutral palette accented by warm dark wood and cool marble is found throughout. Clean lines define the modern furnishings, which include a marble desk, steel and leather desk chair, and two wood and nylon easy chairs in the sitting area.

Wall-to-ceiling windows run along one wall, inviting natural light during the day and a dramatic city vista at night. Original artwork by local artists is displayed on the walls in the sitting area and above the bed. The desk area caters to the experienced traveller with a virtual office media hub, IP phone and high-intensity desk lamp. Further amenities include a 60-inch flat screen TV and hi-fi stereo.

For our guest’s comfort, Le Méridien signature king or twin-sized bed guarantees a restful night’s sleep. The bathroom features marble and glass countertops, a large vanity and separate rainforest shower, an assortment of Le Méridien bath products, as well as a bathrobe and slippers.

Each room also offers an in-room safe, refreshment centre, illy coffee machine, as well as the daily delivery of a newspaper.

Images.Name: 艾美套房
Images.Description:
1,690 Square Feet / 157 Square Metres
Located in the corner on the 11th floor, Le Méridien Suite encompasses a sprawling sophisticated space. The walls of floor-to-ceiling windows frame multidimensional city views, with the impressive Taipei 101 building as their striking centre piece.

The elegant living and dining room are styled soothing earth tones, punctuated by the dramatic arc of an oversized floor lamp and the richly textured fabric of a custom-made sofa. Easy bucket chairs in rich leather round out the ample seating options. A state-of-the-art 60-inch flat screen TV is embedded into the wall, connected to the sleek Bang & Olufsen stereo.

The contemporary wooden dining table and chairs host 6 persons comfortably for an intimate meal or a meeting over coffee from the suite’s illy coffee machine. A separate marble powder room in the entry hall of the suite also caters to the comfort of additional guests.

A spacious marble desk complete with a virtual office media hub, HDMI, IP Phone and High Speed Internet Access, defines the work area. Another work table and chair allows the space to be adapted with the greatest flexibility. Guests also enjoy the use of engraved stationery, notepads and pens for any personal or professional correspondence.

The distinctive bedroom features a signature Le Méridien Suite king-size bed, with a discreetly backlit headboard and sleek control panels for the drapes and bedside lamps. The adjacent master bathroom exceeds expectations with its generous layout, twin marble vanities, gleaming glass countertops, separate rainforest shower and deep sunken tub and plentiful bath amenities.

Guests of Le Méridien Suite enjoy unlimited access to Le Méridien Club Lounge, and a complimentary selection of soft drinks from the suite's refreshment centre, attentive 24-hour valet service, daily delivery of a newspaper and a daily shoe shine.

Images.Name: 總統套房
Images.Description:
2,400 Square Feet / 223 Square Metres
Characterised by a sweeping floor plan, uninterrupted city views and abundant natural light, the Presidential Suite provides an oasis of refinement in the heart of a dynamic city. Soothing earth tones flow from living room to bedroom, punctuated by bold modern design evident in the dramatic arced floor lamps, wide-set sofas, curved leather easy chairs and long chrome and marble coffee table. Entertainment options include a 60-inch flat screen TV embedded into the wall, connected to a Bang & Olufsen stereo.

The elegant marble desk in the living room defines a spacious work area. The virtual office media hub, IP phone, High Speed Internet Access and HDMI keep guests seamlessly connected, while the engraved stationery, notepad and pen set encourages more personalised correspondence.

The dining area hosts elegant private gatherings of up to 10 persons—the modern wooden table and chairs a sleek reflection of the graphic original artwork on the walls.

The comforts abound at every turn. A spacious walk-in closet and dressing area is situated directly next to the sumptuous marble and glass bathroom. The generous rainforest shower is enclosed in glass, while a deep free-standing tub sits by the window offering a majestic view of Taipei 101. Twin vanities provide ample space to spread out, and a selection of bath amenities may be found throughout.

The serene bedroom features a signature king-size Le Méridien bed, its dramatic headboard discreetly backlit to showcase the wall of artwork above. Control panels over each bedside table manage the room’s lighting and electronic drapes with ease. A separate sitting area by the window invites guests to enjoy their newspaper and morning cup of coffee, prepared in the suite’s very own kitchen.

Guests of the Presidential Suite enjoy unlimited access to Le Méridien Club Lounge, private valet service, complimentary soft drinks from the suite’s refreshment centre, and daily shoe shine service.

Images.Name: 卓越套房
Images.Description:
807 Square Feet / 75 Square Metres
The ample one-bedroom Executive Suites make the most out of their sweeping layout—offering guests distinctive areas in which to work, rest and socialize.

A wall of floor-to-ceiling windows in both the living room and bedroom add to the airy spacious feeling. The soft neutral colours of the fabrics and furnishings underscore the clean open aesthetic, while accents of warm wood, rich leather, polished marble and gleaming metal infuse a contemporary note. Chic squared-off sofas are grouped in front of the state-of-the-art 60-inch flat screen TV, embedded into the wall. Further seating options include two modern leather bucket chairs.

The working area is defined by a marble desk that features a virtual office media hub, HDMI, an IP phone and High Speed Internet Access. An impressive array of high-tech devices keeps guests connected, including a  hi-fi stereo linked to the television, plus audio and video capabilities which may be connected to your personal computer. A deluxe stationery set is also provided. For further flexibility, an additional wooden table with chairs may be used for small meetings or as the place to enjoy a cup of coffee from the suite’s illy coffee machine while reading the daily newspaper.

The separate bedroom features a signature king-size Le Méridien Bed, with a softly backlit headboard. Control panels for the drapes and lights are within easy reach above each bedside table. A curated selection of contemporary works by local artists is showcased on the walls.

The master bathroom is a study in marble and glass—featuring two spacious vanities, a deep soaking tub and a separate rainforest shower. In addition to a bathrobe and slippers, guests also enjoy a selection of pampering bath products. A separate marble powder room is located at the entrance of the suite.

The Executive Suites may be connected to a Deluxe Twin or a Le Méridien Club Twin Room, for additional space and flexibility. Valet service at the touch of a button ensures that all of a guest’s needs are met promptly. Unlimited access to the private Le Méridien Club Lounge on the 12th floor is included, as well as a selection of complimentary soft drinks from the suite’s refreshment centre.

Hotels.Description: Kinmen｜Kinba GuesthouseLittle Pug leads the way through the creative revitalization of an old houseAs you descended from the airplane, the bright sunshine of Kinmen embraces you. Follow the winding alleys around old water wells and past ancient homesteads as you discover the daily happenings of this island. All of a sudden, an adorable and mischievous pug bumps into you, leading you to your final destination. As if breaking free from the heavy wartime history of the area, Kinba guesthouse is radiant with liveliness.Each brick, each tile endowed with skillful designKinba is an amalgamation of historical buildings number 85 and 80. Inside the compact structure of number 85, the cute household pooch, Little Pug, passionately rushes forward in greeting and guides you down the hallway laid with red tiles. At the patio, the old-style water well, ingeniously surrounded with cylindrical bamboo tubes, creates a quaint scene. Green bonsai plants line stone shelves in mimicry of a Japanese courtyard, granting a pleasant vitality to the heavy dignity of this historical home. You spend a leisurely afternoon sitting on the threshold with Little Pug, soaking up the sunshine, chatting, leafing through a book. This is the simple life.Drawing open the doors of the main hall, you find the place where the travelers who come to Kinba rest. The hostess, Maruko, has decorated the space in her favorite Japanese style, with simple wooden furnishings that bring warmth to the reserved atmosphere of the house. The spacious double room is ideal for a couple to spend some sweet time together. If you come with friends, the Japanese-style rooms in the wings adjacent the main structure are your best choice. Whether sitting and chatting freely on the living room tatami mats or lying down for a heart-to-heart chat on the soft-cushion couches, Kinba brings you an idyllic lifestyle.When light industry meets historical homeFollowing Little Pug’s playful down the path, you turn progress a corner to find historical home number 80. Emitting the fragrance of Chinese fir, this structure is still magnificent despite the long years it has endured. With his own skillful hands, Little Kang has harmoniously infused number 80 with the style of light industry. When you enter the main hall, the rich colors of the decor mingle with the terracotta of the brick, and the bright-yellow sofa and handsome chandelier display youthful vitality. The old leather case and sewing table personally refurbished by Little Kang revive the past in in this place, where old and new perfectly intersect.With the sun setting in the west, a cool and gentle breeze blows through the open courtyard, and a characteristic Kinmen night prepares to unfold. You gather with your friends as the crystal-clear Koaliang, signature of Kinmen, is poured generously into small glass cups. You mix a special Kinmen cocktail of Koaliang and beer, and it’s bottoms up! Allow the cool, carefree flavor to wash away your worries. Deep in the night, you reluctantly climb the ladder into the loft where what was once a storage space has been transformed into cozy sleeping quarters. You drift into a deep sleep, where the fine evening continues on in your dizzy dreams.A taste of local affectionMaruko, with her charming short hair and relaxed attire, was born on Kinmen. Little Kang, with his shoulder length hair, was born here as well. They both exude a rich islander quality. It’s hard to imagine that one of the simple people who now stand in front of you once worked in public relations for some fancy Japanese brand while the other was an engineer in the semiconductor industry! Weary of urban life, they decided to shatter all expectations and travel to Australia together for a holiday in search of better things. That journey not only inspired their love of slow, simple life, but also confirmed for Maruko that Little Kang would be her life partner. When their holiday ended and they returned to Kinmen, and they learned that the government was taking bids on some historical homes, Maruko and Little Kang unhesitatingly cancelled all plans to return to work in Taipei. They chose to stay in Kinmen, where the pace of life is more akin to Australia and to strive to create their ideal life together.“Seeing as everyone is so much alike, we just want to be different!” They painted every corner of Kinba and chose every item of furniture themselves in order to make things just right. They used their experience in the big city to liberate themselves from the burden of history, infuse their space with trendy modernity and bring youthful vitality to Kinmen.Walking into the main hall in the early morning, you discover that Maruko has already prepared breakfast. Crispy, deep-fried breadsticks dipped in delicate, tasty congee, together with mouthwatering sweet or savory sesame seed cakes, give you the energy to tackle the day. The rich history permeating Kinba guesthouse, infused with the youthful vigor of the hosts, revitalizes the impression of Kinmen, allowing the island’s rich nostalgia to live on.

Hotels.Description: With back to Yushan Mountain, across Chenyoulan River, opposite Xitou, located in Shang& #39;an Village, Shuili, Nantou, silently guarding the green mountains. Having been living in the city for a few years makes us realize the value of early experiencing the natural environment. Emotionally being deeply rooted in the land, we returned to favorite Shang& #39;an Village. On the river plains we built a folk house in Tang style. We introduced stream water into the pond and planted water willows and pine trees, and arranged it into a natural garden to regain natural tranquility of a mountain life.   If life is a learning process, then the lush plantings in the courtyard is our learning outcomes, to set aside a space for nature, and nature will return full hearty responses. The Bigcatkin willow trunk becomes wider and wider, Japanese strobus pine& #39;s stretch without restrain, the fireflies come uninvited, river fish are full of ponds, and common Moorhens settle down here. Take care a plot of organic vegetable fields, leftovers make compost, lotus blossom in the ecological wastewater treatment pond, natural cycle of life here has been practiced freely, and we enjoy it.   Rest in a soothing garden, taste the leisure of venting, listen to the birds chirping, branches and buds are flickering, when mountain mist floating by, or whether it is slow living or LOHAS, here words have been forgotten. Sharing this natural life process makes us feel more affluent. Welcome your visit, and together with our breath of life to share the mountain leisurely time.

Hotels.Description: Yilan｜TaioriPlentiful Harvest! The Gourmand’s Ideal Japanese FeastPassing through the Snow Mountain Tunnel and exiting the highway interchange, you turn down a small road into a rural atmosphere rich with the scent of rice paddies. To say that the enchanting county of Yilan is akin to Taipei’s backyard garden simply doesn’t do it justice. This place could more rightly be described as every traveler’s ideal paradise. In the same way, Taiori is every Japanese cuisine-loving gourmand’s Shangri-la.Experience the exquisite character of a Japanese-style homeAs with every other bed and breakfast in Yilan county, Taiori is tucked away beside farmers’ fields, and exudes a generous and friendly ambiance. Even though this is so, it’s difficult to miss the sight of it, with its light gray slate wall and wooden door. To one side of the door sit several bicycles and potted plants. Compared to the other cement buildings in the area, Taiori radiates a different kind of warmth.Opening the doors and stepping forward, you immediately smell the rich aroma of solid wood. Above a long wooden table, a Japanese-style water kettle hangs peacefully from a hook over a charcoal burner. A colorful Japanese-style flag bearing the name of the bed and breakfast hangs on the wall in the entrance. Symbolic in Japan of a plentiful fishing harvest, the colorful red fish leaping into the sunshine between Mount Fuji and a magnificent sea wave seem to represent the feelings of satisfaction and abundance that Taiori hopes to give to every guest. Your hostess, Shan, approaches and greets you in her delicate voice. Her genuine smile gives every traveler the feeling that they have arrived at a traditional Japanese household, and are about to experience the meticulous attention to detail characteristic of the Japanese. “Our original motivation was to allow people to travel to Yilan for a vacation, to eat local fish, and discover the deliciousness of Taiwanese fish!” With his wife Shan’s support, Wesley exacting tastes realized that no other bed and breakfast had yet combined the local seafood of Yilan with the hot springs for which Jiaoxi is famous into a single space. So they took the initiative and constructed just such a landmark restaurant guesthouse which is now in high demand.Experience the warmth of slow livingWhen you arrive at Taiori with its solid wood construction and head upstairs to the second floor, the symmetrical rooms left and right both consist of comfortable two-level spaces. The bedrooms contain soft beds and a full wall of windows overlooking the vast fields beyond. After soaking in the hot spring bathtub, you don a supple bathrobe and sit in the Japanese-style space sipping hot tea and playing Chinese chess. Turning your head, you admire the bright green rice paddies outside the windows. During migratory bird season, black-winged stilts with their long, slender legs can be seen wading slowly through the fields.The upper level of each room consists of your very own private hot spring spa which, however small, is brimming with character. The spacious hot spring bathtub is large enough for three or four friends to enjoy without feeling crowded. Bathing in the gentle hot spring water of Jiaoxi, while sipping a glass of ice-cold sake wine and marveling at the meticulously manicured Japanese garden outside the floor-to-ceiling windows, you feel elated and content.Collect for safe keeping all the delicious memoriesFor the gourmand traveler, the most fascinating element of Taiori B&B is obviously the sumptuous evening meal. When he was a boy, Wesley fell in love with eating and enjoyed helping his mother in the kitchen. Stationed in Shitiping, he often joined the fishermen at sea, experiencing firsthand how to eat freshly caught fish raw and straight from the sea. Seizing the opportunity to open a restaurant beside the Shitiping Harbor, he learned the ropes for cooking seafood while consulting his indigenous chef friends. To this day, Wesley still makes daily trips to the harbor to select the freshest fish, always striving to prepare a unique seasonal menu just for you.Appetizers consist of Yilan’s famous smoked duck and handpicked seaweed. Japanese Jack mackerel, Oriental tuna, and sweet prawns caught fresh that evening are prepared into sashimi, allowing you to savor their most authentic flavor. Precious harlequin shrimp and red big-eyed fish are served lightly salted and broiled to perfection to preserve the delicate freshness of the meat. The seasonal main dish is fried on a pottery skillet: anglerfish liver, testes, and maw served with a rich variety of vegetables and mushrooms, paired with a clear soup and light brown Japanese soy sauce. The sweetness of the veggies perfectly complements the savory fish in mildly salty sauce to produce an indescribable array of flavors. The meal is followed at last by a bowl of miso soup and a kumquat slushie. Using the authentic flavors of the best unadorned ingredients, tonight’s meal leaves you with an unforgettable dining experience.In operation for nearly nine years, Wesley and Shan have not lost their passion for life. Through the hot springs of Jiaoxi and their deliciously sincere intention, they take care of the heart of every traveler. Between blue sky and green fields, they have created a happy safe harbor, providing you with relaxation and peace of mind.

Hotels.Description: Shuangxi is a township at the confluence of two rivers, and the area is a protected water source. While it lacks the glitz and glamor of neighboring Jinguashi, Jiufen, Pingxi, or Fulong, it retains as its core value the concept of creating a dialogue between the rivers and the mountains, making hit a valued tourist destination. Shuangzhenyuan Bed & Breakfast aims to provide its guests with a tranquil, healthy, simple experience. Its managerial team has a total of five hospitality licenses, and the breakfasts provided, both Chinese and Western, are created using organic fruit and vegetables along with other locally produced ingredients. Built using green design ideas that provide excellent ventilation and lighting, the building offers a sense of being embraced by nature as you dine, while around you the calls of little egrets and Formosan blue magpies provide accompaniment. Enjoy the best that life has to offer in an atmosphere of green mountains, blue waters, and bright sunshine. This Bed & Breakfast has five rooms over two floors, with wooden floors that create a comfortable Japanese style. It also offers a safe, comfortable space for parents to bring their children to. The natural-stone-paved riverbank creates a perfect balance with the lush grasslands and greenery, which sop up the rain like a sponge. This natural environment also attracts a diverse range of fauna, and to help guests get the most out of their stay, guided tours from the owners and their families are available. In quiet and secluded mountains, the unique geographical location offers you to embrace the scenery of East Rift Valley together with your companions. We provide a bicarbonate chloride spring for every room. HOTEL Area features a total of 119 rooms, all equipped with a scenery balcony. Open your windows gently, enjoy the views of blue sky of Huatung Valley (East Rift Valley), clouds and mists in the green overflowing mountains. PRESIDENT VILLA Area features a total 102 villas, the largest villa complex in Southeast Asia. Each villa has landscape garden, private pool, balé (Gazebo); comfortable and bright living rooms and separate bedrooms, for you to enjoy undisturbed privacy. Check in Papago International Resort, you'll find yourself seeming to stay in a beautiful dreamland.     ※ Won the first place by vote in "2009 Excellent Hotel of Choice in East Rift Valley" sponsored by the East Rift Valley National Scenic Area Administration, Tourism Bureau.    ※ Won the fifth place in "2010 National Survey of the Service Sector" sponsored by Global Views Monthly. This was the first time Papago participated in the survey and was the only hotel candidate selected in a competitive market of leisure travel hotel in Hualien-Taitung-Pingtung Area.   ※ In 2010, Papago pioneered the "2012 Super Car Tour" in Taiwan, establishing the new culture of the East Rift Valley, Super Car Tour in Papago!   ※ In 2011, the third anniversary of Papago, Taitung County Government sponsored "2011 Taiwan Balloon Fiesta" and held the International Airspace Seminar at Papago International Conference Venue. And, hot air balloons took off from the Love Square of Papago, Chihshang (Chishang), which was an event for promoting both Taitung City and Papago International Resort synchronously.   ※ In 2011, Papago and Taitung County Government organized "2011 Super Car Tour Holiday" to integrate Taitung Tourism Cultural in holiday activities, promoting the culture to the international arena.   ※ In 2012, Tourism Bureau, MOTC, granted Papago a Five-star Rating certificate, and Papago International Resort becomes a quality resort with both five-star rating and certified hot spring.

Hotels.Description: Futen-house Villa B&B is located in the Leisure Agriculture Area of the historic Mountain Route of Railroad, Sanyi Township, at Miaoli Highway 49-1 where connects Longteng Broken Bridge and Shengxing Station. Amid luxuriant woods next to Shengxing old railroad, you can find an independent red brick building, "Futen-house Villa," hides in the woods and appears particularly eye-catching.     Toiling over to reclaim the land of Futen-house Villa and cultivating every tree and flower personally, the host couple hope to provide a natural environment for future generations and to present completely the organic and ecological perspectives of the Fulton- house Villa to the public. In particular, in every season of Tung Blossom, the natural forest barrier of Futen-house Villa presents a hazy sea of snow white flowers of the April. It is breathtakingly beautiful.     Futen-house Villa covers an area of ​​two hectares, which focuses on environmental constructions of returning to the original forests. In the vast hinterland of the eco-park, the green land of forest includes organic orchards, ecological purification ponds, and has planted Lagerstroemia subcostata, maples, Taiwan Gordonia, etc., throughout. The natural environment often attracts the nesting of Taiwan Blue Magpies, Taiwan Barbets, Gray-cheeked Fulvetta, among others, in the park of Futen-house Villa. Every visiting visitor is able to experience the fun of living in the mountains and the leisure of recreational mode, to enjoy the idyllic countryside, and artistic creations of Hakka village, and to stroll in an open paradise of blue sky and green land.   Come to Futen-house Villa, allow the hosts to elaborate the Sanyi culture / Monuments / Art / Nature, and to make carefully a custom journey package for you, featuring a natural hinterland of 16,500 square-meters for the parent-child ramble, tea party for a few friends, lovers' stroll, health programs for the seniors, and enjoying the calm space of the mind.      Feature forest landscape log cabins, elegant coffee house, outdoor pavilion lounges, ecological lotus ponds, orchards, goose pond, and coffee tree trails, in addition to exclusive spacious suites. In Autumn, coffee beans turn ripe; visitors may also enjoy the pleasure of picking coffee beans. Visitors can experience all park facilities and activities, and because of this attitude of careful management, the Villa won consistently high praises from travelers. The innkeepers adhere to make Futen-house Villa a happy accommodation that the tourists to Sanyi cannot miss.

Hotels.Description: Taitung｜TRUE FDs INNExperience Life in an Ecological Classroom on Little Liuqiu!If you get some rare time off, why not embark on a special island journey? Little Liuqiu is the perfect spot! This place has it all, including splendid sunshine, sea views, and a wealth of ecological culture. If you’re seeking travel accommodations near the convenience of the wharf, look no further than TRUE FDs INN, where you will find comfortable rooms, passionate hosts, and the joyous laughter of travelling guests. Everything you need awaits you at TRUE FDs INN!An ecological classroom located on the Old StreetEntering Little Liuqiu’s bustling old street district, you come to the bright yellow door of TRUE FDs INN. Pulling the door open, the host of the guesthouse, Cheng-Nan steps out from behind the bar to greet you. With his love of natural ecology, he has turned his guesthouse into a little classroom devoted to ecological education. The spacious living room provides a place for travelers to interact. From tissue boxes, to the homemade map of Little Liuqiu on the wall, to models of sea turtles, look around to see the entire space devoted to ecological awareness.TRUE FDs INN sees all guests as dear friends - all of your questions are welcome. Your host will share information about his treasured collection of sea animal miniatures. The son of a fisherman, Cheng-Nan was born and raised in Little Liuqiu. After high school, Cheng-Nan left the island life for a time to pursue his independence in Kaohsiung. After his daughter was born, he decided to return to his hometown to raise her. He was determined to introduce her to all the beauty of this little island. He applied his experience in hotel management as well as his passion for ocean ecology to create the TRUE FDs INN we see today.A lesson in seven rooms on the beauty of LiuqiuThe clear, square exterior appearance of TRUE FDs INN actually contains traditional construction which is long and deep. All seven rooms are decorated in a simple yet comfortable industrial style. The name of each room contains both a story and special local significance. In the “Crab” and “Hermit Crab” rooms, Cheng-Nan urges travelers to “take nothing but pictures” and “leave nothing but footsteps” so as to protect the ecology of Little Liuqiu. The “Fisherman” and “Mermaid” rooms conceal the secret legend of the Black Dwarf Cave, and are most suitable accommodations for two good friends to check into. Furthermore, the “Little Liuqiu”,  “Ocean Superman” and “Sea Hare” rooms are all well worth checking out.Beyond the rooms, Cheng-Nan has combined local ecology with cultural creativity in his design, even preparing small gifts for each traveler who checks in. The gift box made of eco-friendly materials can be used as a tissue box, and contains a t-shirt of the nightly theme, postcards, and descriptions in an interesting passage introducing to travelers the nightly theme for their room. Little Liuqiu: a profound exploration “Sleeping accommodations are the first and most direct line of contact with travelers!” Cheng-Nan firmly believes that travel accommodations offer the best opportunity to educate travelers. Travelers are usually left with a profound impression of the natural beauty of Little Liuqiu, yet very few people know about the rich cultural history of the island. In the future, Cheng-Nan plans to launch a different kind of itinerary for travellers, allowing visitors to go beyond the educational ocean eco-tourism that is now prevalent, to become acquainted with local culture, and to have a deep experience of life on the island. Furthermore, Cheng-Nan is beginning to promote habitat regeneration of intertidal zones, beach clean-up efforts, and weekly lectures from ecological experts and environmental protection figures. Through this series of discussions, he hopes to allow more and more people to understand ways in which to coexist and thrive within the natural environment.TRUE FDs INN is built upon Cheng-Nan’s passion for natural ecology, and his dreams and determination are visible in every nook and corner. Above and beyond the wish to offer travelers a comfortable space in which to stay, Cheng-Nan hopes that after his guests will gain a deeper knowledge of natural ecology, and work together to protect the environment, and become friends of the ocean!

Hotels.Description: A-Bun’s Home Bed and Breakfast in Ruili is legally-certified Bed and Breakfast No. 78, surrounded by verdant mountains and greenery, with a two-story wooden building, quietly standing in front of the tea garden in a perfectly serene environment. With a superior location on the the Ruili Scenic line, it’s near sites such as the Ruitai Visitor Center, Yejianghua Creek Trail, Swallow Cliff, 1000 Year Bat Cave, Yuantan Creek Eco Park, and Fenqihu Old Street, with convenient transportation whether you’re coming here by bus or car. The owner of A-Bun’s Home originally worked in the tea business; in cooperation with the Alishan Management Office and public promotion of the Ruili tourism industry, A-Bun’s Home also promoted the local industry, leading visitors on tours to learn about the aesthetic beauty of Ruili’s natural mountain scenery and rich plant and animal ecology. Rooms are limited, but each is warm and bright with elegant layout and decoration. The wooden floor and walls give off a faint scent, and right outside the window is a tea garden that looks straight out of a TV commercial. These rooms are perfectly comfortable. After enjoying a delicious dinner, let the owner take you on a night tour – the night life of Ruili is sure to bring unprecedented experiences. The thoughtful owner has also created an outdoor rest area and game room where guests can play mahjong or cards if they are in the mood for it. Or chat with friends under a starry sky, sampling homegrown high mountain tea. Tea-picking or tea production process tours are available from April to November.

Hotels.Description: "The Place", is a brand crafted with style under the Hotel Royal Group. The name of "the Place" stresses deep link to local culture where the hotel locates, and insists the spirit of "Fun, Fusion, Fashion". In 2019, the Place officially opens in Taipei.Design team from Mecanoo architecten in Holland was appointed on a project basis for the interior design of the hotel. The team planned for 179 chic and simple rooms, the public art space, meeting rooms and specialty restaurants. The team uses ports, red bricks, tea and other historical and pictorial elements in the hotel to present different periods of Nangang.The exterior and lighting of the hotel building are designed by internationally famous C.Y. Lee and James Yuan. Hotels.Description: Keep a Little Light Art Hostel is a hostel located in a former military dependents’ village in Kaohsiung City.Leaving a small light on represents the warmth of home—so that when family members return after a long day, they know this home has always been waiting for them.It also symbolizes the anticipation and hope that the families of naval servicemen once held for their loved ones’ safe return.Here, everything can move a little slower. You can relax as if you were at home, enjoying the nostalgic charm and tranquil life of the old villages, away from the hustle and bustle of the city.This is a military dependents’ village—a place where the families of servicemen once lived. After demolition and reconstruction, the remaining villages have become part of Taiwan’s valuable cultural heritage.It is an ideal place for friends to gather, for family retreats, wedding celebrations, or simply as a quiet stop during your travels. At the same time, it serves as an art studio and a peaceful space for rest and reflection—an oasis in the heart of the city.Its unpretentious, vintage atmosphere is built upon the wisdom of the past and the humility of carrying on tradition for the future. With gratitude, care, and dedication, we have restored No. 23 to bring its historical beauty back to life.

Hotels.Description: Known previously as Juguang New Village, a military dependent’s village, Penghu Bay Resort has its history rooted across two different historical eras: Japanese colonization, and the exodus of the Republic of China Government from China. Juguang New Village is one of the oldest military dependent’s village in Taiwan.Penghu Bay Resort offers 60 individual rooms. Each room is its own bungalow.Before the advent of red brick, concrete, and materials like steel rebars for construction, much of Penghu’s residences were made from coral stone or Penghu’s specialty: basalt.Every room in the resort is separated by a wall of coral stone, and when viewed from the outside, one can see the individual basalt pieces that form the outer wall of the bungalows.Walking in the quiet resort, you can feel the tranquility and beauty of this historic village.Every corner of this resort is filled with history and nostalgia, transporting you through time back to the simpler 50s and 60s Taiwan.

It is known as "Miaoli Barn" and "Lin Grassland Township".These artistic and cultural history are revitalized and carried forward under the efforts of a group of returning youths. It is called "Enjoy the Time".On the way to "enjoy the time", drive through the spacious country roads, surrounded by field scenery, spring seedlings are green and vibrant; summer green rice fields swing with the wind, green waves ups and downs; autumn full of golden rice ears, floating bursts of rice Fragrant; fallow in winter to prepare for the coming year, planting flowers to form a unique scenery of the sea of ​​flowers, looking up at the sky will give you a panoramic view of the vast blue sky. The planning of various areas such as "Xianyan" banquet hall, "Music" restaurant, "Time Man" coffee shop, "Guangyuan" outdoor terrace, game and reading area, KTV, indoor observation deck, etc. will bring guests the ultimate enjoyment .

Hotels.Description: Kenting Good News B&B is a stylish *legal B&B* located in Hengchun Town. The entire building has a high-ceiling design, and the B&B provides guests with a very comfortable resting space.  You can take a sightseeing bus at the intersection of the homestay, which takes about 5 minutes to get to Nanwan, 3 kilometers away, and 10-15 minutes to get to Kenting Street, 7.8 kilometers away. It also takes about 10-15 minutes to get to the National Museum of Marine Biology and Aquarium.  The Hengchun Peninsula is very large. Kenting Street is a street in Hengchun Town. It is very lively at night with a lot of commercial activities, but during the day most people go to places other than Kenting Street to play, such as Baisha Bay, Guanshan, Maobitou, Eluanbi Lighthouse, Longpan Park, Fengchuisha, Jialesui, Oceanarium... and so on.  Kenting Good News B&B is located right in the middle of these attractions. There are many attractions and special foods near the B&B, such as Dong Niang's Store, Alley Kitchen, Hengchun Mi Valley, Garage Kitchen, Six-Inch Plate Brunch, Taiwan's First Fried Chicken, Food Stalls, Eight Treasure Ice, Braised Food, Vegetarian Noodles, Xiao Du Baozi, Ten Bowls of Noodles, Thai cuisine, seafood cuisine, Vietnamese cuisine, 7-11 convenience store, and PX Welfare Center, all of which are near the B&B and can be reached in about 2 to 10 minutes on foot. The B&B provides wireless internet access. Each room has a private bathroom and split-type air-conditioning, LCD TV, refrigerator, and toiletries. The accommodation environment is very comfortable and the transportation is convenient. The B&B will provide a complete guide map and introduce local delicious and fun information to tourists in need. It is also a high-quality B&B that spreads good news. This homestay will be left to my good friends, a place to stop and rest. We will provide the most comfortable accommodation environment and sincere and attentive service attitude to give you the most wonderful journey. I also wish you all a happy holiday! Hotels.Description: No. 10 Magong Ancient Street B&B is located on Central Street in Magong City, a historical scenic spot where the ancestors of Penghu first developed and gathered. Although we are located in an ancient street, our B&B exudes a brand new vitality. In 2005, the building fell into disrepair and was no longer habitable. With the approval of the government, we rebuilt the house and carefully preserved the historical features of every brick and tile. When you come here, you feel as if you are in the early years of the Republic of China.Our bed and breakfast is very conveniently located in a corner of the city center, away from the hustle and bustle. There are many first-class historical sites around, such as Tianhou Temple, Taixiajiao Guild Hall (Narcissus Temple), Wanjun Well, Siyan Well, Shigong Temple, etc., which can be easily reached on foot. You can stroll through this quaint old street and experience the lifestyle of the early ancestors. In addition, our homestay is well connected, whether you are going to Guanyinting Beach to enjoy the fireworks, or to the downtown area of ​​Zhongzheng Road, Fisherman's Wharf and other urban attractions, it is a very convenient choice. We sincerely invite every traveler to slow down, experience the feeling of traveling through time, and immerse yourself in the unique charm of No. 10 Magong Ancient Street B&B.☆Our Honor:◆Won the first place in the "Sustainable Low-Carbon Island, Saving Electricity for a Better Life" electricity saving competition in 2023◆Rated as "Hospitable B&B" in January 2024◆Provide travel introduction and customized services​☆Tips:◆In order to preserve the historical features, this B&B is a three-story building without elevator facilities, but we have strong helpers who can assist in carrying luggage.◆Because it is located in the old street in the city center, parking may be a little inconvenient, but our little helper can provide detailed parking information.​☆★☆After booking, please be sure to join our official LINE: @mk864 to get more information!

Hotels.Description: We are located in the suburbs of Taitung City, offering a standalone "courtyard vacation house" with private access and easy parking. Just 10 minutes from the city center, Tiehua Village, Zhonghua Road shopping district, Showtime Cinemas, PX Mart flagship store, Blue Dragonfly Fried Chicken, Banyan Tree Rice Noodles, and Zhengqi Tourist Night Market. Enjoy fresh air and a comfortable resting space. Please allow us to introduce you to the beauty of Taitung and let’s enjoy the blue skies of Taitung together.The owner personally designed the space with gentle, understated tones—nothing flashy. The high ceilings create a relaxing atmosphere. In the living room, there is a massage chair (sanitized regularly) as a thoughtful little service for those driving or riding motorcycles. We provide oversized beds to ensure travelers can rest comfortably—small details but very important. We look forward to welcoming travelers to experience the happiness of Taitung.Our green-themed guesthouse is located in Taitung City but without the crowding of the urban area. Just 10 minutes to the golden city center. We are a standalone courtyard house with neighbors nearby. There’s a FamilyMart convenience store close by, and the airport is only 1.3 kilometers away. Perfect for vacationers, small families, and motorcycle enthusiasts (safe parking for your beloved bikes). Renting the entire house for weddings or banquets is also a great option.The guesthouse is spotless inside and out because the owner loves cleanliness. We hope you come here to feel the simplicity, warmth, and relaxed lifestyle of Taitung. Hotels.Description: A century ago, standing at Keelung riverside, overviewing the sight of smoke-filled air from chimneys of brick kiln factories in the area surrounding Dazhi Bridge. Ever since the time of Japanese Occupation, Dazhi has been recognized as the gathering place for numerous brick kiln factories. As brick kiln masters pick up every piece of meticulously crafted bricks, branded with the T.R logo (T.R represents “Taiwan Renga”—quality bricks that are produced by Taiwan Renga Stock Corporation), the entire process serves as a reminder of the changes and glorious past of Dazhi. Inheriting the spirit of persistence from the kiln masters, Hotel Indigo Taipei North sparing no effort for five years with a careful selection of 520,000 handmade bricks, methodically constructed a building which overlooks Dazhi in its entirety. Bring a new aspect of the hotel construction, through its stylized design, historical concepts and beautiful paintings, reappears once again in the hotel spaces, completely imprinted Dazhi’s wonderful past.

Hotels.Description: 【Xindian Bitan Lake Hotel】 is located next to Bitan in Xindian District, New Taipei City. “Renaissance” is a philosophical and cultural movement that occurred in Europe between the 14th and 17th century. It inherited ancient Greek and Roman culture and brought about a revolutionary era in science and art. It has innovative meanings due to “inheriting the past and opening up for the future”. The Renaissance unveiled a new era for modern European history by setting foundations for modern science and culture development. It also symbolized the input of an unprecedented current regarding tourism and cultural creative industry. With 【Classic Replica－European Renaissance】 as the center of design, by assembling core art, drama, literature, science, and philosophy works, “humanism thoughts” promoted in the Renaissance are utilized in the overall design of the hotel, thus creating an European artistic and cultural atmosphere blended with modernity and classic. Upon entering the lobby, visitors can immediately feel the magnificence of European Renaissance scenarios. Staying in our themed rooms, tourists can enjoy the beautiful scenery of the green mountains and blue water of Bitan, along with classic Renaissance masterpieces from various fields, thus reproducing the grand recreational palaces of the time. This extravagant classical and European hotel is located in an area with convenient transportation. You can enjoy the beautiful landscapes of Bitan with your eyes! It is your first choice among all hotels in the Bitan region of Xindian! It is the most iconic hotel of this region!

The flowing water along the small bridges, the sound of frogs and birds, coupled with the fragrance of flowers will truly be memorable. Our 9 stepped natural ecological pool is a well-known parent-child outdoor education venue! Enjoy lotus viewing, water playing, barbecuing, singing... Hotels.Description: Welcome to Voyage Kaohsiung by Cosmos Oasis, where “Explore the Harbor City, Experience Exquisite Living” is our philosophy. ‘Voyage’ embodies the essence of travel and journeys, perfectly suited for our location in the vibrant harbor city of Kaohsiung. Inspired by the harbor and shipping containers, our hotel showcases timeless, understated, new oriental aesthetics. The main structure, composed of stacked containers, boasts an elegant, pure white exterior that seamlessly blends elements of the ocean, harbor life, ships, and trading goods. Illuminated at night, it mirrors the lively buzz of the bustling harbor, resonating with travelers from all over the world who dock here to experience the unique passion, culture, and history of Southern Taiwan. Experience a memorable stay at our enchanting harbor retreat and embark on an unforgettable journey. Bon Voyage!Voyage Kaohsiung by Cosmos Oasis features 28 well-appointed guest rooms, a grand lobby with soaring ceilings, and elegant floral and botanical arrangements that exude sophisticated charm. Natural light intertwines with Kaohsiung’s cultural highlights, creating an ambiance filled with profound visual imagery that reflects the vibrant essence of the local harbor city. This atmosphere offers a rich blend of visual allure and comfort, catering to both the mind and body of travelers.

Hotels.Description: Tang Home B&B is a charming building made of white and orange cultural stone, which looks even more beautiful at night with atmospheric lighting that creates a poetic vibe. The B&B offers free breakfast and free parking for added convenience. The interior design is thoughtfully curated by the owner, with each room having its own unique color scheme and style. The lobby has a more American-style vibe, and on the first floor, you& #39;ll find a mosaic wall art designed by the owner herself. The warm lighting inside creates a cozy and welcoming atmosphere. Additionally, Tang Home B&B is equipped with an elevator, making your stay even more comfortable.Located in the heart of Taitung City, the B&B is just a 10-minute drive from the Taitung Train Station, making it very accessible. For your convenience, the B&B offers self-check-in after 5 PM, allowing for a smoother arrival process. Guests can also enjoy free bicycles to explore nearby attractions like the Taitung Art Museum, Tiehua Village, Taitung Forest Park, and Seaside Park—perfect for a relaxing and enjoyable vacation. There are also affordable and tasty local restaurants nearby, where you can savor the flavors of Taitung and experience its rich culture.At Tang Home B&B, you can take a leisurely stroll through the thoughtfully designed space, soak in the authentic atmosphere of Taitung, and unwind in a comfortable setting that promises a pleasant journey. Whether you& #39;re here with family, a partner, or for business, Tang Home B&B offers the perfect retreat for all types of travelers. We look forward to welcoming you and making your Taitung trip unforgettable.

Hotels.Description: Located in Taibao City, Chiayi County in southern Taiwan, The Brick Hotel is the first resort hotel that uses bricks with both cultural and ecological characteristics as the theme of the hotel. It is only two minutes& #39; walk away from the Southern Branch of the National Palace Museum. The hotel provides family accommodation and catering services. Its facilities include the Kids& #39; Luminous Bricks Playroom, the Kid& #39;s Exclusive Racing Track .The Brick Hotel comprises two main halls and 188 brick-themed rooms. On display in the corridor of the guest room are copies of 100 world-famous paintings. By integrating technology and the human-touch, the luminous brick corridor is interactive and voice-activated. Inside the hall, the luminous brick playroom nearly 330 m2 in size provides a great space for all guests to relax. The child-friendly hall has 36 large rooms with six themes, including the cherry blossom fairy, the tunnel train, the blue mountain and sea, wood elves, Mr. Giant Tree and a deer park. There are also special tracks for children to play with electric cars, including a garage, cars in every room, and private bathroom facilities.The hotel boasts a Hotsai banquet hall that provides both Chinese and western breakfast containing strictly selected, high-quality agricultural products and fresh ingredients. The banquet room is tall without columns, affording all guests a broad view of the room. Covering an area of 1,320 m2, the banquet venue can accommodate up to 100 round tables (10 guests per table) so is suitable for conferences, meetings, wedding banquets, dinners and other special events.

Hotels.Description: The whole concept started from architecture. In 2004, Yuan Ken Architecture Workshop and us built BIBOFI in Anping. This project is the initial point of architecture for me and Architect WU-I WU. What's more, I saw a group of people making effort to turn out their ideal under the traditional system of constructing. They are making the change, restarting a new house pattern by focusing on every single detail which would also touch you in various ways.  That's why my family and I made a wish. We hope that more and more people can experience such fragrant thing.  We then took over Share House which is built in 2015, making it into a guesthouse. Hoping to continue the spirit of sharing and provide the oppurtunity for more travelers to enter a new generation of townhouse. A house that's minuscule but has it's own front and backyard at the same time, this gains you a peaceful night just for you and you companions.  Inspired by architecture, turned out by Guesthouse The final goal is hoping we and our next generation to resonate the houses we live in everyday. The possibilities that we can seek in buildings, especially to feel the breeze, the sun naturally in urban. We desire to get close to mother nature because we are borned from it, If we can be surrounded by nature in urban, how precious could it be?  A group of hard-working people fulfilled this building so it worth recommending.  The base of Share House is nothing but a slim land, by the effort of those people we can see how different they are using the interior and changing the way of life from the traditional ways. This is not just a townhouse, but also a feast of living and seeing.  The effort of us keep on going  Such worthy of recommendation, we hope all of you would find here as another home that you would want to come back often.  We sincerely share this Share House with you. About interior furnishing  We decorated Share house with our collection in the past 20 years of traveling under the systematic material. colour and detail design of Yuan Ken Architecture Workshop. We hope to share our travel experience with all travelers.  Home bears the accumulation of life. Family will always devote the best of themselves to each other. This would increase the happiness between everyone visbly and invisbly.  We hope that everyone can consider Share House as your home in Tainan. Leisurely enjoy traveling and clear out the tireness in Share House.

Hotels.Description: Countryside Retreat in Yilan, TaiwanNestled in the rural landscape of Yilan County in northeastern Taiwan, this private vacation cottage offers a serene escape surrounded by lush greenery. The standalone modern-minimalist home features an open-concept kitchen, allowing guests to cook and dine while enjoying the picturesque countryside views. Experience the tranquility of Taiwan’s rural lifestyle in this thoughtfully designed farmhouse retreat.Designed and planned by three sisters—a renowned architect, an interior designer, and a travel journalist—this cozy yet stylish homestay embodies warmth and comfort. To ensure an intimate and exclusive experience, we host only one group at a time, accommodating 4 to 6 guests. Ideal for friends and families, it’s the perfect place to unwind and savor the charm of country living.The integrated kitchen and dining area create a welcoming space for shared meals and gatherings. Floor-to-ceiling windows provide unobstructed views of the surrounding farmlands, while the verdant garden and wooden deck with a hanging chair offer a peaceful retreat. Whether you seek relaxation or a quiet getaway, a stay in Yilan promises a rejuvenating rural escape.Important InformationCheck-in: After 4:00 PMCheck-out: Before 12:00 PMAccommodation: 4–6 guests (2 double beds + 1 sofa bed). Please inform us of the number of guests when booking.Amenities: The farmhouse does not have a TV or provide meals. However, the kitchen is fully equipped with a refrigerator, gas stove, microwave, electric kettle, small oven, rice cooker, tableware, cookware, and basic condiments. A 7-Eleven is conveniently located across the street.House Rules:No barbecues or pets allowed.Smoking indoors is strictly prohibited.Absolutely no drug use or parties.Nature & Environment: As this is a rural area, we recommend bringing mosquito repellent.Enjoy a peaceful countryside retreat in Yilan!

Hotels.Description: K2 Hostel is conveniently located in Taitung City, just 800 meters from the train station. Designed with a focus on practicality and warmth, the interiors feature minimalist wooden decor, creating a cozy and natural ambiance. The bunk bed setup maximizes space efficiency, with each bed equipped with a personal curtain to ensure privacy and comfort. The women’s dorm includes a Japanese-style low table and seating area, perfect for relaxing, reading, or playing games with travel companions. Small windows on the walls bring in natural light, making the space bright and inviting. Each room is also equipped with a simple clothes rack and a waste bin, catering to essential needs and highlighting the convenience of light travel.  The overall atmosphere is modest yet comfortable, making K2 Hostel an excellent choice for backpackers and small groups seeking a simple, homey stay and a pleasant travel experience.

In the park, you can watch countless wild birds flying, butterflies flying, dragonflies soaring...listen to the chirping of cicadas and enjoy the harmonious sounds of nature. If you are lucky, you can even catch a striga to keep you company!

Hotels.Description: Xinyi Xinyi is a newly opened homestay in 2022/July. It is located in Wujie Township, Yilan County, near the Interchange of National Highway No. 5 (Luodong/Wujie), near Dongshan River Water Park, Chuanyi Center, Luodong Night Market, etc. The transportation location is convenient. Sex is high, and it is also a good place to be quiet in the midst of trouble. We present comfort and expectation of life in the most natural, simple and pure way. The living room is spacious to create a feeling of relaxation, and there are several large floor-to-ceiling windows and large window frames, allowing natural sunlight to flow in. Each window is a natural landscape painting, adding a touch of greenery to each space. Extending to the restaurant, it is a good space for dining. The simple and spacious environment hopes to bring you a comfortable, natural and relaxing space. It's a good place to be in a daze, to be empty, and to forget that time is flowing. You can have a cup of coffee and a cup of tea here, in the flowing space, laughing happily or roaming the field road for a day, it seems to inject energy, a kind of enjoyment of life, and live your vacation. This is where we want to give you comfort and relaxation. Come to Xinyi ~ feel it! In spring, the fields are green, but the green is different: dark green, oily green, tender green, neatly divided into small pieces. In summer, in the low fields, the rice is ripe, and the golden ones seem to be covered with a thick layer of gold. The autumn waves swayed the rice, causing the heavy ears of rice to fluctuate rhythmically, as if the golden mountain was on a landslide. The sound of wind and rice waves is like a moving piece of music. In autumn and winter, the fields are like mirrors, reflecting the sky and beautiful scenery. Seeing it is fate~

Hotels.Description: Xiuchuan Street was a bustling commercial street during the Qing Dynasty, more than a hundred years ago. The old dock of the Sanxia River was located here, attracting numerous merchant ships and presenting a picturesque scene. Adjacent to the riverbank stood the Zaisu Temple, the earliest center of worship in Sanxia. The street gradually became surrounded by traditional buildings as it catered to the residents& #39; daily needs for food, clothing, shelter, and transportation. However, during the Japanese colonial period, commercial activities in this area declined, and most shops moved to the current Sanxia Old Street. Nevertheless, Xiuchuan Street and its surroundings still retain a strong sense of ordinary life and are considered one of Taiwan& #39;s most historically valuable old streets.To revive the beauty of the old houses, Gandle Creative Studio has reinterpreted a historic building as an independent homestay called "Xiuchuan Residence," through a minimalist and gentle approach. The interior decoration preserves the charm of the old house, with nostalgic floor tiles and warm yellow pendant lights that naturally exude an indescribable sense of familial intimacy. We hope that during your short stay here, you can experience the nostalgic atmosphere of the past in this contemporary setting, and create wonderful memories with your family, friends, colleagues, and classmates.

Hotels.Description: In Yilan, an art city, we use an architectural style that stands out with a mesh exterior grille structure, combined with clean water construction methods, a large open-air bath with a natural atmosphere of a hot spring forest, and a hot spring-style children's play area space to create a It is a unique hot spring hotel and has a semi-open-air marble hot spring bathtub in the room, allowing you to experience the open-air hot spring experience without interference in the room. There was a vague quality between people in the soup pool.We try to replace a heavy volume with an unknown texture, so that the irregular lines produce an unknown volume. Sometimes the roller blinds are half-covered, and sometimes Fog fills the room, sometimes the windows are bright and clear, and sometimes the night light shines through. Hotels.Description: .We once gathered travelers to hear Daji introduce "Together Design& #39;s" installation art, "Kaohsiung Shui Shui." From that landscape, I saw an image of my own journey through the harbor city. At the time, I joked, "If the opportunity ever arises, could we collaborate on a similar installation somewhere?" Years later, that dream materialized in this old mountain house, allowing Daji to express his perception of this land through architecture and lines.One afternoon, I stepped into "WADO Light+Living" in Dadaocheng. I watched and listened as Jiyang used light to narrate memories with his grandfather, surrounded by a house full of vibrant lighting fixtures, until the golden hour of sunset. I thought, "Someday, given the chance, the lighting in a space should be arranged just like this." And now, within "Layers of Light," every moment sees not only the shifting natural light but also "WADO& #39;s" ingenious artistry with light harmonizing with it."Layers of Light" is the first movement in the "Glittering Gold" project by the Storing Light team. In life, we gather and disperse, then disperse and gather again, but we ultimately decided to do something fun together. This house is currently the largest guesthouse in the project, and the team has invited many collaborators we& #39;ve long wanted to work with, starting the story from the very genesis of the earth. We hope people will gather here, reflect on the treasures they& #39;ve found on their own journeys, and enjoy the layered convergence of each other& #39;s paths.

Hotels.Description: -Yuandian Homestay – LuodongYuandian Homestay is conveniently located in Luodong, just minutes from Luodong Night Market and the beautiful Luozhuang Sakura Trail. The Shiliufen waterway offers both cycling paths and pedestrian walkways, connecting to the Dongshan River and extending all the way toward the river mouth. Hotels.HotelName: SOHO Military Dependent's Villages Exploration Hall
Hotels.Description: Three old trees with lush greenery set off the Japanese-style single-family two-story brick and wood elevated house covered with cement roof tiles. The four-inch anti-theft nails above the brick fence and the red and white red gate of the military community. The whole house uses mortise and tenon structure to repair large wooden beams and columns, reinforce the elevated wooden floor, and open the damaged pole edge ceiling, so that the roof waterproofing and roof tile repair work can be seen at a glance, showing the restoration method and the integration of old and new local materials. This house is It is the residence of Principal Wang Jingyou, the first principal of Chengzheng Elementary School, and teacher Sun Juren (cousin of Sun Liren).We hope that everyone can experience the immersive daily life of the military dependents' village like us. In addition to walking through the village alleys and visiting the houses, you can also learn about the restoration process of the military dependents' houses and feel the gentle breeze blowing on your face under the three big trees that are unique for more than a month. You can linger comfortably, make a pot of fragrant tea, and enjoy the afternoon snacks of the Military Village. Children, both adults and children, can also experience making early handcrafted Children's Village toys. When night falls, you can ride your bicycle to Fengshan Street to buy local delicacies and return to the family home to enjoy. You can also simply experience making home-cooked food from the military family in the cooking area that retains the white square tiles from the 1950s. After a meal and a break, fill the bathhouse with hot water and put a bath tablet in it to relieve stress. At the end of the night, people quietly put on their pajamas and nestled in the master bedroom full of military village atmosphere or on the Japanese-style floor. Listening to the long good night song of the Army Academy, they fell asleep soundly. The next day, the melodies of various birds singing on the trees in the yard composed the beautiful movement of nature. Mix in the military academy’s reveille and experience the unique morning march of the military military village. After washing, make a cup of hot milk or hand-brewed coffee, pick up the steaming steamed buns in the steamer, and pair them with porridge and side dishes, which is the delicious taste of home in the military community. Open the edge grille sliding door and extend the interior to the courtyard. The inside and outside complement each other. Open a book in the corner, sit on a rocking chair, sometimes relax and sometimes reflect, and enjoy the unique SOHO studio that has evolved in this military village.​

Hotels.Description: Introduction to Chengdian B&BIndigo, still and bright blue, the sky in Taitung is always clean and clear.After a while, when the car slowly drove into Nanhui, my mood began to settle down, and I finally returned to Taitung, where I thought about it day and night, to calm down physically and mentally.The B&B is located next to Taitung Airport. The large terrace in front can overlook the Pacific Ocean and Green Island. In the evening The hour is accompanied by colorful sunset.The front of the third floor is the brother's room. This is how the family's feelings are accumulated and nourished. There is a comfortable leather sofa in the living room, where three generations can enjoy the sofa movie theater together, or sisters can chat over a glass of red wine in comfort.There are large windows in the living room, and there is a Japanese garden outside the window, with grass, stone steps and various potted flowers running around. You will be in a good mood when you wake up early in the morning.If you are a camping fan, the large terrace on the fourth floor can definitely satisfy your mood. Hotels.Description: THE ROCK B&B is located in Donghe Township, Taitung County. It leans against the towering mountains and overlooks the vast blue ocean. From a high position, it has a bird& #39;s-eye view of the Mawu Ku River and the parallel new and old East River bridges. Along the winding country roads, you can reach Donghe Old Street, which is rich in humanities. The interior and exterior walls of the B&B are made of uncarved concrete buildings. Low-key, quiet, simple and full. It is like a large stone standing on the hillside, contrasting with the imperial stone monoliths scattered on the bed of Mawu Ku River. The farmland where the B&B is located is planted with various herbs and fruit trees. The harvest is used to make agricultural products such as spices, jams and soaps. Within 30 minutes of driving, you can reach Dongheqiao Scenic Area, Jinzun Fishing Port, Lulian Island, Taiyuan Valley, the hometown of citrus, Chenggong Fishing Port, Dulan Sugar Factory Cultural and Creative Park and other places. It is a popular spot for surfing, rafting and tourism. Dashi Space hopes that travelers who stay here can feel the beauty of ultimate simplicity.

Hotels.Description: Here lies a story that belongs to the host of this guesthouse and this land.   The host grew up in the urban tribal area of Keelung, a mixed heritage of Han and Amis descent, and has always felt a deep sense of pride in their indigenous identity. When tribal friends spoke about returning to their homeland, it sparked a longing to reconnect with their roots. Carrying this hope, they came to Taitung, only to find themselves without connections or a guide to lead them back to the tribe.   Life in Taitung was lonely at times until one day, the companionship of cats brought a sense of comfort. The unconditional love and support of these animals provided a familiar warmth on this unfamiliar land and became the inspiration for creating this guesthouse. Through **Healing Cats Café and Guesthouse**, the host hopes that every traveler who visits can not only experience the healing presence of animals but also discover the beauty of indigenous culture.   Here, they wish for every visitor to relax their hearts and feel the warmth that flows deep from this land.

Hotels.Description: Li He Jia Zhu | Tainan West Central DistrictLi He Jia Zhu is located in Tainan West Central District, with convenient transportation and close proximity to many famous tourist attractions and shopping areas. The Shin Kong Mitsukoshi West Gate Store is about a 10-15 minute walk away, and guests can also visit the Blueprint Cultural and Creative Park along the way.It takes about 10 minutes by car to reach the Garden Night Market, one of the largest night markets in Tainan, which operates on Thursdays, Saturdays, and Sundays. It offers a variety of food and specialty snacks from all over Taiwan. There are also traditional markets nearby, such as Yongle Market and Yamu Liao Market, where guests can experience local flavors and cultural atmosphere.Check-in time is from 15:00 to 17:30 daily, and check-out time is before 11:00 the following day.Li He Jia Zhu looks forward to providing every guest with a safe and comfortable travel experience, allowing you to experience the unique slow-living charm of Tainan.**Please note that our front desk service hours are from 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM daily. If you plan to check in outside of these hours, we offer self-check-in service.**The self-check-in process will be sent to you through our official LINE account @lihejiazhu.To ensure a smooth check-in, please settle your room payment in advance and provide the guest& #39;s personal details for registration.This information will be used for legal registration and to comply with relevant regulations. We are a legitimate accommodation provider, and all check-in processes will follow legal requirements to ensure your safety and privacy.If you have any questions, please contact us during business hours or through our official LINE account. We are here to serve you. We look forward to your visit and wish you a pleasant stay!

Hotels.Description: "Alley House" B&B is located in the city center of Puli Township, Nantou County, offering a comfortable and convenient accommodation experience. Each room is equipped with windows, a private bathroom, air conditioning, a TV, and a refrigerator, ensuring a private and cozy stay for guests.In terms of transportation, the B&B is about a 10-minute drive from the Ailan Interchange. For bus travelers, you can get off at the Puli Winery Station and walk about 3 minutes to reach the B&B, making it very convenient. There are also plenty of amenities nearby, with Starbucks and 85°C just around the corner. Within a 2-minute walk, you’ll find popular local breakfast spots like Qing Bao Salty Fried Dough and City Burger. For shopping, you can drive 2-4 minutes to reach 7-11, PX Mart, Carrefour, and other supermarkets for your daily needs.Moreover, the B&B is close to many popular attractions, including the Puli Winery, Torii Cafe & Eatery, Knock Knock Wood Workshop, Wood Insect Museum, Paper Dragon Creative Center, Puli Town Holiday Night Market, Guangxing Paper Mill, and the Geographic Center Monument (Paragliding), making it an ideal place for those who enjoy exploring local culture and nature. The famous Sun Moon Lake is about a 20-minute drive away, and Cingjing Farm is about an hour’s drive, perfect for guests who plan to explore the surrounding area.Whether you're looking for a comfortable place to rest or an ideal base for exploring Nantou, "Alley House" offers the perfect accommodation choice.

We warmly invite you to create unforgettable memories with us as you embark on an extraordinary journey in Meinong.

Hotels.Description: The origin of Lanyu B&B "Original Tribe Exquisite B&B", "DO ji mi ney li Original Tribe"? It is said that this area was originally a small settlement. Hundreds of years ago, this small settlement was buried by the soil sliding down the slope above, so the residents here moved to the Dongqing tribe. After a long time, we returned to this place and built the "Original Tribe Exquisite B&B" with reinforced concrete. In order to commemorate the ancestors who once lived here, the B&B was named "DO ji mi ney li& #39;s original living tribe". This is the origin of the "Original Tribe Exquisite B&B".Our B&B "Yuanbu Village Exquisite B&B" recommends high-quality rooms with Lanyu sea and mountain views. It is located in Dongqing Village on the east side of Lanyu. Accommodation introduction: the B&B room types include double suites, six-person suites, and one love suite. The bathroom threshold has been changed to a flat type, specially designed with barrier-free facilities and movable safety handrails. The door has also been widened to facilitate electric wheelchairs to enter and exit. The bathroom door uses a horizontal pull design, which is easy for the elderly or disabled friends to push open.The entire space of "Yuanbu B&B" is 3.45 meters high. The stairs for going up and down are designed with night fluorescent light strips to provide guidance in the event of a power outage. There are also escape indicator LED lights and night LED lighting, flame-proof curtains, fire-fighting equipment, etc. Our original intention is to make the guests who come to stay feel at ease and relaxed.The beautiful island of Lanyu is the best place in Taiwan to watch the first light of dawn. You don& #39;t have to go out to watch the sunrise when staying at the "Original Tribe B&B". Just gently open the curtains and you can see the beautiful sunrise in the sea view room. The mountain view room is even farther away from the hustle and bustle of the city, allowing you to wash away the fatigue of your body and soul and relax your body. The "Original Tribe B&B" is surrounded by mountains and rivers, with a broad view and beautiful scenery. The balcony of the sea view room has a view of the endless sea, with green mountains and green waters behind it, and vegetation surrounding the entire hill. It only takes about 5 minutes to walk from the B&B to the Dongqing Night Market and 7-11 convenience store. It has good living functions and convenient access, making it your best choice.

Hotels.Description: At the southern tip of Hengchun Peninsula,  The wind is freer than in the city, and time goes slower.  We chose to open a B&B here. It's not for the pursuit of excitement. Nor is it to make travelers just passers-by for entertainment, I want to make a space. Become the most gentle stop in a journey.  ⸻  Today’s tourism,  It often turns into a race for equipment. KTV, swimming pool, electric mahjong table—— It seems that if something is missing, it can’t be called a “good B&B”.  But we believe that Really touching, Not these facilities, But the light from a window, A gust of sea breeze blew in in the afternoon. A quiet night to be alone.  ⸻  We want you to come here.  It's not for some reason to hit the checkpoint. But to feel again—  Sunshine, wind, tree shadows, dogs on the street corners, The smell of incense in the temple and the sweetness of milk tea in the breakfast shop.  ⸻  Here, You don’t need to fill your schedule. Go out to the mountains and the sea. It's also safe to stay indoors.  You can read, daydream, write, Bake a pot of tea, or do nothing.  ⸻  We believe that • Traveling is not about escaping from life, but getting closer to life • The beauty of Hengchun does not need to be packaged, it can be preserved • B&B is not a commodity, but an invitation to life • The simpler, the more real; the slower, the more profound  ⸻  This is Peninsula Hotel  A place that does not pursue exaggeration and just wants you to be quiet.  Welcome to listen to the wind and yourself

Hotels.Description: .Sunrise Bike Inn is located in Fengshan, Kaohsiung, at the intersection of the city and suburb. Transformed from a Japanese-style space, it’s filled with the daily lives of its hosts—cycling, Surfing, and the vibrant energy of an old house that never fades with age. Instead, it continues to thrive with the arrival of different lives at different times. This is the essence of a military dependents’ village: a blend of various eras and diverse people.This is our home, and we share this space to offer rest and respite. The 80-year-old Japanese-style building isn’t about luxury or grandeur—it’s been simply restored to preserve the soul of the house and traces of past lives. If you’re on a journey or a cycling trip, Sunrise offers a laid-back place to stay. You might hear some noise, perhaps the sound of bicycles—that’s just the rhythm of our life here.
