Hotels.Description: Irately Fa Ge& #39;s Homestay (Introduction)The name of Lanyu, Parsley, means a warm and polite place.Before the road was opened, Lang Island was a must-go place for residents of the Dongqing Tribe and the Coconut Oil Tribe.Therefore, the Langdao tribe, which greets everyone they meet in a friendly manner, is known as a polite tribe.The Langdao tribe is located between the Coconut Oil tribe and the Dongqing tribe. It has the largest territory among the six tribes. The tribe has more strange rocks and stones than other tribes, and the living area is flat.It is divided into the lower tribe and the upper tribe. The lower tribe is currently a space for the elderly to live in.The cement public housing previously built by the government was built at the foot of the mountain above the tribe, called the upper tribe, which is where young people live, forming a contrast between traditional underground houses and modern cement houses and two generations.The tribe& #39;s cultivated land is on the left and right sides of the tribe, and the hillside behind is an orchard. The Langdao tribe has a large hinterland, with a wide intertidal zone and endless sea in front.The beach in front of the lower tribe was set aside as a place for ceremonial activities such as the Fish Attraction Festival.lraraley Fa Ge& #39;s Home B&B is located in the upper residential area, with the mountain behind and the sea in front, quiet in the hustle and bustle, and you can enjoy the sunrise in the east and the sunset in the west. There is a lush green forest on the back mountain. There is no gorgeous decoration design inside Fa Ge& #39;s Home B&B, but it is presented to the guests in a simple, elegant and natural living style. Hotels.Description: Yanliao Village, located east of the Pacific Ocean, boasts a long, narrow coastline and pleasantly cool summers, making it a prime tourist destination. The village boasts numerous cultural attractions, including the Eastern Coast National Scenic Area, Farglory Ocean Park, and Henan Temple. Early farming and fishing were the primary occupations of the village, with agricultural products including peanuts, citronella oil, and sweet potatoes; fish primarily consisted of mullet fry and lobster. Today, Yanliao primarily serves as a tourist destination for guesthouses. Yanliao& #39;s most famous coastal landscape is Taiwan& #39;s longest gravel beach, making it the best place to explore rock formations along the island& #39;s coast. The gravel on the beach boasts a wide variety of rock types. Metamorphic rocks from the Central Mountain Range have traveled thousands of miles to this location, where they blend with sedimentary and igneous rocks from the Coastal Range, creating a spectacular geological landscape.

Images.Description:
Just Right Guesthouse – Room 101 (Ground Floor Double Room)

This cozy double room on the ground floor offers a beautiful garden view right from the window — nature is just outside.
The bathroom features a bathtub, perfect for a relaxing soak after a long day.
You’ll also enjoy full amenities with TV and Wi-Fi for your comfort and convenience.

For guests who may find climbing stairs inconvenient, Room 101 is a friendly and accessible option.
The door opens directly to the living room and kitchen, where you can enjoy warm, leisurely moments with family or friends.

Just Right Guesthouse – Room 201 (Second Floor)

Room 201 faces the community’s open lawn and large trees, with a view of your car parked below.
The balcony is perfect for taking photos, relaxing, or enjoying quiet moments alone.

Inside, the room features two double beds, ideal for families with young children.
It’s equipped with a round table and chairs, plus TV, Wi-Fi, hair dryer, and air conditioning — everything you need for a comfortable stay.

A refrigerator and RO purified water dispenser are available in the first-floor kitchen for shared use.
By keeping the room space uncluttered, you can enjoy a simpler, purer journey — feeling closer to nature, your heart, and your loved ones.

Just Right Guesthouse – Room 202 (Second Floor)

Room 202 features a private balcony and a bathroom with separate wet and dry areas, allowing one person to shower while another uses the toilet without interference — a refined experience for those who enjoy sharing moments in comfort and style.

If you’re traveling with friends or family, your loved ones are just a few steps away in the next room — close enough to gather, yet private enough to retreat at will.
Go downstairs and you’ll find the living room, where you can sing karaoke, play mahjong, or head out for an adventure — all within a moment’s reach.
Step outside the guesthouse, and you’ll meet the starry sky, moonlight, and the gentle evening breeze — every moment is life, and living it “just right” is what matters.

Come — whether you wish to make new friends openly or arrive and leave quietly without a trace, everything here happens just right.

Hotels.Description: Located in the Fuyuan National Forest Recreation Area in Hualien County, Tiancheng Hotel - Butterfly Valley is the first collaboration between Tiancheng Hotel Group and the Forestry and Conservation Administration of the Ministry of Agriculture. With "sustainability, ecology, and vacation" as its core concepts and the vision of "becoming a leading destination for forest ecotourism and hot spring vacations nationwide," Tiancheng Hotel - Butterfly Valley integrates natural resources with the accommodation experience, creating an ecological retreat featuring hot spring guest rooms, single-family villas, open-air hot springs, and forest trails.This area boasts rare low-altitude broadleaf forests in eastern Taiwan and is a key habitat for purple butterfly species. The scenery changes with each season, offering a unique experience of immersion in nature, whether enjoying butterfly watching in spring, escaping the summer heat, or enjoying hot springs in autumn and winter.Adhering to the core values ​​of Tiancheng Hotel Group, "diversity, integration, sharing, and continuity," Tiancheng Hotel - Butterfly Valley extends its brand spirit to the natural setting, creating a unique slow-paced accommodation experience nestled in the forest. Guest rooms are designed with natural imagery in mind, and large windows extend the outdoor greenery indoors, allowing guests to wake up in the morning to soak in the phytoncides and feel the vibrant vitality of the mountain forest.The park draws on precious, 10,000-year-old hot spring waters from the foothills of the Central Mountain Range, offering a premium hot spring experience ideal for relaxation. The park also features a comprehensive nature trail system, exploring butterfly habitats, native forests, and clear streams, allowing guests to experience the tranquility and purity of the Fuyuan National Forest Recreation Area.Tiancheng Yilv - Butterfly Valley invites guests to enter a verdant kingdom of fluttering butterflies, allowing them to breathe in sync with nature and embark on a journey of healing and reconnecting with nature, immersed in the rhythms of the earth.

Hotels.Description: Jiufen Toy HouseNestled in the quiet alleys of the Jiufen mountain town, Jiufen Toy House is more than just a guesthouse—it is the result of years of passion and dedication. We have preserved the charm of a century-old stone house and blended it with elements of industrial design, creating a space that feels both nostalgic and modern. Every corner of the house is filled with toys I’ve collected during my travels—each one tells a story from a different era and reflects my enduring love for the childlike spirit.I believe that the passion for travel and the joy of collecting shouldn’t be just fleeting moments—they should be part of everyday life. I love exploring Northeast Asia, capturing scenery through my lens and experiencing culture through taste. Every journey becomes an extension of my life’s story, adding depth and color to who I am. For me, the greatest joy of running Toy House B&B is meeting and connecting with travelers from all over the world. I’m a passionate, sincere person who truly enjoys making new friends! Under Jiufen’s night sky, I look forward to brewing a pot of tea, sharing travel memories and the joy of collecting, and making this little toy-filled house in the mountain town one of the warmest and most unforgettable stops on your journey.

Hotels.Description: nonNo Old City Memories, Just a Night& #39;s Stroll – A Timeless Walk Near Chiayi City HallChiayi, having witnessed the vicissitudes of time, possesses a charm that time cannot erase. As the humble innkeeper of this guesthouse, I always love to sit on the old wooden chair in front of the door, watching the setting sun cast its rays onto the red-brick old houses at the alley entrance, as if I can hear the footsteps of the past, telling the stories of the city. This guesthouse is located near Chiayi City Hall; during the Japanese occupation, this area was practically the city& #39;s core, and it still retains a rich historical atmosphere.A Qing Dynasty Minnan-Style House Hidden Around the Corner of the CityWhat many travelers wouldn& #39;t expect is that behind our guesthouse, there quietly lies a Qing Dynasty Minnan-style house. With its bluestone brick walls and swallowtail roof, it exudes a serene, poetic atmosphere. This old house, over a hundred years old, was the former residence of a local prominent family, witnessing the early immigrant settlement and community formation in Chiayi. Afternoon sunlight spills onto the roof tiles, casting shadows through the carved window frames, like gentle strokes of time deliberately left for this space. Many visitors enjoy sitting on the small stone steps in front of the old house, sipping tea and chatting, as if they& #39;ve inadvertently shared a moment with people from a bygone era.A four-minute walk to vibrancy and local lifeJust a four-minute walk from the guesthouse will take you to the "Fountain Roundabout" and the Cultural Road Night Market, familiar to Chiayi locals. As evening falls, the lights come on, and the air is filled with enticing aromas; each stall holds the flavors of old Chiayi. Grandma& #39;s grilled corn, a long-established chicken rice shop, aiyu jelly, charcoal-grilled oden… that& #39;s Chiayi& #39;s night—lively and genuine.Breathe in the Forest: Step into the Hinoki VillageOnly about 500 meters from the guesthouse, a seven-minute walk will take you to the "Hinoki Village." This area, once a dormitory complex for forestry workers, has been transformed into a cultural and creative cluster. The Japanese-style wooden buildings are scattered throughout, and walking along the quiet paths gives one the illusion of stepping into the Showa era. Teahouses, handicraft shops, and exhibition spaces allow visitors to immerse themselves in the aroma of wood and the atmosphere of bygone eras.Step into the Chiayi City God Temple and East Market, where faith and daily life intertwine.A seven-minute walk will take you to the century-old Chiayi City God Temple. The temple is a vibrant center of life for the older generation of Chiayi residents. Next to the temple is the East Market, a treasure trove of culinary delights. Enjoy a bowl of rice cake, a taste of pig& #39;s blood soup, and takeout...The starting point for the journey to the mountains—Beimen Station and Chiayi Railway Station.A thirteen-minute walk north will bring you to Beimen Station, one of the starting points of the Alishan Forest Railway. The retro wooden station exudes a nostalgic charm, and you can also visit the Alishan Forestry Village along the way. If you& #39;re coming from out of town, Chiayi Railway Station is just an 18-minute walk away. Along the way, you& #39;ll find old streets and local charm, quietly telling the story of this city. Braised pork rice and a cup of herbal tea are the familiar flavors of every morning for locals.The starting point to the mountains—Beimen Station and Chiayi Railway StationA 13-minute walk north will take you to Beimen Station, one of the starting points of the Alishan Forest Railway. The retro wooden station exudes a nostalgic charm, and you can also visit the Alishan Forestry Village along the way. If you& #39;re coming from out of town, Chiayi Railway Station is just an 18-minute walk away. Along the way, you& #39;ll find old streets and local charm, quietly telling the story of this city.Our guesthouse may not have luxurious modern decor, but every window, every lamp, and every handcrafted old wooden table is a small scene of time that we& #39;ve carefully arranged. We sincerely invite you to stay here for a night, and together, let& #39;s quietly listen to the voice of Chiayi.e
